title: Improving Cross-Lingual Factual Recall via Consistency-Driven Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained predominantly on English data encode substantial world knowledge, yet often fail to express it reliably in other languages, a phenomenon known as cross-lingual factual inconsistency. To study and address this, we introduce PolyFact, a large-scale parallel multilingual factual QA dataset containing 100K Wikidata-grounded facts across 12 typologically diverse languages. Using PolyFact, we compare light continual pretraining (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for improving cross-lingual factual recall in Qwen-2.5-7B and OLMo-2-1124-7B. We find that GRPO consistently outperforms SFT, improving both cross-lingual consistency and generalization to unseen languages, while CPT on parallel data yields limited additional gains. Mechanistic analyses further show that GRPO reorganizes multilingual routing by reducing language specialization in MLP layers and attention heads, thereby promoting more shared cross-lingual representations. We release our code, models, and dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出PolyFact多语言事实QA数据集，发现GRPO强化学习比监督微调更有效提升LLM跨语言事实一致性，机理分析表明GRPO通过减少语言特异性表征来促进跨语言共享。
AI.motivation: LLM主要用英语数据训练，编码了丰富的世界知识，但在其他语言中无法可靠表达，存在跨语言事实不一致问题。
AI.method: 构建PolyFact数据集（10万条维基数据事实，12种语言），对比三种方法：持续预训练（CPT）、监督微调（SFT）、GRPO强化学习，在Qwen-2.5-7B和OLMo-2-1124-7B上评估。
AI.result: GRPO在跨语言一致性和未见语言泛化上均优于SFT；CPT增益有限；GRPO通过减少MLP层和注意力头的语言专门化，促进跨语言表征共享。
AI.conclusion: GRPO是提升LLM跨语言事实回忆的有效方法，其机制在于重组织多语言路由，降低语言特异性，增强跨语言共享表示。

title: Re-Centering Humans in LLM Personalization
summary: Despite growing interest, most evaluations of large language models' (LLMs') personalization abilities have relied on synthetic data. It remains unclear how well current personalization systems work for real users. In this paper, we study the gap in LLM personalization performance when using synthetic versus human data. We collect human conversations (550 conversations) and judgments across three stages of personalization: extracting user attributes from conversations (5,949 judgments), pairing relevant attributes with new prompts (11,919), and incorporating relevant attributes into a personalized response (1,101). Incorporating human data reveals system limitations at each stage. Models struggle to extract attributes from human conversations, disagree with human judgments on relevant attributes, and generate personalized responses that humans judge no better than generic responses (though that LLM judges widely rate as better). We introduce two lightweight training-based interventions that shift automated personalization evaluation closer to human data in our first two stages. However, in our third stage we find that learned reward models achieve only modest correlation with human ratings, suggesting that human-aligned personalization quality judgments are difficult to model directly. Our collected data provides a foundation for studying how models should extract, select, and incorporate user information in ways that humans find useful.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM个性化系统中使用合成数据与真实人类数据之间的性能差距，通过收集550段人类对话和大量判断数据，发现模型在三个个性化阶段（属性提取、属性匹配、响应生成）均表现不佳，并提出了两种轻量级训练干预方法，但发现学习奖励模型与人类评分的相关性仍有限。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数LLM个性化能力的评估依赖合成数据，但尚不清楚这些系统对真实用户的实际效果如何。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究合成数据与真实人类数据在LLM个性化性能上的差距。
AI.method: 收集了550段人类对话和大量判断数据，涵盖个性化三个阶段的评估（属性提取5949个判断、属性匹配11919个判断、个性化响应生成1101个判断），并引入两种轻量级训练干预方法优化前两个阶段。
AI.result: 模型在从人类对话中提取属性时存在困难，与人类在相关属性判断上存在分歧，生成的个性化响应被人类评价为不比通用响应更好（尽管LLM自身评分更高）。提出的训练干预方法在前两个阶段有效，但奖励模型与人类评分的相关性仍较低。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM个性化系统在真实人类数据上表现不佳，前两个阶段可通过轻量级训练改善，但第三阶段（个性化质量判断）与人类对齐仍难以实现，本研究所收集的数据为未来研究奠定了基础。

title: UnpredictaBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Distributional Randomness in LLMs
summary: We introduce UnpredictaBench, an evaluation that tests the ability of large language models (LLMs) to capture true underlying distributions. As LLMs are increasingly used as substitutes for other entities (e.g., for humans in economic simulations), the tendency of many models to collapse towards a single plausible answer means a failure to capture the unpredictability of real systems. Recent work on improving output diversity is insufficient for this setting: simulation requires samples that are calibrated to a target distribution, not merely varied outputs. UnpredictaBench isolates a simplified but fundamental version of this problem: sampling outcomes from individual target distributions, including canonical statistical distributions, distributions induced by stochastic programs, and natural-language scenarios that describe random processes. We introduce 448 such problems together with KS@N, a general-purpose evaluation metric that quantifies how well a model outputs approximate black-box target distributions via the Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistical test. This is the rate at which we fail to reject model samples of size N against ground-truth samples, with larger N indicating greater difficulty. Tested across open and proprietary models, we find a large spread in distributional capabilities. For instance, when models generate samples of size 100 (KS@100, our standard metric), scores range from near 0 to over 20%. No model is able to achieve over 40% at KS@100, showing significant headroom in distributional sampling as a capability. Although adding reasoning can somewhat increase scores, we find no immediate solution for this issue. UnpredictaBench shows that even simple distributional simulation remains challenging, making it a necessary first step toward using LLMs as stand-ins for complex systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了UnpredictaBench评估基准，用于测试大语言模型捕捉真实底层分布的能力，发现当前模型在分布采样任务上表现不足（KS@100最高仅40%+），即使加入推理也难以解决。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作其他实体（如经济模拟中的人类）的替代品，但许多模型倾向于坍缩到单一的"合理"答案，无法捕捉真实系统的不可预测性。现有提升输出多样性的工作不足以解决此问题，因为模拟需要校准到目标分布的样本，而不仅仅是多样化的输出。
AI.method: 构建了448个分布采样问题，涵盖经典统计分布、随机程序诱导分布以及描述随机过程的自然语言场景。引入KS@N评估指标，通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验量化模型输出与黑盒目标分布的拟合程度。
AI.result: 在开源和闭源模型上测试发现分布能力差异巨大：KS@100下分数从接近0%到超过20%不等，最高模型也未超过40%，表明分布采样能力仍有显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 即使是简单的分布模拟对当前LLM仍然具有挑战性，UnpredictaBench是将LLM用作复杂系统替代品所必需的的第一步评估工具。加入推理可小幅提升分数，但无法根本解决问题。

title: How Language Models Fail: Token-Level Signatures of Committed and Persistent Reasoning Failures
summary: Failures in language model reasoning emerge through distinct processes that leave identifiable signatures in the reasoning trace. We characterize these failures using token-level uncertainty signals, finding they arise through two empirically distinguishable processes. The first is committed failure, in which a model locks onto an incorrect reasoning path early in its trace. A central diagnostic signature is the commitment point, beyond which considering additional tokens hurt rather than help failure detection. In the second, persistent uncertainty, uncertainty instead accumulates throughout, and the full trace is needed to best distinguish failing from successful completions. These signatures reproduce across 23 model-dataset configurations, with the framework's falsifiable predictions holding in 20 of 23 cases, well above chance across both failure modes. Finally, we demonstrate our failure mode framework has direct implications for self-consistency, identifying when uncertainty signals complement it and when it can be selectively skipped. These results offer a foundation for understanding when LLM reasoning failures become detectable and for adapting detection strategies accordingly.

AI.tldr: 本文通过token级不确定性信号，将语言模型推理失败分为“承诺失败”（早期锁定错误路径）和“持续不确定性”（不确定性逐渐累积）两种模式，并在23个模型-数据配置中验证了其可区分性，进而指导自一致性策略的选择性应用。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对语言模型推理失败内在机制的细粒度理解，无法区分不同类型的失败模式，导致检测和应对策略缺乏针对性。
AI.method: 利用token级不确定性信号分析推理轨迹，识别出两种失败模式的诊断特征：承诺失败存在“承诺点”（之后更多token反而损害检测），持续不确定性则需要完整轨迹才能最优区分成功与失败。
AI.result: 在23个模型-数据配置中，该框架的可证伪预测在20个案例中成立，显著高于随机水平。两种失败模式的诊断特征均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解LLM推理失败的可检测性提供了基础，并能指导自一致性策略的适应性应用——何时需要不确定性信号补充，何时可以跳过。

title: Applying Deep Learning for cockpit segmentation in the context of mixed reality
comment: XXV Congresso Brasileiro de Automática - CBA 2024
summary: Computer vision is an area that has been growing continuously. With the advance of technologies with a first-person view, new development opportunities have emerged inside the area. Mixed reality promotes virtual environments with objects from the physical world shown in real time. For that, it's necessary to be concerned with the immersion of the user in this simulated environment, increasingly seeking to bring it closer to a possible desired reality. This paper proposes the development of image processing in order to perform the segmentation of images to identify what is foreground and background in order to facilitate the union of virtual and real images. Thus, the present work obtain real images of the user using the off-highway truck simulator CAT793F, through a camera, to be able to perform the segmentation of such images with artificial intelligence techniques.The convolutional neural network architectures "U-net" and "DeepLabV3+" are applied to perform image segmentation. As a result, metrics with around 90% accuracy were presented and and the best model was determined.

AI.tldr: 本文利用U-net和DeepLabV3+卷积神经网络架构对矿用卡车模拟器的第一视角图像进行前景/背景分割，以辅助混合现实中的虚实图像融合，取得了约90%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 为了提升混合现实中用户的沉浸感，需要将真实世界图像与虚拟环境无缝融合，因此需对摄像头采集的真实图像进行前景与背景的准确分割。
AI.method: 使用CAT793F矿用卡车模拟器的摄像头采集真实图像，分别采用U-net和DeepLabV3+两种卷积神经网络架构进行图像分割，以区分前景和背景。
AI.result: 两种模型均取得了约90%的准确率指标，并从中确定了表现最佳的模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于AI的图像分割方法能够有效支持混合现实中的虚实图像融合，为第一视角下的沉浸式模拟器应用提供了可行方案。

title: Detecting and Mitigating Bias by Treating Fairness as a Symmetry Operation
summary: Machine learning systems deployed in high stakes socioeconomic settings routinely display bias. We formalize bias as a symmetry breaking operation: a classifier is fair if its outputs remain invariant under the counterfactual operation of switching a sensitive attribute, with merit features held fixed. We implement loss based regularization as a symmetry restoring mechanism and evaluate the framework on four synthetic datasets with varying levels of noise, correlation, and bias. The framework achieves upwards of 90\% violation reduction, with accuracy costs around 5\%. This framework does not require causal graph knowledge, is computationally lightweight, and generalizes to any sensitive attribute definable as a bit-flip, making it suitable for contexts where local sources of discrimination remain absent from mainstream benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对称性破缺的形式化偏见定义，并通过损失正则化作为对称性恢复机制实现公平分类，在合成数据集上达到90%以上的偏见减少，准确率损失仅约5%。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统在高风险社会经济场景中经常表现出偏见，现有方法存在需要因果图知识、计算成本高等局限，亟需一种轻量级、通用且不依赖因果知识的公平性框架。
AI.method: 将偏见形式化为对称性破缺操作——当固定相关特征不变、切换敏感属性时，若分类器输出不变则视为公平；通过基于损失的规则化作为对称性恢复机制来实现公平性。
AI.result: 在四个不同噪声、相关性和偏见水平的合成数据集上，该方法实现了超过90%的违规减少，准确率成本仅约5%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不需要因果图知识、计算轻量、可推广到任何可定义为比特翻转的敏感属性，特别适用于本地歧视来源未出现在主流基准测试中的场景。

title: CAF-Gen: A Multi-Agent System for Enriching Argumentation Structures
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of ICCCI 2026
summary: Formalizing complex reasoning from natural text is one of the central challenges in computational linguistics. It requires systems to understand not just keywords but also the context and complex reasoning embedded in a text. Current Argument Mining (AM) techniques identify basic claims and premises, yet they often struggle to capture the richer structural information required by advanced schemas such as the Carneades Argumentation Framework (CAF), which incorporates features such as premise types, proof standards, and argument schemes. We address this limitation by introducing CAF-Gen, an automated multi-agent framework designed to enrich shallow argument structures into CAF-compliant argument models. By employing an iterative Creator-Reviewer pipeline, a creator agent's output is validated by a critical agent to ensure structural integrity. This multi-agent collaboration is crucial for mitigating the structural instability typical of single-pass generative models. Our experiments demonstrate that the iterative feedback loop improves the quality of the resulting data and achieves strong alignment with the original annotations, while producing structurally richer models. Our findings show that the multi-agent system can overcome the limitations of single-pass generation, providing a robust methodology for the automated modeling of formal argumentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAF-Gen，一个多智能体框架，通过迭代的Creator-Reviewer流程将浅层论证结构自动丰富为符合Carneades Argumentation Framework (CAF)的复杂论证模型，有效克服了单次生成模型的结构不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 当前论证挖掘技术能识别基本主张和前提，但难以捕捉高级框架（如CAF）所需的丰富结构信息，如前提类型、证明标准和论证模式。
AI.method: 提出CAF-Gen多智能体框架，采用迭代的Creator-Reviewer流水线：创作者智能体生成输出，审阅者智能体验证结构完整性，通过多智能体协作缓解单次生成模型的结构不稳定问题。
AI.result: 实验表明，迭代反馈循环提升了数据质量，与原始标注高度一致，并生成了结构更丰富的模型。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统能克服单次生成的局限性，为自动化建模形式化论证提供了稳健的方法论。

title: GOPAgen: Motion-Aware and Efficient Agentic Long-Video Understanding with Structural Memory and Hierarchical Reasoning
summary: Despite significant progress in agentic long video understanding, existing methods still lack detailed motion comprehension coupled with an efficient memory architecture. In this paper, we propose GOPAgen, a novel approach that first integrates video codec into the video understanding framework via a meticulously designed motion agent trained on Groups of Pictures (GOPs) from video codec. We further develop a GOP tree reasoning algorithm, which is naturally aligned with video codec and enhances the model's ability to understand local detailed motions in videos. Additionally, we carefully design a structural memory mechanism that integrates local motion information with detailed captions in structural pages, and propose an efficient coarse-to-fine zoom-in algorithm to fully exploit the structural memory. Furthermore, we incorporate a motion vector database into the framework to enable efficient retrieval of motion vectors at different granularities. Overall, our method achieves superior Video Question Answering (VQA) performance on various video understanding benchmarks, including MotionBench and Egoschema, thereby demonstrating the superiority of our proposed framework.

AI.tldr: GOPAgen将视频编解码中的GOP（图像组）结构引入视频理解框架，通过运动代理、GOP树推理、结构化记忆和运动矢量数据库，显著提升了长视频中的细粒度运动理解能力，在多个VQA基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体长视频理解方法在细粒度运动理解和高效记忆架构方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 基于视频编解码GOP训练的运动代理；2) GOP树推理算法增强局部运动理解；3) 结构化记忆机制融合运动信息与详细描述；4) 粗到细的缩放算法利用结构化记忆；5) 运动矢量数据库实现多粒度高效检索。
AI.result: 在MotionBench、Egoschema等多个视频理解基准上取得领先的VQA性能。
AI.conclusion: GOPAgen框架通过融合视频编解码与结构化记忆，有效提升了长视频中细粒度运动理解能力，证明了该方法的优越性。

title: DiBS: Diffusion-Informed Branch Selection
summary: Sudoku is a representative constraint satisfaction problem that requires global structural reasoning under strict discrete constraints. The existing works of solving Sudoku mainly focus on two dominant approaches, i.e., traditional heuristic and deep learning solver. However, they suffer from two complementary limitations: learning-based solvers lack hard correctness guarantees, while complete symbolic solvers are still prone to long-tail search. To address these shortcomings, we propose a novel diffusion model-guided approach, termed as DiBS, for the branch selection search process. Specifically, DiBS keeps the symbolic solver complete and uses the diffusion model as a branch-ordering guide. The core method is ranking candidate values under the current partial assignment and lightweight consistency signal. Furthermore, we provide an in-depth theoretical proof to reveal how it works and why it works. Experiments on the challenging Royle 17-clue Sudoku benchmark show that our DiBS substantially reduces search cost relative to strong heuristic baselines, especially in nodes, backtracks, and long-tail percentiles. Besides, these results confirm that learned global guidance is effective on hard instances where branch-order mistakes are most expensive. All codes are available at https://github.com/shanxierdan/DiBS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiBS，一种将扩散模型与符号求解器结合的Sudoku求解方法，利用扩散模型引导分支选择，在保证完全性的同时大幅降低搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 现有Sudoku求解方法存在互补性缺陷：基于学习的求解器缺乏硬正确性保证，而完全符号求解器仍易陷入长尾搜索。需要一种兼具完备性与高效性的方法。
AI.method: DiBS保持符号求解器的完备性，使用扩散模型作为分支排序引导。核心方法是在当前部分赋值和轻量级一致性信号下对候选值进行排序，并提供了理论证明。
AI.result: 在Royle 17线索Sudoku基准上，DiBS相比强启发式基线显著降低了搜索成本，尤其在节点数、回溯次数和长尾百分位数方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证实，在分支顺序错误代价高昂的困难实例上，学习到的全局引导是有效的。代码已开源。

title: The Piggyback Hypothesis of Generalization: Explaining and Mitigating Emergent Misalignment
summary: The mechanisms behind LLMs' broad over-generalization beyond training examples remain unclear. Emergent misalignment (EM) offers a striking case study: finetuning on narrow tasks induces broad misalignment to semantically-unrelated test domains. In this work, we propose the Piggyback Hypothesis: the chat-template tokens can piggyback the finetuned behaviour onto out-of-domain queries. We validate this hypothesis by showing that subtle perturbations to the prefix (tokens preceding all user queries), or patching the prefix representations with those from the unfinetuned model, can restore alignment without changing the user query. Building on this finding, we propose Token-Regularized Finetuning (TReFT), which regularizes specific token representations during training to mitigate EM. Across different models and multiple EM-inducing datasets, TReFT reduces EM while preserving in-domain learning. On Llama-3.1-8B finetuned on the legal domain, TReFT achieves 33.5% more EM reduction than data interleaving with a retain set of aligned examples. We further show that TReFT extends to other narrow-finetuning settings, including abstention, tool use, and refusal (off-topic generalization is reduced by 54.3% on average), supporting the Piggyback Hypothesis. Broadly, our work highlights that LLMs may learn and generalize in unintended ways and suggests a path toward more constrained finetuning. It also calls for further study of how shared input features can piggyback model behavior across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“搭便车假说”（Piggyback Hypothesis），认为聊天模板中的前缀token会将微调行为“搭便车”到领域外查询上，导致大模型出现突现性错位（EM）。基于此，提出Token正则化微调（TReFT），通过在训练时正则化特定token表示来缓解EM，实验表明该方法有效降低EM并保留领域内学习能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在窄任务微调后会在语义无关的测试领域出现广泛的突现性错位（EM），其背后机制尚不清楚。本文旨在揭示这一现象的成因并提出缓解方法。
AI.method: 提出搭便车假说，通过扰动前缀token或替换其表示来验证；提出Token正则化微调（TReFT），在训练时对特定token表示施加正则化以抑制EM。
AI.result: TReFT在Llama-3.1-8B法律领域微调中EM减少33.5%；在拒答、工具使用、拒绝等窄微调场景中，域外泛化平均降低54.3%。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可能以非预期方式学习和泛化，共享输入特征（如前缀token）可将模型行为“搭便车”到不同领域；本文为更受约束的微调提供了可行路径。

title: Attention-Guided Autoencoder Fusion for Insulator Defect Detection Using UAV Transmission-Line Imaging
summary: Automated defect detection in high-voltage transmission-line insulators remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, large scale variation, and the small spatial extent of defect instances in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery. To address these challenges, this paper proposes AE-YOLO, an Attention-Guided AutoEncoder-Enhanced YOLO framework for robust insulator defect detection. The architecture integrates lightweight bottleneck autoencoders within a Feature Pyramid Network-Path Aggregation Network (FPN-PAN) neck. This preserves anomaly-sensitive information during multi-scale feature fusion. Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM) are used throughout the backbone, enhancing feature discrimination and suppressing background interference. The framework also introduces a variance-maximizing autoencoder regularization strategy, which encourages diverse, defect-discriminative latent representations. The network trains using a unified objective that combines focal loss, Complete IoU (CIoU) loss, and autoencoder regularization to address foreground-background imbalance and improve localization accuracy. During inference, Weighted Boxes Fusion (WBF) combines predictions from YOLOv8, YOLOv10, and YOLO11. An autoencoder-guided confidence boosting mechanism improves sensitivity to rare defect categories. Experiments on the Insulator-Defect Detection dataset show that AE-YOLO with an EfficientNetV2 backbone achieves 95.10 percent mAP at 0.5, 96.40 percent precision, and 93.80 percent recall. This performance surpasses the strongest YOLO-family baseline by 5.0 points in mAP at 0.5 and 6.7 points in recall. These results confirm the effectiveness and adaptability of the framework. The model is a practical and scalable solution for UAV-based transmission-line inspection and defect monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AE-YOLO框架，通过自编码器增强、注意力机制和多模型融合，在无人机绝缘子缺陷检测中实现95.10% mAP@0.5，比最强YOLO基线提升5.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 无人机航拍绝缘子缺陷检测面临严重的类别不平衡、尺度变化大和缺陷实例空间范围小等挑战，现有方法难以有效应对。
AI.method: 在FPN-PAN颈部集成轻量瓶颈自编码器保留异常敏感信息；骨干网络使用CBAM增强特征判别性；提出方差最大化自编码器正则化策略；结合Focal Loss、CIoU Loss和自编码器正则化的统一训练目标；推理时使用WBF融合YOLOv8/v10/v11预测结果，并引入自编码器引导的置信度提升机制。
AI.result: 在绝缘子缺陷检测数据集上，基于EfficientNetV2骨干的AE-YOLO达95.10% mAP@0.5、96.40%精度、93.80%召回率，相比最强YOLO基线mAP@0.5提升5.0点，召回率提升6.7点。
AI.conclusion: AE-YOLO框架有效且适应性强，是无人机输电线路巡检和缺陷监测的实用可扩展方案。

title: SafeGene: Reusable Adapters for Transferable Safety Alignment
summary: Open-weight LLMs are increasingly fine-tuned into customized assistants, but downstream fine-tuning can weaken safety alignment and make models more vulnerable to malicious prompts, even when the training data is not intentionally harmful. This creates a recurring safety recovery problem as target models are repeatedly updated with new task data or user interactions. We propose SafeGene, a reusable safety-adapter module designed for cross-task reuse within each architecture-compatible model family. Rather than treating safety recovery as a model-specific repair step, SafeGene treats safety capability as an independent, reusable adapter representation decoupled from task-specific updates. This representation is obtained from aligned--degraded model discrepancies, refined into task-transferable safety vectors through data-aware layer selection, and expressed in each downstream task-adapted model via few-shot layer-wise coefficient recalibration. Experiments across multiple model families, downstream tasks, and safety judges show that SafeGene-enhanced models reduce harmful response rates while maintaining downstream performance, outperforming representative safe adaptation methods in safety--utility trade-off.

AI.tldr: SafeGene是一种可重用的安全适配器模块，通过将安全能力解耦为独立表示，在跨任务微调中恢复LLM的安全性，无需重新对齐整个模型。
AI.motivation: 开源LLM在下游微调中会削弱安全对齐，且模型频繁更新导致安全问题反复出现，现有方法缺乏可跨任务复用的安全恢复机制。
AI.method: 从对齐模型与退化模型的差异中提取安全表示，通过数据感知的层选择提炼为可迁移的安全向量，再利用少样本层系数重新校准将其注入下游任务适配模型。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族、下游任务和安全评判标准下，SafeGene增强的模型在降低有害响应率的同时保持了下游任务性能，优于现有安全适应方法。
AI.conclusion: 安全能力可以作为独立、可复用的适配器表示与任务特定更新解耦，实现跨任务的低成本安全恢复。

title: What Do People Actually Want From AI? Mapping Preference Plurality
comment: Accepted at the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26)
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are often fine-tuned through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to align with people's preferences and values. However, this method has known limitations: it aggregates conflicting preferences, often relies on unrepresentative samples, and uses only binary comparisons. Analysing 1,500 open-ended responses from the PRISM dataset across 75 countries, we examine what people actually want from AI systems and reveal concrete failures of current methods.
  We find that different people want different things: most values are requested by fewer than a quarter of respondents, with truthfulness the sole exception at 49%. Furthermore, the same words hide divergent meanings: when people describe what they mean by "truthfulness", they reveal distinct, potentially incompatible, epistemological bases, as some ask for sourced claims, some for expert opinions, and some even ask for unpopular views. Certain capabilities, namely how human-like a model behaves, and some features, like AI guardrails, are outright controversial, with some desiring them and others rejecting them. We additionally find that people often use contextual distinctions (what AI should do "by default" versus "if requested") that binary comparisons cannot capture.
  These findings expose fundamental problems in current alignment practices. When 49% request truthfulness but define it differently, this is unlikely to be captured by a single reward model. The persistence of high hallucination rates in well-funded models, despite users' clear demands for accuracy, suggests that current methods fail to identify actual preferences. This paper sheds light on the situated, contested, imperfect signals that are currently being flattened into universal preference models, a practice others have characterised as epistemic violence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析75个国家1500份开放回答，发现当前RLHF存在三大问题：价值观诉求高度分散（仅"真实性"被49%受访者提及）、同一词汇（如"真实性"）含义分歧巨大、某些能力（如拟人化）存在根本性争议。这些发现揭示了将多元化的人类偏好扁平化为单一奖励模型的做法存在根本缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前RLHF方法存在已知局限：聚合冲突偏好、依赖非代表性样本、仅使用二元比较。本研究旨在揭示这些方法在实际应用中如何失败，以及人们真正期望的AI系统是什么样的。
AI.method: 分析PRISM数据集中来自75个国家的1,500份开放回答，考察人们对AI系统的真实期望。
AI.result: (1) 大多数价值观诉求被不到25%受访者提及，仅"真实性"达49%；(2) 同一词汇（如"真实性"）在不同人眼中包含不同甚至不相容的认识论基础（来源可查、专家意见、少数派观点）；(3) 某些能力（拟人化程度）和特征（AI护栏）存在根本性争议；(4) 人们常使用"默认"与"按需"的上下文区分，这是二元比较无法捕捉的。
AI.conclusion: 当前将多元化的、情境化的、有争议的人类偏好扁平化为通用偏好模型的做法存在根本问题，这种做法已被学者定性为"认识论暴力"。49%的人要求真实性却定义各异，单一奖励模型无法捕捉这种差异；高幻觉率持续存在表明当前方法未能识别真实偏好。

title: WorldBench: A Challenging and Visually Diverse Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark
summary: In real-world applications, models are expected to perform reliably across diverse settings. Yet, many existing multimodal benchmarks expand task types without capturing the visual diversity needed to handle open-ended visual inputs. We present WorldBench, a challenging and visually diverse reasoning benchmark to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). We build a taxonomy of thousands of visual concepts across multiple domains (e.g., living things). Guided by this taxonomy, we curate a broad collection of images from search engines and existing datasets to comprehensively represent the visual world. Through structured trial-and-error, we manually design challenging questions that frontier MLLMs fail to answer. On quantitative and human evaluations, WorldBench achieves higher visual diversity than any existing diverse benchmark. Evaluating 15 MLLMs on WorldBench reveals weaknesses in visual understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 64.0% accuracy, while some models perform marginally above chance-level. We hope our work highlights the importance of visual diversity in building multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: WorldBench是一个视觉多样性极高的多模态大语言模型推理基准，最强模型仅达64.0%准确率，揭示了现有模型在视觉理解方面的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基准虽扩展了任务类型，但缺乏应对开放视觉输入所需的视觉多样性，无法真实评估模型在多样化场景下的表现。
AI.method: 构建覆盖多个领域（如生物等）的数千视觉概念分类体系，据此从搜索引擎和现有数据集中筛选广泛图片，并通过结构化试错人工设计前沿模型难以回答的挑战性问题。
AI.result: 在定量评估和人工评估中，WorldBench的视觉多样性超过所有现有基准；15个MLLM中最强模型仅达64.0%准确率，部分模型仅略高于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 视觉多样性对构建多模态基准至关重要，当前MLLM在开放视觉理解方面仍存在显著弱点。

title: Lean4Agent: Formal Modeling and Verification for Agent Workflow and Trajectory
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) to execute reliable multi-step workflows has become a central challenge in artificial intelligence. Despite recent advances in LLMs' agentic capabilities, most agent systems still lack formal methods for specifying, verifying, and debugging their workflow and execution trajectories. This challenge mirrors a long-standing problem in mathematics, where the ambiguity of natural languages (NLs) motivates the development of formal languages (FLs). Inspired by this paradigm, we propose **Lean4Agent**, to the best of our knowledge, the first framework that uses Lean4, a dependent-type FL to model and verify agent behavior. **Lean4Agent** launches **FormalAgentLib**, an extensible Lean4 library for formally modeling and verifying agent workflows' semantic consistency under explicit assumptions, and enabling localization of execution-time failures revealed by trajectories. Building on **FormalAgentLib**, we further develop **LeanEvolve**, which applies results in **FormalAgentLib** to revise workflows to enhance its capability. Extensive experiments on a hard problem subset of SWE-Bench-Verified and a subset of ELAIP-Bench across 5 leading LLMs indicate that the verification-passing workflows outperform the failing ones by an average of **11.94%**, and **LeanEvolve** further improves SWE performance by **7.47%** on average. Furthermore, **Lean4Agent** establishes a foundation for a new field of using expressive dependent-type FL to formally model and verify agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出Lean4Agent框架，利用依赖类型形式语言Lean4对LLM智能体的工作流进行形式化建模与验证，实验证明验证通过的工作流性能平均提升11.94%，LeanEvolve进一步改进7.47%。
AI.motivation: LLM在多步工作流中缺乏形式化的规约、验证和调试方法，这一问题类似于自然语言歧义性推动形式语言发展的经典困境，因此需要引入形式语言来建模和验证智能体行为。
AI.method: 基于Lean4（依赖类型形式语言）构建FormalAgentLib库，用于形式化建模与验证智能体工作流的语义一致性，并定位执行时故障；在此基础上提出LeanEvolve，利用验证结果自动修订工作流以提升能力。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench-Verified和ELAIP-Bench子集上，验证通过的工作流比验证失败的工作流平均高11.94%；LeanEvolve进一步将SWE性能平均提升7.47%。
AI.conclusion: Lean4Agent为利用表达性依赖类型形式语言进行智能体行为的形式化建模与验证奠定了基础，开辟了该方向的新研究领域。

title: HKJudge: A Legal Discourse-Annotated Corpus for Interpreting What Courts Find, How They Reason, and What They Rule
summary: Court judgments are central to legal practice and jurisprudence, yet discourse analysis of Hong Kong judgments has received limited attention, owing largely to the absence of expert-annotated corpora. We introduce the Hong Kong Judgment Discourse Dataset (HKJudge), the first sentence-level expert-annotated legal discourse corpus. HKJudge includes criminal judgments across all five levels of HK's court hierarchy, comprising $\sim$290k sentences and $\sim$6.5 million tokens, fully annotated by legal linguistics experts. We design a two-tier discourse schema that captures what facts a court finds, how it reasons, and what it rules. At the sentence level, each sentence is assigned one of 26 rhetorical roles. At the span level, sentences are further annotated with three sentencing elements (charge, imprisonment term, fine). Ten legal linguistics annotators produced the annotations with an inter-annotator agreement of $κ= 0.8$. We formulate two tasks on HKJudge, termed rhetorical role classification and legal element extraction, and provide the first benchmark evaluation of four BERT-based models, two open-source LLMs under zero-shot and fine-tuning settings, and four commercial LLMs on both tasks. Our work demonstrates the value of sentence-level discourse annotation for modeling the structure of HK judgments and provides a rich data foundation for future work on legal judgment prediction. The HKJudge dataset and code are available at https://github.com/xuanxixi/HKJudge.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍HKJudge，首个由法律语言学专家标注的香港刑事判决书句子级语篇语料库，包含约29万句、650万词，设计了双层语篇标注体系，并提供了多种模型的基准评测。
AI.motivation: 香港判决书的语篇分析因缺乏专家标注语料库而受到限制，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建HKJudge语料库：覆盖香港法院五个层级刑事判决书，由10位法律语言学专家进行双层标注（26种修辞角色的句子级标注+三种量刑要素的片段级标注）。在修辞角色分类和量刑要素提取两个任务上测试了4种BERT模型、2种开源LLM和4种商业LLM。
AI.result: 标注一致性达到κ=0.8，提供了多种模型的首次基准评测结果。
AI.conclusion: 句子级语篇标注对建模香港判决书结构具有重要价值，为未来法律判决预测研究提供了丰富的语料基础。

title: Synthetic Benchmarks Overstate Forward-Forward Scaling: Real-Data Limits of Layer-Local Training
summary:
Forward-Forward (FF) learning [Hinton, 2022] replaces backpropagation with strictly layer-local goodness updates. Recent FF-CNN work has narrowed the gap to BP on 32x32 benchmarks, raising the question of whether layer-local training is becoming a viable alternative at realistic scale. To probe this rigorously, we develop DTG-FF -- dynamic temperature goodness, decoupled normalization, and multi-layer fusion -- as an instrument that sets FF-family state of the art across nine real-data benchmarks (91.8% CIFAR-10 and the first FF baseline at ImageNet-100 224x224), and use it to audit how far layer-local training actually scales.
  (1) Real-data scaling. Under identical recipe and backbone, an architecture-matched BP-DeepSup baseline beats DTG-FF by 2.40/5.93 pp on CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100, and the gap widens with class count. At 224x224 the same instrument reaches only 49.4% -- the first FF baseline at this scale, versus typical BP above 75% [Tian et al., 2020] -- exposing a real-data ceiling invisible at 32x32.
  (2) Synthetic vs. real K-conflict. DTG-FF increasingly outperforms BP as class count K grows on synthetic teacher-student tasks, yet on real images the FF-BP gap reverses sign and widens with K. A within-dataset CIFAR-100 coarse vs. fine probe isolates label-hierarchy from image distribution: synthetic K-sweeps confound output dimensionality with fine-grained discrimination difficulty and thereby overstate FF transferability.
  (3) Systems audit. FF can be implemented without storing depth-wide activations, but on commodity 8 GB hardware standard BP+gradient-accumulation reaches 4.18 GB / 157 imgs/s versus DTG-FF's 7.90 GB / 138 imgs/s, so a memory-based justification for FF at this scale is not supported under fair baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了DTG-FF方法，在多个真实数据集上达到FF系列最佳性能（CIFAR-10 91.8%，首次在ImageNet-100 224x224上建立FF基线49.4%），但与BP方法相比仍有显著差距（CIFAR-10上低2.40个百分点，ImageNet-100上BP通常超75%）。研究发现FF在合成任务上的优势在真实数据中不成立，且FF在8GB硬件上并未节省内存（7.90GB vs BP的4.18GB），挑战了层局部训练作为BP可行替代的论断。
AI.motivation: 探究层局部训练（Forward-Forward learning）是否能成为反向传播（BP）在真实规模下的可行替代方案，检验其扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出DTG-FF方法（动态温度目标、解耦归一化、多层融合），在9个真实数据集上进行对比实验，并通过合成数据实验和系统内存/速度审计进行深入分析。
AI.result: DTG-FF在CIFAR-10达91.8%，ImageNet-100 224x224达49.4%（首个FF基线），但BP在相同条件下分别高出2.40/5.93个百分点；合成数据中FF表现优于BP，但真实数据中差距反转；硬件测试中FF占用内存7.90GB高于BP的4.18GB。
AI.conclusion: 层局部训练在真实数据尺度下与BP仍有显著差距，其在合成任务上的优势源于混淆了输出维度与细粒度判别难度，且内存优势在公平对比下不成立，FF并非BP的可行替代方案。

title: CrowdMath: A Dataset of Crowdsourced Mathematical Research Discussions
summary: Large language models have made substantial progress on mathematical reasoning, but existing benchmarks typically evaluate well-specified problems with final answers, step-by-step solutions, or complete proofs. They do not capture collaborative open-problem solving: a setting in which participants propose partial arguments, identify gaps or errors in prior steps, repair flawed reasoning, and gradually synthesize incremental contributions into a proof. We introduce CrowdMath, a dataset of 164 expert-annotated progress chains from the MIT PRIMES--Art of Problem Solving (AoPS) CrowdMath program (2016-2025), a collaborative research initiative whose discussions have led to peer-reviewed publications. Each chain traces a multi-participant forum discussion from an open-problem statement to a completed proof. Posts are labeled by their functional roles in the evolving solution process, including partial progress, proof completion, erroneous reasoning, and error identification. We define evaluation tasks and benchmark six frontier models. Models achieve 83-88% accuracy on next-post prediction, suggesting that they can follow the local flow of mathematical discussion. However, they struggle to identify the functional significance of individual contributions with the best model achieving only 0.42 macro-F1 on post-role classification. CrowdMath exposes a gap between solving well-specified mathematical problems and understanding collaborative mathematical progress as it unfolds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CrowdMath数据集，包含164条专家标注的数学协作讨论链，并评估了六个前沿模型。模型在下一帖预测任务上表现良好（83-88%准确率），但在识别帖子功能角色方面表现较差（最佳模型macro-F1仅为0.42），揭示了当前模型在理解协作数学推理过程上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理基准主要评估结构良好、有明确答案的问题，无法捕捉协作式开放问题求解过程——即参与者提出部分论证、识别错误、修复推理并逐步综合贡献形成完整证明的协作场景。
AI.method: 从MIT PRIMES-AoPS CrowdMath项目（2016-2025）中构建了164条专家标注的进展链，每条链追踪从开放问题到完整证明的多参与者论坛讨论，并对帖子的功能角色（部分进展、证明完成、错误推理、错误识别等）进行标注。
AI.result: 六个前沿模型在下一帖预测任务上达到83-88%准确率，但在帖子角色分类任务中最佳模型macro-F1仅为0.42。
AI.conclusion: CrowdMath暴露了当前模型在解决结构良好的数学问题与理解协作数学推理过程之间的差距，表明模型在追踪局部讨论流方面尚可，但难以识别单个贡献在整体推理中的功能意义。

title: Signal-Driven Observation for Long-Horizon Web Agents
summary: Web agents operating over long horizons ingest raw DOM and accessibility trees -- routinely tens of thousands of tokens -- at every action step, causing progressive context degradation that erodes reasoning well before tasks complete. We argue that this coupling of observation frequency to action frequency is an architectural mistake. Drawing on the insight from Recursive Language Models that querying a document outperforms reading it wholesale, we propose Signal-Driven Observation (SDO): a dedicated sub-call reads the full DOM but returns only task-relevant elements and their selectors, and is re-invoked only when a lightweight signal detector fires -- triggered by URL transitions, newly visible interactive elements, action failures, or exogenous browser events. We outline the open problems SDO introduces and call on the community to treat observation compression as a core architectural decision in web agent design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信号驱动观察（SDO）方法，将Web智能体的观察频率与动作频率解耦，仅在特定信号触发时重新读取完整DOM，从而避免长任务中的上下文退化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体在每个动作步骤都读取完整的DOM或无障碍树（数万token），导致长任务中上下文逐渐退化，推理能力在任务完成前就已下降。作者认为将观察频率与动作频率耦合是架构上的错误。
AI.method: 提出信号驱动观察（SDO）：专用子调用读取完整DOM但仅返回任务相关元素及其选择器；仅当轻量级信号检测器触发（URL变化、新交互元素出现、动作失败或外部浏览器事件）时才重新调用。
AI.result: 尚未给出实验验证，主要提出SDO框架及待解决的开放问题，呼吁社区将观察压缩作为Web智能体设计的核心架构决策。
AI.conclusion: 观察压缩应成为Web智能体架构设计的核心组成部分，SDO为长任务场景下的智能体效率提升提供了新方向。

title: Direct 3D-Aware Object Insertion via Decomposed Visual Proxies
summary: Object insertion aims to seamlessly composite a reference object into a specified region of a background image. Recent diffusion-based methods achieve high visual quality but formulate insertion as a simple 2D inpainting task, providing no explicit control over the object's 3D pose and limiting their practical applicability. We propose DIRECT (Decomposed Injection for Reference Composition and Target-integration), a novel framework that integrates interactive pose manipulation with high-fidelity 2D image synthesis to enable pose-controllable object insertion. Our method decomposes the insertion conditions into three complementary components: appearance guidance capturing visual details from the reference object, geometry guidance derived from the user-adjusted 3D proxy, and context guidance from the target background. By injecting them through separate pathways, DIRECT avoids feature entanglement and simultaneously preserves reference appearance, follows the user-specified pose, and adapts the object to the target scene. We also introduce an automated data construction pipeline to improve the diversity and quality of training data. Experiments show that DIRECT outperforms previous methods in both geometric controllability and visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出DIRECT框架，通过分解注入外观、几何和上下文引导，实现可控制3D姿态的物体插入，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型将物体插入视为简单2D修复任务，缺乏对物体3D姿态的显式控制，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 将插入条件分解为三个互补组件：外观引导（参考物体视觉细节）、几何引导（用户调整的3D代理）、上下文引导（目标背景），通过分离路径注入避免特征纠缠，并引入自动化数据构建流程。
AI.result: 在几何可控性和视觉质量上均优于此前方法。
AI.conclusion: DIRECT框架能够同时保留参考物体外观、遵循用户指定姿态并适应目标场景，实现了姿态可控的高质量物体插入。

title: Attack Selection in Agentic AI Control Evaluations Meaningfully Decreases Safety
summary: An attacker that strategically chooses when to attack is much harder to catch than one that attacks indiscriminately. AI control is a safety framework for deploying capable but untrusted AI agents under the oversight of a weaker, trusted monitor and a limited human audit budget. Control evaluations stress-test these protocols by pitting a red-team attack policy against the blue-team monitor, but current evaluations typically assume attackers that do not strategically select when to attack. We study this capability, attack selection, in agentic settings by decomposing attack decisions into a start policy, which decides when an attacker should attack, and a stop policy, which decides when an attacker should abort an ongoing attack. Across two agentic settings, BashArena and LinuxArena, both policies substantially lower measured empirical safety without changing the underlying attack capability. At a 1% audit budget, our start policy reduces safety by 20pp on both BashArena and LinuxArena, and our stop policy reduces safety by 20pp on BashArena and 28pp on LinuxArena. These reductions should be interpreted as upper bounds on the effect of attack selection. Existing control evaluations may therefore yield overly optimistic safety estimates against selective attackers. We recommend that future evaluations, system cards, and safety cases elicit attack selection to produce more realistic safety estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI控制框架中攻击者策略性选择攻击时机（攻击选择）对安全评估的影响，发现Start和Stop两种策略均显著降低安全性，现有控制评估可能高估安全水平。
AI.motivation: 现有AI控制评估假设攻击者不会策略性选择攻击时机，这可能导致对安全性的乐观估计，因此需要研究攻击选择这一能力对安全评估的实际影响。
AI.method: 将攻击决策分解为Start策略（决定何时开始攻击）和Stop策略（决定何时中止攻击），在BashArena和LinuxArena两个智能体环境中进行实验。
AI.result: 在1%审计预算下，Start策略在两个环境中均降低安全性20pp；Stop策略在BashArena降低20pp，在LinuxArena降低28pp。
AI.conclusion: 现有控制评估可能对选择性攻击者给出过于乐观的安全估计，建议未来评估应引入攻击选择机制以获得更现实的安全评估。

title: Data-Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: We study the transformation of autoregressive models (ARLMs) into diffusion language models (DLMs). Rather than pretraining from scratch, prior work replaces the causal attention in ARLMs with bidirectional attention and then trains the resulting model using a DLM objective. However, these approaches incur two distribution shifts. First, transitioning from a next-token prediction objective to a DLM objective can discard knowledge acquired by the ARLM during training. Second, standard DLMs suffer from a train-inference mismatch, as the training loss is defined on randomly masked sequences rather than the trajectories encountered at inference produced by confidence-based decoding. To address both challenges, we introduce an On-Policy Diffusion Language Model (OPDLM) in which On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is employed for ARLM-to-DLM transformation. Specifically, OPDLM is trained via self-OPD, where the student, an ARLM with bidirectional attention, generates its own trajectories, and the teacher, the original frozen ARLM, distills its knowledge by providing target logits on these trajectories. By training directly in an on-policy manner, OPDLM eliminates the train-inference mismatch in DLMs, while distillation from the original model enhances knowledge retention from the ARLM. Empirical results demonstrate that OPDLM requires 15x to 7,000x fewer training tokens with strong performance across a wide variety of tasks. OPDLM avoids the prohibitive cost of DLM pretraining and positions DLM transformation as a form of ARLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为OPDLM的在线策略蒸馏方法，将自回归模型高效转化为扩散语言模型，训练数据量减少15倍至7000倍，同时避免原有方法中的分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有将ARLM转化为DLM的方法存在两个分布偏移问题：一是从自回归目标转向扩散目标会丢失先前学到的知识；二是标准DLM存在训练-推理不匹配，训练时使用随机掩码序列而非推理时的置信度解码轨迹。这两个问题导致转化效率低、需要大量训练数据。
AI.method: 提出OPDLM方法，采用在线策略蒸馏（OPD）：学生模型（带双向注意力的ARLM）生成自己的轨迹，教师模型（原始冻结的ARLM）在这些轨迹上提供目标logits进行知识蒸馏。通过在线策略训练消除训练-推理不匹配，同时通过蒸馏保留原始ARLM的知识。
AI.result: OPDLM仅需15倍到7000倍更少的训练token，就能在多种任务上取得强劲性能，避免了昂贵的DLM预训练成本。
AI.conclusion: OPDLM有效解决了ARLM到DLM转化中的分布偏移问题，将DLM转化定位为ARLM的后训练阶段，大幅降低了训练成本。

title: CARVE-Q: Quantum-Proposed, Classically Certified Interactive Driving Repair
summary: The critical question after a correct driving veto is not only whether a maneuver is unsafe, but whether the blocked interaction admits a lawful, auditable, and responsibility-bounded repair. Prediction and game-theoretic planners can suggest plausible cooperation, yet they do not return a proof that the repair respects hard rules, right-of-way, cost allocation, and ego fallback. We introduce CARVE, Certified Affordable Repair of Vetoed maneuvers via Envelopes, a certificate architecture for prediction-free interactive repair. Given a vetoed maneuver, CARVE constructs a finite repair lattice and emits a structured certificate recording the binding rule, selected joint repair, right-of-way-scaled cooperation envelope, responsibility-weighted cost split, and ego-only fallback. This certificate view reveals the algorithmic bottleneck: multi-owner repair induces a product lattice $M = \prod_j |\mathcal{A}_j|$. We therefore introduce CARVE-Q, a verifier-shielded quantum-AI search layer that applies quantum minimum finding only to this black-box lattice while leaving all safety authority classical. In the conservative verifier-oracle model, exact classical minimum finding requires $Θ(M)$ queries in the worst case, whereas Durr-Hoyer/Grover minimum finding uses $O(\sqrt{M})$ oracle queries with high probability. We prove verifier-shielded certificate soundness, priority non-elicitation, black-box query separation, and finite-precision reversible-oracle constructibility. We then demonstrate state-vector minimum finding on CARVE repair oracles up to 65,536 assignments and validate certificate preservation on Lanelet2-grounded INTERACTION replay with 100% right-of-way respect, 100% blame consistency, and zero priority false positives. The result is a trust-bounded quantum-AI pattern for certified autonomy: quantum proposes; CARVE certifies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARVE和CARVE-Q架构，通过经典证书系统保证驾驶否决后的合规修复，并用量子最小查找算法加速多车协商的修复格子搜索，实现“量子提议、CARVE认证”的可信自主驾驶模式。
AI.motivation: 驾驶否决后，仅判断操作是否不安全不够，还需要一个合法、可审计、责任有界的修复方案。现有预测和博弈规划器无法提供形式化保证。
AI.method: 构建可修复格（repair lattice）生成结构化证书，记录绑定规则、联合修复方案、路权缩放协作包络、责任加权成本分配及仅自车回退方案。针对多车修复的乘积格复杂度问题，引入CARVE-Q，用量子最小查找（Durr-Hoyer/Grover）在黑盒格子上实现平方级加速，所有安全权威保持经典。
AI.result: 理论上证明了证书可靠性、优先级非泄漏、黑盒查询分离和有限精度可逆预言机构造性。实验在65,536个赋值的格上完成状态向量最小查找，在Lanelet2的INTERACTION重放中实现100%路权尊重、100%过错一致性和零优先级误报。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种信任有界的量子-AI模式——量子提议、CARVE认证，为认证自主驾驶提供了可验证的修复框架。

title: Does Topic Sentiment Cause Perceived Ideology? Comparing Human and LLM Annotations in Political News Articles
summary: We ask whether topic sentiment has a causal effect on perceived political ideology, and whether the answer depends on who assigns the ideology label. Using articles from AllSides, paired with shared sentiment annotations from Llama-3.3-70b-versatile, we compare ideology labels from expert human annotators, GPT-4o-mini (baseline and finetuned), and Llama-3.3-70B. We apply Double Machine Learning (DML) and community-level mediation analysis across all four annotation paradigms. Human annotations yield no significant causal effects at the community level. Fine-tuned GPT-4o-mini achieves the highest classification accuracy (F1=72.48) and is the only annotator paradigm that produces significant community-level treatment effects and significant natural direct effects (NDEs) in mediation. We interpret this as evidence of shortcut learning: fine-tuning on ideology-labeled data causes the model to internalise a spurious sentiment--ideology coupling not operative in human judgment for this task. This coupling is structurally invisible to F1-based evaluation, with implications for the use of LLM annotations as silver labels and as proxies for human judgment in downstream causal analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究话题情感是否对感知政治意识形态有因果影响，发现微调后的GPT-4o-mini虽分类准确率最高（F1=72.48），但产生了人类标注中不存在的情感-意识形态虚假耦合，揭示了LLM标注在因果分析中的潜在偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 探究话题情感对政治意识形态感知的因果关系，并比较不同标注者（人类专家、GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B）在这一因果效应上的差异。
AI.method: 使用AllSides文章及Llama-3.3-70b-versatile情感标注，通过双机器学习（DML）和社区级中介分析，比较四种标注范式下的因果效应。
AI.result: 人类标注无显著因果效应；微调GPT-4o-mini分类准确率最高且产生显著因果效应和自然直接效应；其他LLM未产生显著效应。
AI.conclusion: 微调LLM学习到了虚假的情感-意识形态耦合（捷径学习），这种偏差在F1评估中不可见，警示LLM标注不能简单替代人类判断用于因果分析。

title: Inside the Visual Mind: Neuroscience-Motivated Concept Circuits for Interpreting and Steering Vision Transformers
comment: In Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026. (acceptance rate 26.6%)
summary: Despite high accuracy, Vision Transformer (ViT) predictions can be driven by spurious cues, raising the need to understand their inner workings before safe deployment. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising lens for decomposing model representations into human-interpretable concepts, yet adapting SAE-based interpretation to ViTs remains challenging due to limited control over concept coverage and subjective, non-scalable feature interpretation. To fill the gaps, motivated by neuroscience-inspired principles, we propose ViSAE, a mechanistic interpretability toolbox for understanding ViT inner workings through concept circuits. ViSAE consists of three components: (1) A probing suite with 64K images and a 16K visually grounded concept vocabulary, improving concept coverage efficiency by 20x over ImageNet and interpretation accuracy by 28.7% over existing concept sets. (2) Top-down concept reading and Bottom-up circuit tracing algorithms that automatically recover ViT inner workings via concept circuits. (3) Applications for auditing and steering ViT behavior. Through concept editing, ViSAE improves the worst-group accuracy on WaterBirds by 48.2%, outperforming existing methods by 23.8%. Our data and code: https://github.com/deep-real/ViSAE.

AI.tldr: ViSAE是一个基于稀疏自编码器的视觉Transformer可解释性工具箱，通过概念电路机制自动解读ViT内部工作原理，并在WaterBirds任务上将最差组准确率提升48.2%。
AI.motivation: ViT预测可能受虚假线索驱动，现有SAE方法在概念覆盖率和特征解释可扩展性方面存在不足，需要更系统化的可解释性工具。
AI.method: 提出ViSAE框架，包含三个组件：(1) 64K图像+16K视觉概念词汇的探测套件；(2) 自上而下概念读取与自下而上电路追踪算法；(3) 审计与引导ViT行为的概念编辑应用。
AI.result: 概念覆盖效率提升20倍（相较于ImageNet），解释准确率提升28.7%；在WaterBirds上最差组准确率提升48.2%，超过现有方法23.8%。
AI.conclusion: ViSAE通过构建概念电路有效解读ViT内部机制，为模型审计和行为引导提供了可扩展的工具。

title: Position: Don't Just "Fix it in Post": A Science of AI Must Study Training Dynamics
comment: Accepted as an oral to the ICML: https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/67142
summary: What would it mean to have a scientific understanding of AI? Models are not static objects: they are snapshots of time-evolving processes shaped by data, objectives, architectures, and optimization dynamics. Yet much of AI research treats models as fixed artifacts, analyzing behaviors after training rather than asking why they emerge. This position paper argues that a science of AI must move beyond post-hoc fixes and study the training dynamics that produce model behavior. Such a science should support progressively stronger forms of understanding: predicting outcomes from early training signals, intervening when trajectories go wrong, and ultimately designing training procedures that more reliably produce desired properties. Scaling laws have made prediction routine for loss; the challenge is extending this success to capabilities, biases, robustness, and safety-relevant behaviors. We articulate requirements for such theories grounded in the history and philosophy of science, examine progress in mechanistic interpretability, fairness, memorization, and simplicity bias, and identify concrete open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文主张AI科学必须超越对训练后模型的静态分析，转向研究产生模型行为的训练动态过程，以支持预测、干预和设计更可靠的训练流程。
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究大多将模型视为固定产物，只分析训练后的行为，而非探究这些行为为何涌现。这种静态视角限制了我们对AI的深层理解。
AI.method: 从科学哲学出发，提出理解AI的三个递进层次（预测、干预、设计），并审视可解释性、公平性、记忆化、简单性偏差等领域的现有进展。
AI.result: 指出缩放定律已成功预测损失，但扩展到能力、偏见、鲁棒性和安全相关行为的预测仍是挑战；识别出具体的开放性难题。
AI.conclusion: AI科学需要建立能够理解训练动态的理论框架，而非仅靠事后修补，从而更可靠地设计出期望的模型属性。

title: Modular Monolingual Adaptation using Pretrained Language Models
summary: Building monolingual language models (LMs) for low-resource languages typically relies on adapting pretrained language models (PLMs) by finetuning the whole model on the target language. This approach is widely favored over training from scratch, as it enables effective knowledge transfer. Additionally, prior work has shown that using a language-specific tokenizer can enhance the adaptability. In this work, we hypothesize that full model tuning is often unnecessary and propose a more modular approach. Specifically, we replace the tokens, freeze the corresponding embeddings, and tune the rest of the model. We use Scottish Gaelic, Irish, and Quechua for our experiments, with Quechua being a very low-resource language (8.5k training instances). Evaluation on natural language understanding (NLU) tasks -- mask filling, NER, and POS -- shows that our proposed approach improves performance when adapting models to low-resource languages. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive analysis of the effectiveness of training strategies, the choice of pretrained embeddings, and models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模块化方法，通过替换token、冻结对应嵌入并微调模型其余部分，在低资源语言上优于全模型微调。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言构建单语语言模型通常需要全模型微调预训练语言模型，但全模型微调可能并非必要，希望探索更高效的模块化适配方法。
AI.method: 替换目标语言的token，冻结对应的嵌入层，只微调模型其余部分（而非全模型微调）。在苏格兰盖尔语、爱尔兰语和克丘亚语上进行实验。
AI.result: 在掩码填充、NER和POS等NLU任务上，所提方法在低资源语言上优于全模型微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 全模型微调对低资源语言适配并非必要，模块化方法更高效且效果更好；同时分析了训练策略、预训练嵌入选择和模型的影响。

title: Architecture-Adaptive Uncertainty Fusion for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detection systems achieve near-perfect accuracy on benchmarks, yet forensic deployment demands reliable prediction uncertainty. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods rely on single sources and ignore that optimal uncertainty composition varies across architectures. We propose Correlation-Optimized Fusion (COF), an architecture-adaptive framework that fuses five complementary uncertainty sources -- epistemic, aleatoric, calibration, conformal, and distributional -- by maximizing Pearson correlation between fused uncertainty scores and prediction errors via constrained optimization on the probability simplex. COF requires no model modifications and only 42 s of weight optimization, compared to 20--45 h for a 5-model Deep Ensemble. Evaluation across eleven architectures on FaceForensics++ reveals a fundamental trade-off: under matched train/evaluation protocol, non-linear methods achieve approximately 5--6% higher in-domain correlation than COF (mean r = 0.438), but this reverses under distribution shift. On CelebDF, COF outperforms Random Forest in 9/11 architectures with up to 7.3x higher correlation (MaxViT-B: r = 0.249 vs. 0.034); RF degrades 85% cross-domain to r = 0.071, whereas COF retains substantially more signal (74% drop to r = 0.116). Cross-dataset evaluation on CelebDF and DFDC reveals catastrophic generalization failure across all methods: in-domain correlations of 0.41--0.47 collapse to near-zero externally (mean degradation 90.7%), with seven of eleven architectures exhibiting uncertainty inversion. These results establish COF as a practical, interpretable framework for controlled-distribution deployment and identify domain-adaptive UQ as the central open challenge for forensic deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出相关性优化融合（COF）框架，通过最大化融合不确定度评分与预测误差的皮尔逊相关，自适应融合五种不确定度来源，在分布偏移下表现优于传统方法，但跨数据集评估揭示灾难性泛化失败。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测系统在基准上准确率接近完美，但实际取证部署需要可靠的预测不确定度；现有不确定度量化的方法依赖单一来源，且忽略了最优不确定度组合因架构而异。
AI.method: 提出COF框架，融合认知、偶然、校准、共形和分布五种互补不确定度来源，通过在概率单纯形上最大化融合不确定度与预测误差的皮尔逊相关进行约束优化，无需修改模型，权重优化仅需42秒。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics++上，匹配训练/评估协议下非线性方法域内相关性（r=0.438）优于COF约5-6%；分布偏移下COF在9/11架构上优于随机森林（最高7.3倍）；跨数据集评估所有方法相关性从0.41-0.47骤降至接近零（平均降幅90.7%），11个架构中7个出现不确定度反转。
AI.conclusion: COF是一种实用、可解释的框架，适用于受控分布部署；跨数据集灾难性泛化失败揭示了域自适应不确定度量化的开放性挑战。

title: Accelerated Fourier SAT (AFSAT): Fully Realising a GPU-based Symmetric Pseudo-Boolean SAT Solver
summary: We present Accelerated Fourier SAT (AFSAT), a GPU-accelerated solver for pseudo-Boolean satisfiability based on continuous local search (CLS). AFSAT realises the proof-of-concept approach, FastFourierSAT, into a fully-engineered solver supporting any heterogeneous mixture of symmetric constraint types and lengths within a single problem instance. Using the JAX compiler, AFSAT leverages pure function composition, automatic vectorisation, automatic differentiation, and just-in-time (JIT) compilation to perform massively parallel CLS across batches of candidate assignments. We demonstrate substantially improved numerical stability, runtime performance, and memory efficiency over the proof-of-concept. We achieve this by way of identifying and addressing various limitations that arise from memory latency and floating-point representation, as well as leveraging automatic parallelisation and compact representations. The inherent representational and stability limitations of floating point are partially addressed by a tailored discrete Fourier transform implementation. We achieve near-linear throughput when scaling to multiple accelerators via JAX array sharding.

AI.tldr: 提出AFSAT，一个基于GPU加速的伪布尔可满足性求解器，利用JAX编译器实现大规模并行连续局部搜索，相比原型方法在数值稳定性、运行性能和内存效率上有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 将FastFourierSAT这一概念验证方法工程化为一个成熟的求解器，支持异构混合的对称约束类型和长度，解决原方法在数值稳定性、运行性能和内存效率方面的局限。
AI.method: 基于JAX编译器，利用纯函数组合、自动向量化、自动微分和JIT编译，实现跨候分配置批量的大规模并行连续局部搜索；通过定制离散傅里叶变换解决浮点数表示和稳定性问题；利用JAX数组分片实现多加速器近线性扩展。
AI.result: 相比概念验证方法，数值稳定性、运行性能和内存效率显著提升；多加速器扩展时实现近线性吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别并解决内存延迟、浮点表示等限制，以及利用自动并行化和紧凑表示，成功将概念验证方法工程化为高性能求解器。

title: When to Think Deeply: Inhibitory Deliberation for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reasoning Large Language Models can improve problem-solving performance through deliberative inference, but invoking slow reasoning for every input is computationally expensive and often unnecessary. We propose IDPR, a framework for response-conditioned inhibitory deliberation. IDPR first generates a concise intuitive answer and then uses an inhibition controller to decide whether that specific response should be released or suppressed in favor of slow reasoning. Unlike input-only routers, the inhibition controller conditions on the fast answer and fast-side evidence, including confidence, logit margin, parseability, and generation cost. We train the controller from paired fast-slow outcomes and select the inhibition threshold on a held-out validation set under an accuracy-first slow-call budget. On a held-out 5,000-example mathematical reasoning test set, IDPR invokes slow reasoning on only 8.20% of examples and improves accuracy from 47.90% to 48.92%. Under the same slow-call budget, random routing decreases accuracy to 46.76%, while the strongest confidence-based baseline reaches 48.22%. IDPR also achieves the highest corrective precision, showing that response-conditioned inhibition better identifies fast answers that benefit from slow reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出IDPR框架，通过响应条件抑制延迟推理，在仅调用8.20%慢推理的情况下将准确率从47.90%提升至48.92%，优于随机路由和基于置信度的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的慢速推理计算成本高且并非所有输入都需要，现有路由方法仅基于输入特征判断，忽略了快速响应本身是否真正需要慢速修正。
AI.method: 首先生成简洁的直觉答案，然后通过抑制控制器基于快速答案的特征（置信度、logit边际、可解析性、生成成本）决定是否抑制并触发慢推理，控制器从配对的快慢结果中训练。
AI.result: 在5000例数学推理测试集上，仅调用8.20%慢推理即提升准确率至48.92%（基线47.90%），优于随机路由（46.76%）和最强置信度基线（48.22%），且纠正精度最高。
AI.conclusion: 响应条件抑制能更精准地识别哪些快速答案需要慢推理修正，在计算预算约束下实现准确率与效率的更好平衡。

title: JA-SIREN: Deterministic Initialization for Sinusoidal Networks via Spectral Matching
summary: Existing implicit neural representation (INR) approaches suffer from stochastic initialization that does not guarantee consistent or high-quality performance across runs, with variations reaching more than 2.5 dB (78%) in image regression. This variation is problematic for scientific computing and simulation, where result reproducibility is crucial. To address this problem, we present Jacobi-Anger Sinusoidal Representation Network (JA-SIREN), a deterministic initialization scheme for sinusoidal networks grounded in classical spectral analysis. By computing the Discrete Sine Transform (DST) of the target signal and leveraging the Jacobi-Anger expansion, we derive closed-form weights for a two-layer sinusoidal MLP that analytically match the network's initial spectral response to the target signal, requiring no random seed or additional hyperparameter tuning. On the Kodak dataset, JA-SIREN achieves a mean PSNR of 67.18 dB, a 21.30 dB improvement over the best baseline. This is achieved with zero run-to-run variance, confirming that spectrally-informed initialization is a more effective and reproducible alternative to stochastic initialization for sinusoidal INRs.

AI.tldr: 提出JA-SIREN，一种基于Jacobi-Anger展开和离散正弦变换的确定性子初始化方案，用于隐式神经表示中的正弦网络，消除了随机初始化带来的性能波动，在Kodak数据集上实现了零方差且PSNR高达67.18 dB的卓越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经表示方法因随机初始化导致性能波动大（超过2.5 dB，78%的差异），严重影响科学计算和仿真中的结果可重复性。
AI.method: 通过计算目标信号的离散正弦变换（DST），结合Jacobi-Anger展开，推导出两层正弦MLP的闭式权重，使网络的初始频谱响应与目标信号解析匹配，无需随机种子或额外超参数调优。
AI.result: 在Kodak数据集上，JA-SIREN平均PSNR达到67.18 dB，比最佳基线提升21.30 dB，且运行间方差为零。
AI.conclusion: 基于频谱信息的确定性子初始化比随机初始化更有效且更具可重复性，是正弦INR的更优方案。

title: A Study of Parallel Continuous Local Search
summary: We study parallel Continuous Local Search (CLS) as a solution approach for Boolean satisfiability problems with symmetric pseudo-Boolean (PB) constraints. Here, the $n$-variable PB-satisfiability problem is relaxed to a continuous optimisation problem with a differentiable objective function on an $n$-dimensional hypercube. For satisfiable instances, the global minimisers of this optimisation problem correspond to satisfying assignments of the SAT problem at hand. We present several novel findings via empirical experiments: (i) redundant constraints can inhibit rather than accelerate convergence; (ii) CLS shows promise as a sub-solver in hybridised settings, quickly completing partial assignments; and (iii) local search rapidly converges to a stable distribution of solution quality (i.e., degree of satisfaction), due to saddle-dense objectives where additional solver steps yield diminishing returns. Our findings inform practical uses of CLS for SAT on modern accelerator hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了并行连续局部搜索（CLS）在对称伪布尔约束的可满足性问题中的应用，通过连续优化求解SAT问题，并发现了冗余约束的抑制效应、作为子求解器的潜力以及局部搜索的快速收敛特性。
AI.motivation: 探索并行连续局部搜索（CLS）作为求解布尔可满足性问题（尤其是含对称伪布尔约束的SAT问题）的新方法，填补CLS在SAT领域系统实证研究的空白。
AI.method: 将n变量PB可满足性问题松弛为n维超立方体上的连续优化问题（可微目标函数），通过并行CLS进行求解，并在经验实验中对比分析冗余约束、混合求解设置及解质量分布等特性。
AI.result: (i) 冗余约束反而会抑制而非加速收敛；(ii) CLS在混合求解中作为子求解器有潜力，能快速完成部分赋值；(iii) 由于鞍点密集的目标函数，局部搜索快速收敛到解质量的稳定分布，后续步骤收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为CLS在现代加速硬件上用于SAT问题提供了实践指导，揭示了其收敛特性与适用场景。

title: Evidence Graph Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Model-Dependent Analysis of Hallucination Detection
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Advanced Machine Learning and Data Science; to appear in the IEEE Xplore proceedings
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reduces but does not eliminate hallucination in large language models. Existing detection methods rely on flat similarity between generated answers and retrieved passages, ignoring structural relationships among evidence pieces and answer claims. We propose Evidence Graph Consistency (EGC), a framework that constructs a local evidence graph per response and computes five structural consistency measures as hallucination indicators. Evaluated on the full question answering split of RAGTruth across six LLMs (5,767 responses), EGC reveals a consistent model-family split: graph consistency features show the expected diagnostic direction for hallucinations in Llama-2 models but exhibit systematic reversal in GPT-4, GPT-3.5, and Mistral-7B. This reversal suggests qualitatively different hallucination patterns across model families and indicates that embedding-based graph consistency cannot serve as a model-independent hallucination detection signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出证据图一致性（EGC）框架，通过构建局部证据图并计算五种结构一致性指标来检测RAG中的幻觉。实验发现，该指标在不同模型家族中表现不一致：在Llama-2中有效，但在GPT-4、GPT-3.5和Mistral-7B中呈系统性反转，表明基于嵌入的图一致性不能作为模型无关的幻觉检测信号。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG幻觉检测方法仅依赖生成答案与检索段落之间的平面相似度，忽略了证据片段与答案声明之间的结构关系。
AI.method: 构建每个回答的局部证据图，计算五种结构一致性度量作为幻觉指标。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth的完整问答集上（6个LLM，5,767个回答）评估，发现EGC特征在不同模型家族中表现出系统性反转：对Llama-2有效，但对GPT-4、GPT-3.5和Mistral-7B呈反转方向。
AI.conclusion: 基于嵌入的图一致性不能作为模型无关的幻觉检测信号，不同模型家族可能存在性质不同的幻觉模式。

title: Adaptive Band Selection for Hyperspectral Classification with Spatially Disjoint Evaluation
summary: Hyperspectral band selection methods based on differentiable selectors can be sensitive to initialization and to extracting a final discrete subset, while prescribed band counts limit flexibility. We propose SGBR-HC (Spectral-Group Band Ranking with Hard-Concrete initialization), a two-stage method that uses a supervised spectral ranking to initialize trainable sparse gates rather than treating ranking as a fixed selection rule, letting the number of selected bands be determined by training. Stage-1 scores candidate bands from training pixels by class discriminability and spectral diversity; this ranking seeds the gate logits for Stage-2, which trains the sparse gates jointly with a spatial classifier. Under spatially disjoint evaluation on Pavia University and Houston 2013, verified by retraining a fresh classifier on the selected bands, SGBR-HC achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and Cohen's kappa with approximately twenty bands. Bypassing Stage-1 degrades OA by 8.84 pp on Pavia University and 22.15 pp on Houston 2013, confirming the ranking prior's role. Random pixel splits inflate OA on Pavia University by 30.56 pp, underscoring spatial leakage as a critical evaluation confound.

AI.tldr: 提出SGBR-HC两阶段高光谱波段选择方法，通过监督谱排名初始化可训练稀疏门控，在空间解耦评估下用约20个波段达到最高分类精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可微选择器的高光谱波段选择方法对初始化敏感、最终离散子集提取困难，且预设波段数量缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：Stage-1基于类判别性和谱多样性对候选波段进行监督排名；Stage-2用该排名初始化门控logits，与空间分类器联合训练稀疏门控，自动确定波段数量。
AI.result: 在Pavia University和Houston 2013数据集上，空间解耦评估下用约20个波段取得最高平均总体精度和Cohen's kappa。跳过Stage-1导致OA下降8.84~22.15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 监督谱排名初始化对性能至关重要，随机像素划分会因空间泄漏严重高估精度（高达30.56个百分点），需采用空间解耦评估。

title: AEGIS: A Backup Reflex for Physical AI
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation tends to fail gradually: one bad step degrades the state, and the policy spirals into a basin from which it cannot recover. The failure is often visible before it happens. We introduce AEGIS (Activation-probe Early-warning, Gated Inference Switching), a selective escalation method that uses a lightweight probe on a weak policy's frozen activations to detect high-risk steps while there is still time to act. When the probe flags a step, control switches to a stronger separate policy, but only for the steps that need it. On LIBERO-Spatial, AEGIS recovers 10.1% of the trajectories the weak policy alone loses, versus 4.6% for budget-matched blind escalation and 5.1% for a random-trigger placebo. These gains are significant under one-sided exact paired McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni adjustment over three pre-registered contrasts: +5.4pp over blind escalation, p=8.5e-6; +5.0pp over random triggering, p=1.0e-4; paired-trajectory bootstrap CIs exclude zero. AEGIS activates the stronger policy on only 38% of steps, so the lever is timing rather than compute. The probe clears its precondition with an early-window AUROC of 0.764, 95% CI [0.70, 0.84], read from the weak-policy path over the first 30% of trajectory steps before any handoff. We pre-register the full analysis plan, including a conditional recovered-task-rate estimand and explicit kill criteria, and confirm the result on 700 common-random-number episodes per arm, with nA-fail=646.

AI.tldr: AEGIS是一种选择性升级方法，通过轻量级探针检测弱策略的高风险步骤，仅在必要时切换到强策略，在LIBERO-Spatial任务中恢复了弱策略损失的10.1%轨迹，且仅激活38%的步骤。
AI.motivation: 长视野机器人操作任务中，策略往往逐步失败——一个坏步骤使状态恶化，策略陷入不可恢复的困境，而失败在发生前通常已有征兆。作者希望提前检测高风险步骤并及时干预。
AI.method: AEGIS在弱策略的冻结激活上附加轻量级探针，检测高风险步骤；当探针触发时，将控制权切换到更强的独立策略，但仅在需要时切换。使用了预注册分析计划、条件恢复任务率估计量和明确终止标准。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Spatial上，AEGIS恢复10.1%的轨迹（盲升级4.6%，随机触发5.1%）；+5.4pp优于盲升级（p=8.5e-6），+5.0pp优于随机触发（p=1.0e-4）；仅38%的步骤激活强策略；早期窗口AUROC为0.764，95% CI [0.70, 0.84]。
AI.conclusion: AEGIS通过时序选择而非计算量提升效率，证明了轻量级探针在长视野机器人操作中提前检测失败并选择性干预的有效性，统计结果显著且稳健。

title: PromptPrint: Behavioral Biometrics Through Natural Language Prompting in LLMs
summary: Authorship attribution research has traditionally focused on long-form, expressive texts; however, interactions with large language models (LLMs) are typically brief and task-driven prompts. This raises a fundamental question: do such prompts contain a stable, author-identifiable, and distinctive signal? We introduce PromptPrint, a systematic study of prompt-based identity, the hypothesis that a user's habitual vocabulary, syntax, and discourse patterns form a learnable behavioral biometric. Using 20,680 real prompts from 1,034 users, we establish three key findings. First, lexical representations significantly outperform semantic encoders, supporting the "lexical stability hypothesis": identity is primarily encoded in surface-level word choice rather than abstract intent. Second, stylometric features exhibit a "uniqueness-consistency paradox": users are highly distinctive across the population, yet behaviorally inconsistent across contexts. Third, adversarial analysis reveals a clear vulnerability spectrum: identity signals are robust to minor lexical perturbations but degrade substantially under semantic paraphrasing. Overall, our results demonstrate strong identification performance at scale, establishing prompt-based identity as a viable behavioral biometric. This work introduces a new perspective on user modeling in LLM interactions, with important implications for security and privacy. Data and code will be released upon the acceptance of our work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PromptPrint概念，证明用户在LLM交互中的提示语包含可识别的身份特征，基于词汇选择而非语义，具有唯一性但存在一致性悖论，对细微扰动鲁棒但对语义改写脆弱。
AI.motivation: 传统作者归因研究针对长文本，而LLM交互多为简短任务型提示，作者身份信号是否存在尚不明确。
AI.method: 收集20,680条来自1,034名用户的真实提示，通过词汇表示、语义编码、风格特征分析及对抗攻击等方法进行系统性研究。
AI.result: 词汇表示优于语义编码；用户具有高区分度但行为一致性低；身份信号对词汇扰动鲁棒但对语义改写敏感。
AI.conclusion: 提示语身份是一种可行的行为生物特征，对LLM交互中的用户建模、安全与隐私有重要启示。

title: A Geometric Account of Activation Steering through Angle-Norm Decomposition
summary: Linear activation steering has gained popularity as a simple and empirically effective way to control language model behavior. More recently, spherical steering paradigms have been proposed to address limitations of additive interventions, often motivated by the assumption that hidden-state norm does not carry concept-relevant information. In this work, we revisit this assumption through a controlled empirical study designed to disentangle the roles of angular and radial components. We show that steering methods differ mainly in how they couple two geometric effects: changing a token's angular alignment with a concept direction and changing its hidden-state norm. Across seven language models, we find that concepts are represented primarily in angular structure, supporting the motivation for spherical methods, but that norm remains important for the stability and downstream effects of steering. Our results explain why interventions with similar concept-level effects can behave differently, and suggest that activation steering should be parameterized by interpretable angular and radial components of the intervention, rather than by a single additive coefficient that entangles these two effects.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验发现，语言模型中的概念主要编码在隐藏状态的角向结构中，但范数对干预的稳定性和下游效果依然重要，建议将激活操控分解为可解释的角向和径向分量。
AI.motivation: 线性和球形激活操控方法存在差异，球形方法假设隐藏状态范数不携带概念相关信息，但这一假设缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 设计控制实验，将角向和径向分量解耦，在7个语言模型上系统比较不同操控方法的几何效应。
AI.result: 概念主要表征于角向结构，支持球形方法的动机；但范数对稳定性和下游效果仍重要；不同方法的差异源于角向和径向效应的耦合方式不同。
AI.conclusion: 激活操控应参数化为可解释的角向和径向分量，而非单一加性系数，以更好地理解和控制模型行为。

title: A Four-Condition Diagnostic Protocol for Evidence Utilization in Long-Context and Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: Final-answer accuracy, retrieval recall, and citation overlap do not by themselves identify whether a long-context or retrieval-augmented language model used the evidence it was given. A model can answer from parametric memory, fail despite receiving the right passages, or cite evidence without converting it into the requested answer. This paper proposes a matched four-condition evidence-availability protocol--no evidence, full context, retrieved evidence, and oracle-evidence reference--for diagnosing evidence utilization under fixed examples, prompts, score fields, retrieval settings, and validity checks. ONCU is used as a protocol-bound estimator of recovered oracle-reference evidence advantage and is computed only for denominator-valid groups; denominator-free answer, evidence, retrieval, and failure-audit metrics are reported separately. The empirical study evaluates five local open-weight models from the Qwen, Gemma, Llama, and Mistral families across Controlled-ONCU-safe16K, HotpotQA-ONCU, and 2WikiMultiHopQA-ONCU, with 18,000 ONCU-compatible predictions. The main finding is a task-dependent bottleneck split: controlled synthetic settings primarily expose full-context utilization failures, whereas the tested realistic multi-hop settings primarily expose retrieval-chain coverage failures in denominator-free answer and evidence metrics, with ONCU supporting the same direction on oracle-improving groups. The contribution is a diagnostic protocol for separating no-evidence answerability, oracle-evidence recoverability, full-context utilization, and retrieval-conditioned utilization, rather than a single-score leaderboard for long-context or retrieval-augmented systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种四条件证据可用性协议（无证据、完整上下文、检索证据、Oracle证据），用于诊断长上下文或检索增强语言模型是否真正利用了提供的证据，并通过ONCU估计器量化证据利用效果。实验在5个开源模型、3个数据集上进行，发现任务瓶颈存在于全上下文利用失败（合成设置）或检索链覆盖失败（真实多跳设置）。
AI.motivation: 现有指标（如最终答案准确率、检索召回率、引用重叠）无法区分模型是依赖参数记忆还是真正利用了提供的证据，导致对模型行为的误解。
AI.method: 设计四条件证据可用性协议（无证据、完整上下文、检索证据、Oracle证据），结合ONCU估计器量化Oracle证据恢复优势，并分别报告无分母的答案、证据、检索和失败审计指标。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Gemma、Llama、Mistral等5个模型上评估18,000个预测，发现合成设置主要暴露全上下文利用失败，真实多跳设置主要暴露检索链覆盖失败。
AI.conclusion: 该协议提供了诊断性分析框架，用于分离无证据可回答性、Oracle证据可恢复性、全上下文利用和检索条件利用，而非单一的排行榜分数。

title: RPC-GS: Gaussian Splatting with native RPC Rendering for Satellite Imagery
summary: We present RPC-GS, the first Gaussian Splatting framework for satellite imagery that operates natively with Rational Polynomial Camera (RPC) models. The RPC model is the de facto standard for representing the complex imaging geometry of modern pushbroom satellite sensors. To simplify rendering, prior satellite Gaussian Splatting methods replace the RPC model with perspective or affine camera approximations, leading to geometric errors during reconstruction. RPC-GS avoids these approximations by projecting Gaussian means and covariances directly through the RPC model during the splatting process. We embed the RPC model in a chain of carefully selected geo-coordinate transformations representing a mapping from splatting-suitable scene coordinates to image coordinates. To map the Gaussian covariance matrices, we derive a numerically robust Jacobian-based covariance projection for the (partially nonlinear) coordinate transformations. Since RPCs lack an explicit notion of camera depth, we integrate a metric ray-based depth formulation. We benchmark RPC, perspective, and affine camera models in a unified framework, with our native RPC renderer consistently achieving the lowest reconstruction error on leading satellite benchmark datasets, improving mean altitude error over perspective and affine approximations by 29.6% and 63.8% on DFC2019, and by 9.9% and 37.9% on IARPA2016. We release our code to support future research of Gaussian Splatting in the satellite imaging domain.

AI.tldr: RPC-GS是首个原生支持RPC模型的卫星影像高斯泼溅框架，通过直接投影高斯参数到RPC模型，避免了近似替代带来的几何误差，在卫星基准数据集上取得了最优重建精度。
AI.motivation: 现有卫星高斯泼溅方法用透视或仿射相机近似替代RPC模型，导致重建中的几何误差。本文旨在避免这种近似，实现原生RPC模型下的高斯泼溅。
AI.method: 将高斯均值和协方差直接通过RPC模型投影，嵌入精心设计的地理坐标变换链；推导基于雅可比矩阵的数值稳健协方差投影方法；集成基于度量射线的深度公式。
AI.result: 在DFC2019上，平均高程误差相比透视和仿射近似分别降低29.6%和63.8%；在IARPA2016上分别降低9.9%和37.9%。
AI.conclusion: 原生RPC渲染器在统一框架下 consistently 取得最低重建误差，证明了该方法的有效性，并开源代码以推动卫星影像领域的高斯泼溅研究。

title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures and 8 tables. Code is avalable at https://github.com/OpenLAIR/OpenSkill
summary: Self-evolving agents requires adaptation after deployment, but existing approaches assume a usable learning loop, such as curated skills, successful trajectories, or verifier signals. Real open-world deployments may provide none of these, offering only a task prompt. In this work, we study open-world self-evolution, where an agent must build both its skills and its own verification signals from scratch, using open-world resources but no target-task supervision. We propose OpenSkill, a framework that bootstraps this loop: it acquires grounded knowledge and verification anchors from documentation, repositories, and the web, synthesizes them into transferable skills, and refines those skills against self-built virtual tasks grounded in the anchors rather than in target answers. The open world thus supplies both the knowledge to be learned and a supervision-independent practice environment, with target-task supervision reserved for final evaluation. Across three benchmarks and two target agents, OpenSkill attains the best automated pass rate while satisfying the no-supervision constraint. Analysis shows its skills transfer across models without model-specific adaptation, and its self-built verifier aligns with ground-truth outcomes despite never accessing them.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenSkill框架，让智能体在无目标任务监督的情况下，仅通过开放世界资源（文档、代码库、网页）自建技能和验证信号，实现自我进化。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化方法依赖可用学习回路（如精选技能、成功轨迹或验证器信号），但真实开放世界部署中这些往往缺失，仅提供任务提示。
AI.method: 从开放世界资源中获取基础知识与验证锚点，综合为可迁移技能；基于自建虚拟任务（以锚点而非目标答案为基础）优化技能，形成无监督的自主进化循环。
AI.result: 在三个基准和两个目标智能体上，在满足无监督约束的前提下取得了最佳自动化通过率；技能可跨模型迁移，自建验证器与真实结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 证明了在无目标任务监督条件下，仅利用开放世界资源即可实现智能体的有效自我进化与技能构建。

title: When Better Codebooks Are Not Enough: Predictive Performance and Behavioral Reliability in LLM Political Event Coding
summary:
High accuracy does not necessarily make an LLM a faithful coder. This issue matters because many social-science studies rely on expert-written codebooks to turn text into structured data. We study this problem in political event coding, a challenging source-target relation classification task beyond ordinary sentence-level classification, where models must determine what one actor did to another using detailed coding rules.
  We test whether expert codebooks become more effective when operationalized into LLM-friendly forms with clearer definitions, examples, retrieved context, and rules for difficult cases. We then evaluate behavioral reliability under controlled changes to label names, codebook order, and label-definition mappings. Clearer codebooks substantially improve classification performance, especially for fine-grained event classification. However, these predictive gains do not fully translate into behavioral reliability. Models may produce valid labels and recover definitions while still failing behavioral reliability tests under controlled codebook changes.
  These findings suggest that codebook-guided LLM systems should be evaluated not only by accuracy, but also by whether they preserve the coding logic that makes coded outputs meaningful for social-science research.

AI.tldr: 专家编写的代码手册虽然能提升LLM在政治事件编码任务上的分类准确率，但模型仍缺乏行为可靠性——在标签名称、代码顺序等受控变化下会偏离原编码逻辑。
AI.motivation: 高准确率并不等同于忠实编码，尤其在社会科学研究中，依赖专家代码手册将文本转化为结构化数据，但LLM的行为可靠性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 将专家代码手册转化为LLM友好的形式（更清晰的定义、示例、检索上下文、难点规则），然后在政治事件编码任务中测试分类性能，并评估标签名称、代码顺序、标签-定义映射等受控变化下的行为可靠性。
AI.result: 更清晰的代码手册显著提升了分类性能，尤其在细粒度分类上；但预测性能的提升并未完全转化为行为可靠性，模型在受控变化下仍会失效。
AI.conclusion: 代码手册引导的LLM系统不仅应评估准确率，还应评估其是否保留了编码逻辑，以确保输出的结构化数据对社会科学研究有意义。

title: AdMem: Advanced Memory for Task-solving Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise as tool-using agents but remain limited in long-horizon tasks that require remembering, organizing, and reusing knowledge. Prior memory approaches aim to resolve the situation, but mainly focus on storing factual information. Recent work on procedural memory improves task reuse, yet often reduces to replaying past successes without addressing failure cases or online scalability. We introduce a unified and automatic memory framework that integrates semantic, episodic, and procedural memory in a bi-level design combining short-term and long-term stores. A multi-agent architecture with actor, memory, and critic agents enables automatic memory generation, reward annotation, and adaptive retrieval. Long-term memory is managed through reward-based evaluation, merging, and pruning, ensuring scalability and continual improvement. Experiments across various environments show that our approach improves robustness and success on long multi-turn tasks compared to existing baselines. This work highlights the importance of comprehensive, adaptive memory for advancing LLM-based agents.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一且自动化的记忆框架，结合语义、情景和程序记忆，通过多智能体架构实现长期任务的鲁棒性和成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在长周期任务中缺乏有效的记忆、组织和复用知识的能力，而先前的记忆方法要么只关注事实存储，要么仅回放成功经验而忽视失败案例，缺乏可扩展性。
AI.method: 设计了一个包含短期和长期存储的双层记忆架构，融合语义、情景和程序三类记忆。采用多智能体系统（Actor、Memory、Critic）实现自动记忆生成、奖励标注和自适应检索，长期记忆通过基于奖励的评估、合并和剪枝机制进行管理。
AI.result: 在多种环境下，该方法在长多轮任务的鲁棒性和成功率上均优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 全面且自适应的记忆机制对于提升LLM智能体的能力至关重要，本工作为这一方向提供了有效框架。
