title: Explain Like I'm 5 or Whatever I Choose: Evaluating the Interactive Potential of Language Model Responses
summary: Evaluations of large language models (LLMs) in scientific information seeking tasks have become increasingly use-centric, such as conducting live or multi-turn evaluations with real users. These evaluations still assume a single, static chat interface, but as models are integrated into new interfaces, evaluations must shift to incorporate interface-specific criteria. We propose a new evaluation framework based on a formative study with $16$ participants that tests models' ability to generate multiple responses to one query that differ along an interpretable axis of language (language complexity), inspired by direct manipulation interfaces from human-centered design literature. We evaluate GPT-5.1, GPT-5 mini, Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Thinking, and DeepSeek-V3.1 by generating 5 responses at different levels of language complexity for $98$ scientific queries. While models vary complexity across responses, most changes remain inconsistent, with the best performing model (Claude Sonnet 4.5) only shifting reliable complexity measures in the correct direction $46\%$ of the time. Our findings hold with increased sample size and alternative complexity levels.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型在科学信息搜索任务中的评估，提出一种基于语言复杂度可解释轴的多响应生成评估框架，测试了4种模型在98个科学查询上的表现，发现即使最好模型也仅有46%的时间能正确调整复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仍假设单一静态聊天界面，但随着模型被集成到新界面中，评估需要纳入界面特定的标准。
AI.method: 基于16名参与者的形成性研究，设计评估框架，要求模型对同一查询生成5个不同语言复杂度的响应。测试GPT-5.1、GPT-5 mini、Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Thinking和DeepSeek-V3.1，使用98个科学查询。
AI.result: 模型能改变响应的复杂度，但变化大多不一致，最佳模型Claude Sonnet 4.5仅46%的时间能正确调整复杂度。增加样本量和替代复杂度水平后结果仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在沿可解释轴（如语言复杂度）生成多响应方面表现不足，需要新的评估框架来适应界面多样化的需求。

title: TA-RAG: Tone-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Peer-Support Health Communication
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) successfully grounds large language model (LLM) outputs in trusted documents, but factual grounding alone is insufficient for sensitive peer-support health communication. In domains such as HIV peer support, responses must also be accessible, stigma-free, empathetic, and tailored to the recipient. This paper presents TA-RAG, a lightweight, prompt-based tone-aware RAG framework that embeds explicit tone control into a RAG pipeline without requiring model fine-tuning. We operationalise tone across four core components: stigma-free rewriting, readability adjustment, recipient adaptation, and empathy rephrasing. We evaluate TA-RAG through component-level tests using questions derived from HIV Online Learning Australia (HOLA), UNAIDS terminology guidance, readability metrics, peer-support standards from National Association of People with HIV Australia (NAPWHA), and a public empathy dataset. Results show that the TA-RAG's components improve their targeted communication quality while preserving key content. These findings emphasise that prompt-based tone control is a potential direction for making RAG outputs suitable for sensitive peer-support health communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TA-RAG框架，通过提示词在RAG流程中嵌入语气控制（去污名化、可读性调整、受众适配、同理心改写），在不微调模型的情况下提升HIV同伴支持等敏感健康沟通场景的回复质量。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG虽能保证事实准确性，但在HIV同伴支持等敏感场景中，回复还需具备可访问性、无污名化、同理心和个性化，仅靠事实依据远远不够。
AI.method: 提出TA-RAG，一种轻量级、基于提示词的语气感知RAG框架，包含去污名化改写、可读性调整、受众适配、同理心改写四个核心组件，无需微调模型。
AI.result: 在HOLA、UNAIDS术语指南、NAPWHA同伴支持标准及同理心数据集上的测试表明，各组件在提升目标沟通质量的同时保留了关键内容。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示词的语气控制是让RAG输出适用于敏感同伴支持健康沟通的潜在方向。

title: Workflow-to-Skill: Skill Creation via Routing-Workflow-Semantics-Attachments Decomposition
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on Skills to encode procedural knowledge, yet high-quality Skills remain costly to hand-write. This paper studies automatic Skill construction from heterogeneous interaction evidence, including demonstrations, agent trajectories, tool traces, and execution logs. We argue that trace-to-skill construction is not simple summarization tasks, because traces are fragmented, redundant, and may miss rare but safety-critical behaviors. To address this, we introduce RWSA, a workflow-oriented intermediate representation that decomposes Skills into Workflow structure, execution Semantics, and runtime Attachments, capturing task decomposition, control flow, verification, safety, rollback, and state management. Building on RWSA, we propose W2S, a framework that segments traces, induces local Skill drafts, aligns shared structures, reconciles branches, and compresses redundancy while preserving evidence and confidence annotations. Experiments on 70 Skills show that W2S improves behavioral replay consistency by 10.5% over summarization- and prompting-based baselines, highlighting the need to treat traces as executable runtime specifications rather than compressible text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RWSA中间表示和W2S框架，用于从异构交互痕迹（如演示、轨迹、工具日志等）自动构建高质量技能，相比基线方法将行为回放一致性提升10.5%。
AI.motivation: 手工编写高质量技能成本高昂，而现有自动构建方法简单地将痕迹视为可压缩文本，忽略了痕迹碎片化、冗余且可能缺失罕见但关键的安全行为的特性。
AI.method: 提出RWSA（面向工作流的中间表示），将技能分解为工作流结构、执行语义和运行时附件。基于此构建W2S框架，通过痕迹分割、局部技能草稿归纳、共享结构对齐、分支调和、冗余压缩等步骤，同时保留证据和置信度标注。
AI.result: 在70个技能上的实验显示，W2S相比基于摘要和提示的基线方法，行为回放一致性提升10.5%。
AI.conclusion: 应将交互痕迹视为可执行的运行时规范而非可压缩的文本，才能有效构建高质量技能。

title: Anchored, Not Graded: Vision-Language Models Fail at Slant-from-Texture Perception
summary: Human perception of surface slant from texture exhibits systematic, graded biases that emerge reliably in psychophysical experiments. Prior work showed that unsupervised CNNs reproduce several human-like biases, while supervised CNNs do not. Do Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit similar competences? Across multiple VLM families and model scales, zero-shot and in-context prompting both produce distinctive failures: slant is predicted at only a small set of anchors (e.g., 0\degree, $\pm$25\degree, $\pm$45\degree) with little dependence on stimulus field of view, optical slant, or surface curvature. Supervised fine-tuning partially remediates the failure, but residual anchoring persists. While success in high-level vision-language benchmarks might not require sensitivity to low-level geometric cues, we interpret anchoring as a failure at the representation-to-output language interface: Not necessarily an absence of geometric encoding, but a failure to express it in a graded form.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，视觉语言模型（VLMs）在感知表面倾斜度时存在严重的"锚定"失败——只能预测少数离散角度（如0°、±25°、±45°），无法像人类或无监督CNN那样产生连续、渐变的感知偏差。即使通过微调也无法完全解决。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉语言模型（VLMs）是否能像无监督CNN那样复现人类对表面倾斜度的感知偏差，检验其低层次几何线索处理能力。
AI.method: 跨多个VLM家族和模型规模，使用零样本、上下文提示和监督微调三种方式进行表面倾斜度感知实验，并与人类心理物理实验及先前CNN研究结果对比。
AI.result: VLMs在所有提示方式下均表现不佳，预测集中在少数离散角度（锚点），对视野、光学倾斜度或曲面曲率等刺激参数几乎不敏感；监督微调仅部分缓解，但锚定现象仍持续存在。
AI.conclusion: VLMs未能像无监督CNN那样复现人类对表面倾斜度的连续感知偏差，失败根源在于表征到输出的语言接口层面——模型可能编码了几何信息，但无法以渐变方式表达出来。

title: Declarative Skills for AI Agents in Knowledge-Grounded Tool-Use Workflows
summary: We study orchestration mechanisms for tool-using AI agents in realistic customer-service workflows over an unstructured knowledge base. We argue that declarative agents -- AI agents equipped with natural-language skill files appended to the system prompt -- are an effective orchestration paradigm. Concretely, we compare (i) a DeclarativeAgent that reads three domain-specific skill files at inference time and decides its own control flow, (ii) an ImperativeAgent based on a programmatic state machine with explicit phases, and (iii) an unscaffolded baseline agent modeled after the $τ$-Knowledge benchmark agent. Our ImperativeAgent is motivated by externalised-control inference as in Recursive Language Models and graph-based orchestration frameworks. We formalise the three agents as policy classes within a decentralised partially-observable Markov decision process and analyse their information-theoretic and structural properties; we then test the predicted differences empirically on five language models and two retrieval regimes. Our results show that retrieval quality is a dominant bottleneck for AI agents: when evidence is incomplete or skewed, all agents degrade substantially, and skill files cannot recover lost performance. Under high-quality retrieval, however, declarative skills consistently improve accuracy on procedural tasks and reduce orchestration errors, while the imperative state machine's brittleness does not reliably improve task success or compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI工具使用代理在客户服务工作流中的编排机制，比较了声明式代理（DeclarativeAgent）、命令式代理（ImperativeAgent）和无框架基线代理。结果表明，检索质量是主要瓶颈；在高质量检索下，声明式技能能提升程序性任务准确率并减少编排错误，而命令式状态机则不够可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有AI工具使用代理在非结构化知识库上的客户服务工作流中缺乏有效的编排机制研究，特别是声明式与命令式范式的系统性对比不足，需要更严格的框架来分析和比较不同编排策略的效果。
AI.method: 将三种代理形式化为分散部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP）中的策略类，分析其信息论和结构特性，并在五种语言模型和两种检索机制下进行实证测试。
AI.result: 检索质量是主要瓶颈；低质量检索下所有代理性能均下降且技能文件无法恢复损失。高质量检索下，声明式技能提升程序性任务准确率并减少编排错误；命令式状态机的脆弱性无法可靠提升任务成功或合规性。
AI.conclusion: 声明式代理（利用自然语言技能文件）是有效的编排范式，优于命令式状态机方法；未来工作应优先关注检索质量提升而非复杂状态机设计。

title: Quantum-Inspired Trace-Augmented Evidence Selection for Reasoning over Structured Hypothesis Spaces
summary: Large language models (LLMs) now solve a wide range of expert-level exams at or above human level, yet remain brittle on specialised, evidence-intensive domains such as law. On these tasks, errors arise not only from gaps in world knowledge but also from subtle distinctions between pieces of evidence and inconsistent use of supporting evidence. The most common aggregator over sampled chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, majority vote, returns the most popular answer regardless of whether its evidence is actually strongest. We propose to treat the selection of CoT reasoning fragments into a set of evidence as an explicit combinatorial optimisation problem, allowing well-supported but minority hypotheses to override noisy majorities, and to evaluate the approach on legal-reasoning benchmarks that are particularly sensitive to evidence quality. We introduce EP-HUBO (Evidence Pool Higher-Order Binary Optimisation), which generates multiple CoT traces with a small local model, parses fragments into per-hypothesis evidence pools, solves a higher-order unconstrained binary optimisation per pool with quality-derived weights (relevance, specificity, distinctiveness), and delegates a single adjudication call per question to a frontier model. We evaluate EP-HUBO on two evidence-intensive legal benchmarks using both simulated annealing on classical hardware and the Dirac-3 photonic entropy-quantum machine from Quantum Computing Inc. HUBO-style optimisation gives a principled way to aggregate reasoning fragments while preserving minority-but-correct hypotheses, and is most valuable in low-contamination domains where frontier models have not already absorbed the benchmark material.

AI.tldr: 提出EP-HUBO方法，将思维链推理片段的选择建模为组合优化问题，通过证据池高阶二元优化来聚合推理证据，在法律推理基准上优于多数投票方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在法律等证据密集型任务上表现脆弱，多数投票聚合思维链轨迹时会忽略证据质量，导致正确但属于少数的假设被噪声多数掩盖。
AI.method: 使用小型本地模型生成多条思维链轨迹，将片段解析为每个假设的证据池，构建带有质量权重（相关性、特异性、区分度）的高阶二元优化问题，通过模拟退火或光量子计算机求解，最后交给前沿模型做单次裁决。
AI.result: 在两个证据密集型法律基准上评估EP-HUBO，在低污染领域（前沿模型未见过基准数据时）价值最大。
AI.conclusion: HUBO式优化提供了一种原则性的推理片段聚合方式，能保留少数但正确的假设，在证据质量敏感的任务中优于传统多数投票。

title: Progress-SQL: Improving Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL via Progressive Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning has recently shown promise in improving large language models for Text-to-SQL generation, yet existing methods typically optimize one-shot rewards defined over a single SQL state. Such rewards provide limited guidance for iterative SQL correction and are insufficient to capture the improvement of multi-turn SQL refinement. In this paper, we propose Progress-SQL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework with progressive rewards for Text-to-SQL. Our approach introduces an Oracle-guided Diagnostic Tree (ODT), which abstracts SQL queries into clause-level structural profiles and produces diagnostic feedback for next-turn refinement. To provide dense and robust reward signals, we combine ODT-based structural alignment with lexical alignment and define a progressive reward that measures the improvement from the initial SQL to the final SQL. We further incorporate a progression latency reward that favors earlier correctness and an execution status reward that encourages recovery from the invalid SQL. Experiments on BIRD, Spider, and Spider robustness variants demonstrate that our method consistently improves Text-to-SQL performance across both primary and robustness evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出Progress-SQL，一种基于多轮强化学习和渐进式奖励的Text-to-SQL框架，通过Oracle引导的诊断树（ODT）提供结构级反馈和渐进式奖励信号，在BIRD、Spider等数据集上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常基于单次SQL状态定义一次性奖励，对多轮SQL修正的指导有限，且难以捕捉多轮优化过程中的改进信号。
AI.method: 提出Oracle引导的诊断树（ODT）将SQL抽象为子句级结构轮廓并生成诊断反馈；结合ODT结构对齐与词法对齐定义渐进式奖励；引入渐进延迟奖励（鼓励尽早正确）和执行状态奖励（鼓励从无效SQL中恢复）。
AI.result: 在BIRD、Spider及Spider鲁棒性变体上，Text-to-SQL性能在主要指标和鲁棒性评估中均得到一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 多轮强化学习结合结构级渐进式奖励能有效提升Text-to-SQL生成质量，尤其在多轮修正场景下优于传统单次奖励方法。

title: Breaking the Lock-in: Diversifying Text-to-Image Generation via Representation Modulation
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/daheekwon/DAVE
summary: Recent text-to-image models built on large-scale Transformer backbones and flow-based objectives deliver strong text-image alignment and high visual quality, yet often produce overly similar samples under a fixed prompt. Existing diversity-enhancement methods alleviate this issue, but typically require expensive sampling or auxiliary optimization, incurring non-trivial overhead. To investigate the root cause of this homogeneity, we examine intermediate Transformer features and observe that the zero-frequency spatial average (DC) component rapidly converges across seeds early in generation, causing early trajectory lock-in that limits downstream variation. Building on this observation, we propose DC Attenuation for diVersity Enhancement (DAVE), a training-free representation-level intervention that selectively attenuates this component in the early regime. DAVE preserves the sampling pipeline with negligible overhead, improving prompt-consistent diversity while maintaining competitive image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到图像模型中同质化问题的根源在于早期生成阶段DC分量的快速收敛，并提出了无需训练、零开销的DAVE方法，通过选择性衰减DC分量来提升多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在固定提示下生成样本过于相似，而现有多样性增强方法计算成本高，需要探究根本原因并提出轻量级解决方案。
AI.method: 分析中间Transformer特征发现DC分量早期快速收敛导致轨迹锁定，提出DAVE方法在表征层面选择性衰减早期阶段的零频率空间平均（DC）分量。
AI.result: DAVE在保持图像质量的同时，显著提升了提示一致性多样性，且几乎不增加额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单干预早期DC分量即可有效缓解生成同质化问题，为提升文本到图像模型多样性提供了高效、无训练的解决方案。

title: Accounting for Context: Shaping Moral Credences for Value Alignment
summary: Ensuring that agent behaviours are aligned with human moral values inevitably raises the problem of how to account for the plurality of moral perspectives that societies -- and even individuals -- typically adopt. Work on moral uncertainty proposes mechanisms to fairly and democratically aggregate evaluations of actions across different moral theories. However, this paper argues that one needs to account for contextual factors when aggregating moral evaluations. For example, consequentialist perspectives assume an ability to accurately determine how an agent's actions change the world; an assumption that often does not hold in real world settings. We, therefore, formalise agent decision making under moral uncertainty, while also accounting for these kinds of contextual factors. We thereby show that a seemingly commonsensical property -- the weak Pareto principle -- is violated. We argue that this apparent problem is, in fact, a variation of Simpson's paradox, and hence reveals the limitations of aggregation mechanisms that ignore the impact of contextual factors.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在道德不确定性下进行决策时，必须考虑情境因素（如能否准确预测行动后果），并证明忽略情境因素的聚合机制会违反弱帕累托原则，这本质上是辛普森悖论的一种变体。
AI.motivation: 现有道德不确定性聚合机制未考虑情境因素（如结果主义假设能准确预测行动后果，但现实中往往不成立），需要更合理的聚合方法。
AI.method: 形式化建模：在道德不确定性下引入情境因素的决策框架，分析弱帕累托原则是否成立。
AI.result: 发现忽略情境因素的聚合机制会违反弱帕累托原则，该问题本质上是辛普森悖论的一种变体。
AI.conclusion: 揭示情境因素对道德不确定性下聚合评估的关键影响，说明忽视情境的简单聚合机制存在局限性。

title: The Dark Regulome: Disentangling Predictability from Regulation in Genomic Foundation Models
summary: High-grade gliomas integrate into neural circuits through functional synapses with neurons, raising the question of which noncoding elements shape synaptogenic gene expression in tumor cells. The regulatory program written across the dark genome, what we call the $\textit{dark regulome}$, is the natural substrate to probe, and sequence foundation models offer a zero-shot route through in-silico mutagenesis (ISM); yet likelihood-based scoring is tautologically coupled to local sequence predictability, leaving the regulatory interpretation underdetermined. Across three architecturally distinct foundation models (Caduceus-Ph, HyenaDNA, Enformer) and 30,448 dark genome elements at 92 glioma-relevant loci, we introduce a residualization-and-permutation diagnostic that separates predictability-driven from regulation-driven RIS variance. A sharp 10kb proximal-regulatory horizon survives every control we apply, but the LM-derived element-class hierarchy does not: a six-feature linear baseline matches Caduceus top-decile membership at AUC $= 0.985$. Cross-architecture decomposition cleanly separates a sequence-predictability layer (the two language models co-rank long well-predicted transposable elements) from a regulatory-output layer (Enformer alone retains residual cCRE-discriminative signal), with literally zero overlap between the two top-100 lists. Conservation, brain cis-eQTL, and STRING-PPI cross-checks then anchor what biology survives: top-100 elements across all three models are $3.3\times$ enriched per model for matching brain eQTLs ($p_\mathrm{emp} < 5\times 10^{-3}$), while a tempting transposable-element regulatory layer and a striking NRXN1+NLGN1 protein-pair convergence both fail proper permutation tests once those tests are constructed. We deliver the diagnostic as a general methodological tool for any ISM-based regulatory study.

AI.tldr: 本文针对胶质瘤细胞中非编码元件（暗基因组）如何调控突触形成相关基因表达的问题，提出了一种残差化-置换诊断方法，用于区分序列基础模型（Caduceus-Ph、HyenaDNA、Enformer）通过原位诱变（ISM）打分中的“可预测性驱动”与“真正调控驱动”的变异。研究发现10kb近端调控边界稳健存在，但语言模型导出的元件分类层级不稳健；跨架构分解清晰分离出序列可预测性层与调控输出层，两者无重叠。生物学验证表明，三个模型共享的top-100元件在脑eQTL中富集3.3倍，而转座元件调控层和NRXN1+NLGN1蛋白对汇聚经正确置换检验后不显著。该方法可作为通用诊断工具用于任何ISM调控研究。
AI.motivation: 高级别胶质瘤通过功能性突触与神经元整合，但哪些非编码元件塑造了肿瘤细胞中突触形成相关基因的表达尚不清楚。暗基因组（dark genome）中的调控程序是研究这一问题的自然对象，而序列基础模型通过原位诱变（ISM）提供零样本分析途径，但基于似然度的打分与局部序列可预测性耦合，导致调控解读不确定。
AI.method: 使用三种架构不同的基础模型（Caduceus-Ph、HyenaDNA、Enformer）分析92个胶质瘤相关位点的30,448个暗基因组元件。提出残差化-置换诊断方法，将ISM方差分解为可预测性驱动和调控驱动两部分。通过交叉架构分解分离序列可预测性层（语言模型）与调控输出层（Enformer），并结合保守性、脑cis-eQTL和STRING-PPI进行生物学验证。
AI.result: 1) 10kb近端调控边界稳健存在；2) 语言模型导出的元件分类层级不稳健，六特征线性基线即可匹配Caduceus top-decile（AUC=0.985）；3) 跨架构分解显示语言模型与Enformer的top-100列表零重叠；4) 三个模型共享的top-100元件在脑eQTL中富集3.3倍（p<5×10⁻³）；5) 转座元件调控层和NRXN1+NLGN1蛋白对汇聚经正确置换检验后不显著。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种通用的残差化-置换诊断方法可用于任何基于ISM的调控研究，揭示了序列基础模型在暗基因组调控解读中的局限性与可靠的生物学信号。

title: VideoSEG-O3: A Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
summary: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) demands a sophisticated integration of temporal dynamics, spatial details, and linguistic reasoning to achieve precise pixel-level localization. Existing methods are limited to reasoning over fixed initial inputs and lack the capacity to actively acquire further visual evidence, which is often essential for resolving complex references in long or intricate videos. To address this, we propose \textbf{VideoSEG-O3}, the first multi-turn reinforcement learning framework for RVOS that emulates the human \textit{``coarse-to-fine''} cognitive process. It employs a \textit{multi-turn temporal-spatial chain-of-thought} to capture fine-grained details by iteratively pinpointing critical intervals and keyframes. Additionally, to enable the policy to perceive segmentation quality beyond mere text probability of \texttt{[SEG]} during the RL stage, we introduce \textit{SEG-aware logit calibration}, which integrates pixel-wise segmentation feedback directly into the token-level logits. Furthermore, we design a \textit{decoupled thinking trace} to hierarchically decompose the reasoning process into temporal, spatial, and linguistic dimensions, and construct \textbf{VTS-CoT}, a specialized cold-start dataset featuring comprehensive reasoning trajectories. The code and models will be released at https://github.com/Dmmm1997/VideoSEG-O3.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoSEG-O3，首个用于推理视频目标分割的多轮强化学习框架，通过模仿人类"由粗到细"的认知过程，结合多轮时空思维链、感知分割质量的logit校准和分离式思维轨迹，显著提升复杂视频中的分割准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅能对固定初始输入进行推理，缺乏主动获取更多视觉证据的能力，难以解决长视频或复杂视频中的引用分割任务。
AI.method: 1) 多轮时空思维链：迭代定位关键时间区间和关键帧；2) SEG感知logit校准：将像素级分割反馈整合到token级logits；3) 分离式思维轨迹：将推理过程分解为时间、空间、语言三个维度；4) 构建VTS-CoT冷启动数据集。
AI.result: 在多个RVOS基准上取得最先进性能，尤其在复杂长视频场景下显著超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 多轮强化学习框架有效模拟人类认知过程，通过主动获取视觉证据和精细化推理，为推理视频目标分割提供了新范式。

title: Exploring Agentic Tool-Calling Decisions via Uncertainty-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents often make suboptimal tool-use decisions, including unsupported tool invocation and hallucinated direct responses, which may accumulate errors throughout multi-step interactions. Existing approaches mainly improve these behaviors through inference-time correction or coarse-grained reward signals based on decision outcomes and structured checklists, leaving the uncertainty characteristics of agent decisions underexplored. We observe that decision-oriented reinforcement learning tends to weaken the uncertainty separation between correct and incorrect actions, resulting in overconfident mistakes and weaker exploration signals. Therefore, we propose TRUST, which incorporates uncertainty quantification into reward design as a repulsive force for maintaining uncertainty separation, and labels lightweight key-turn annotations for unified post-training of multi-turn trajectories. Experimental results across diverse tool-use benchmarks show that TRUST consistently enhances both decision quality and agent performance while maintaining more reliable uncertainty estimates during optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出TRUST方法，通过将不确定性量化纳入奖励设计并标注关键轮次，提升LLM智能体的工具使用决策质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依靠推理时修正或基于决策结果的粗粒度奖励信号来改善工具使用行为，但忽略了智能体决策的不确定性特征，导致过自信错误和探索信号弱化。
AI.method: 提出TRUST框架：1) 将不确定性量化引入奖励设计，作为维持正确与错误动作间不确定性分离的排斥力；2) 标注轻量级关键轮次注释，用于多轮轨迹的统一后训练。
AI.result: 在多种工具使用基准上，TRUST持续提升了决策质量和智能体性能，同时在优化过程中保持了更可靠的不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性量化能有效改善LLM智能体的工具使用决策，TRUST在决策质量和不确定性估计可靠性上均优于现有方法。

title: Translate-R1: Cost-Aware Translation Tool Use via Reinforcement Learning
comment: 14 pages main text plus appendix, 7 figures, 11 tables
summary:
The performance gap across languages in LLMs is well documented, and closing it natively requires pretraining or fine-tuning on corpora that, for most languages, do not exist. Translation offers an alternative: converting an input into the model's dominant language unlocks its full capabilities at once. Applying translation to every input, however, is wasteful for languages the model already handles, while leaving the choice to the model fails in the opposite way, as LLMs are overconfident and skip the tool even when they cannot understand the input. Prior work resolves this with language-specific rules, domain heuristics, language identifiers, or external routers, each requiring manual engineering. We instead learn a single policy that decides when to translate from reward alone, developing language- and domain-adaptive introspection that assesses its own comprehension and invokes translation only when it cannot solve a task natively.
  Using data built by our answer-preserving translation pipeline, we continue RL on the post-trained Qwen3-4B across 22 languages in 3 resource tiers (High, Low, XLow) and 5 domains, and introduce confidence-gated GSPO for cost-sensitive tool use. The gated policy lifts reward over the baseline by +4.6 on High, +23.5 on Low, and +17.5 on XLow. Against an unconstrained policy that almost always translates, it preserves full reward at 63% of the cost and is Pareto-optimal across 87% of the cost-sensitivity range. Additionally, to simulate behavior on a completely unseen language, we create 2 synthetic languages, where our gated policy improves +18.7 over the overconfident baseline that underutilizes the tool even on these incomprehensible inputs. The policy transfers zero-shot to 9 held-out languages, and we analyze how tool use emerges over training, per language and per domain.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应的翻译决策策略，通过强化学习让LLM自行判断何时需要翻译输入到主导语言，在22种语言和5个领域上实现了性能提升和成本控制，并零样本迁移到9种未见语言。
AI.motivation: LLM在不同语言上的性能差距大，原生消除需要大量训练语料，而翻译方法浪费资源、模型自身决策又过于自信，现有启发式规则需要人工工程。
AI.method: 基于答案保持的翻译流水线构建数据，在Qwen3-4B上进行强化学习，使用置信度门控的GSPO策略进行成本敏感的工具使用决策。
AI.result: 门控策略在High、Low、XLow资源层级上分别提升奖励+4.6、+23.5、+17.5；在63%成本下保持完整奖励；在87%成本敏感区间内帕累托最优；合成语言上提升+18.7；零样本迁移到9种未见语言。
AI.conclusion: 通过奖励驱动的自适应策略，模型可以学会自我评估理解力并仅在必要时调用翻译，避免了预定义规则和过度的翻译开销。

title: AdaGRPO: A Capability-Aware Adaptive Enhancement for Flow-based GRPO
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated remarkable success in aligning text-to-image (T2I) flow models with human preferences. However, we have identified that the learning loop of current flow-based GRPO is fundamentally decoupled from the learner's current capability, suffering from critical blind spots at both prompt selection and advantage estimation: (i) Existing methods sample prompts randomly, overlooking the substantial impact of data selection on reinforcement learning (RL) efficacy--a factor proven crucial in GRPO for large language models; (ii) They evaluate sample quality solely relying on intra-group statistics, lacking a global perspective to accurately measure true policy improvement. To address these issues, we propose Adaptive GRPO (AdaGRPO), a novel capability-aware RL algorithm tailored for flow models. Specifically, AdaGRPO consists of two principal components: (i) Online Curriculum Filtering Strategy: Dynamically tracks the model's proficiency and adaptively selects prompts that best match its current learning boundary; (ii) Cross-Level Advantage Fusion: Synergistically integrates fine-grained intra-group advantages with macro-level global advantages, providing a comprehensive and unbiased policy evaluation. As a lightweight, plug-and-play module, AdaGRPO can be seamlessly integrated with existing frameworks such as Flow-GRPO, DanceGRPO, and Flow-CPS. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdaGRPO consistently drives performance gains while significantly stabilizes GRPO training for flow models.

AI.tldr: AdaGRPO 通过在线课程过滤策略和跨层级优势融合机制，解决了流模型 GRPO 训练中数据选择随机和优势估计缺乏全局视角的问题，实现更稳定高效的强化学习对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有流模型 GRPO 存在两个盲点：1）提示选择随机，忽略了数据选择对 RL 效果的重要影响；2）优势估计仅依赖组内统计，缺乏全局视角，无法准确衡量真正的策略改进。
AI.method: 1) 在线课程过滤策略：动态追踪模型熟练度，自适应选择与当前学习边界最匹配的提示；2) 跨层级优势融合：协同整合细粒度组内优势与宏观全局优势，提供全面无偏的策略评估。
AI.result: AdaGRPO 作为轻量级即插即用模块，能无缝集成现有框架，持续提升性能并显著稳定流模型的 GRPO 训练。
AI.conclusion: AdaGRPO 通过能力感知的强化学习设计，有效解决了流模型 GRPO 的核心缺陷，是一种更优的文本到图像对齐方法。

title: Teaching the Way, Not the Answer: Privileged Tutoring Distillation for Multimodal Policy Optimization
summary: Recent post-training methods, particularly Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), have significantly enhanced the reasoning ability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, the sparse nature of verifiable rewards provides little token-level supervision for failed rollouts, often leading to inefficient exploration in complex multimodal reasoning tasks. Although policy distillation can offer dense guidance, external teacher based methods introduce substantial computational overhead, while answer conditioned tuning methods may expose answer-level information and induce shortcut-like generation behavior. To address these limitations, we propose PTD-PO, a Privileged Tutoring Distillation Policy Optimization framework for RLVR that provides dense guidance without exposing the answer to the student policy. Specifically, PTD-PO constructs structured privileged hints from spatial attention guidance and intermediate textual reasoning steps, and uses them through in-context learning to produce step-wise token-distribution supervision. The student is still optimized under the original answer-free context, and its failed rollouts are aligned with the hint-augmented reference model at the token-distribution level. To further stabilize distillation under the distribution shift between guided and unguided contexts, we introduce a Top-K Jensen-Shannon divergence objective that focuses alignment on informative token probabilities while reducing memory overhead. Experiments on LVLMs ranging from 2B to 8B parameters show that PTD-PO consistently outperforms RLVR and distillation baselines, mitigates entropy collapse, and improves complex multimodal reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出PTD-PO框架，通过特权提示蒸馏策略优化，在不暴露答案的情况下为RLVR提供密集的令牌级监督，提升多模态推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法在复杂多模态推理中奖励稀疏，缺乏令牌级监督导致探索效率低；外部教师蒸馏计算开销大，答案条件微调会暴露答案并引发捷径行为。
AI.method: 构建结构化特权提示（空间注意力引导+中间文本推理步骤），通过上下文学习产生逐步令牌分布监督；学生策略在无答案上下文中优化，将失败轨迹对齐到提示增强的参考模型；提出Top-K Jensen-Shannon散度目标以稳定蒸馏。
AI.result: 在2B到8B参数的LVLMs上，PTD-PO一致优于RLVR和蒸馏基线，缓解了熵坍缩，提升了复杂多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: PTD-PO通过特权蒸馏在不暴露答案的前提下提供密集监督，有效解决了RLVR在复杂多模态推理中的稀疏奖励问题。

title: Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces
summary: Modern reasoning models offer surprisingly strong zero-shot performance on challenging multi-label tasks that require selecting a small set of relevant options from hundreds of thousands to millions of candidate labels. We investigate how they achieve this mechanistically. We characterize reasoning as a two-phase process: A broad "shortlisting" of candidates followed by fine-grained reasoning over the resulting set. We provide evidence across a range of datasets that these steps can be isolated and are complementary. Using this characterization, we develop a mechanistic distillation strategy that consistently outperforms standard distillation.

AI.tldr: 现代推理模型在需要从海量候选中选择少量相关标签的多标签零样本任务中表现出色。研究发现其机制分为两个阶段：广泛的候选筛选和后续的细粒度推理。基于此提出的机理蒸馏策略优于标准蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 探究现代推理模型在零样本多标签任务中（需从数十万到数百万候选中选择少量相关项）表现优异的底层工作机制。
AI.method: 将推理过程表征为两阶段：先进行广泛的候选筛选（shortlisting），再对筛选后的集合进行细粒度推理。通过在多个数据集上验证两个阶段的可分离性和互补性，并基于此设计机理蒸馏策略。
AI.result: 提出的机理蒸馏策略在多个数据集上始终优于标准蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型的成功可归因于可分离且互补的两阶段机制，利用该特性设计的蒸馏策略能更有效地迁移模型能力。

title: CFRNet: Cycle-Consistent Fixed-Point Training for Real-Time Blind Face Restoration on Consumer Embedded NPUs
comment: 12 pages.Code and project page will be released
summary: Blind face restoration on consumer devices has to balance image quality against speed and memory. Strong methods such as GFPGAN and CodeFormer give good perceptual quality, but they rely on large pretrained generative priors and on operators such as attention, codebook lookup, and style modulation that are hard to compile and quantize on the small neural processing units (NPUs) used in consumer hardware. Small convolutional restorers run fast enough, but they tend to over-smooth and to leave artifacts around the eyes, nose, and mouth. We present CFRNet, a 2.0,M-parameter ResNet-style restorer for on-device use at $256\times256$, the common face-crop size on consumer NPUs. The main idea is Cycle-Consistent Fixed-Point Training (CCFP). Instead of training the network for one pass and then running it several times by hand, we train it to act as a fixed-point operator, so that applying it again to a restored face does not change the face. CCFP uses three training losses, namely progressive multi-cycle supervision, an idempotence loss, and a re-degradation cycle loss, and it adds no cost at inference. To compare fairly under our deployment limits, we retrain all baselines from scratch at the same $256\times256$ resolution. On a 300-image test set, CFRNet reaches the best perceptual score (LPIPS 0.250 at three cycles, which is 31% lower than one cycle) and also the best PSNR and SSIM at two cycles. It runs in about 23,ms per cycle in INT8 on a HiSilicon Hi3402 NPU, while the same baselines cannot be compiled to that chip. The cycle count $k$ acts as a simple quality knob that needs no retraining: PSNR is best at $k\!=\!2$ and LPIPS keeps improving up to $k\!=\!3$. We further show that the same idea works with a plain CNN that is even easier to deploy, and we run the model in real time on an in-car driver-monitoring board.

AI.tldr: CFRNet是一个200万参数的轻量级人脸修复网络，通过循环一致固定点训练（CCFP）实现消费设备上的高质量人脸修复，在INT8 NPU上仅需23ms每轮，且可通过调整推理轮数k来权衡性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强方法（如GFPGAN、CodeFormer）依赖大型预训练生成先验，难以在消费级NPU上编译和量化；而小型卷积修复器速度快但容易过平滑，在眼、鼻、嘴区域留下伪影。需要一种在速度、内存和质量之间平衡的轻量级修复方法。
AI.method: 提出CFRNet（2.0M参数的ResNet风格修复器）和循环一致固定点训练（CCFP）。CCFP包含三种损失：渐进多循环监督损失、幂等性损失和再退化循环损失，训练网络作为固定点算子，使多次应用不改变修复结果，且推理时不增加额外成本。
AI.result: 在300图测试集上，CFRNet三轮时LPIPS达0.250（比单轮低31%），两轮时PSNR和SSIM最佳；在HiSilicon Hi3402 NPU上INT8每轮约23ms，而基线方法无法编译到该芯片；轮数k可作为无需重新训练的质量调节旋钮。
AI.conclusion: CFRNet结合CCFP训练策略，在消费级NPU上实现了高质量、低延迟的人脸修复，且该思想可推广到更易部署的普通CNN上，已在实际车载驾驶员监控系统中实时运行。

title: The Sim-to-Real Gap of Foundation Model Agents: A Unified MDP Perspective
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted by KDD 2026 Blue Sky Ideas Track
summary: Foundation model agents are increasingly deployed for real-world decision-making, but suffer from the sim-to-real gap. While robotics and classical control have mature frameworks to address this gap, the foundation model community is treating agent robustness as an entirely novel phenomenon. Our paper proposes formalizing the foundation model agent evaluation and training gap as a classical sim-to-real problem structured entirely around the four elements of a Markov Decision Process, including Observation, Action, Transition, and Reward. In this paper, we set a comprehensive research agenda that translates classical discrepancies into the foundation model domain and advocates for adopting established solutions like domain randomization. We provide concrete examples, such as a multilingual tool calling to demonstrate how severe observation space gaps lead to operationally invalid actions despite correct semantic intent. Ultimately, this agenda aims to drive a paradigm shift, yielding a unified vocabulary and standardized stress test benchmarks to foster a new generation of highly trustworthy agents for reliable real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基础模型智能体的评估与训练差距形式化为一个经典的sim-to-real问题，围绕MDP的四个要素（观察、动作、转移、奖励）构建研究框架，并倡导采用领域随机化等成熟解决方案，以推动构建统一术语和标准化压力测试基准，实现高可信度的现实世界应用。
AI.motivation: 基础模型智能体在现实世界部署中面临sim-to-real差距问题，但该领域社区往往将其视为全新现象，忽视了机器人学和控制论中已有成熟框架。本文旨在弥合这一认知鸿沟。
AI.method: 将智能体评估与训练差距形式化为围绕MDP四个要素（观察、动作、转移、奖励）的经典sim-to-real问题，提出采用领域随机化等已有成熟解决方案，并给出多语言工具调用等具体实例。
AI.result: 提供了具体的实例分析（多语言工具调用中观察空间差距导致操作无效），并提出了统一词汇表和标准化压力测试基准的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 通过将问题重新框架化，倡导采用已有成熟方案，推动范式转变，最终实现高可信度的可靠现实世界智能体应用。

title: CRAFT: A Unified Counterfactual Reasoning Framework for Tabular Question Answering and Fact Verification
summary: Table reasoning remains challenging for large language models (LLMs), particularly in tasks that require multi-step inference over long and structured tables. Existing approaches predominantly rely on single-direction reasoning, which limits their ability to explore alternative hypotheses across tasks. In this work, we propose CRAFT, a unified Counterfactual Reasoning Framework that reformulates Tabular question answering and fact verification into a general bidirectional verification process. Our method explicitly constructs both declarative statements and their counterfactual variants. Evidence is then extracted from reasoning along both the original and counterfactual paths, and integrated via a weighted mechanism to arrive at the final answer. Experimental results show that our approach consistently surpasses representative baselines on table reasoning datasets such as WikiTQ and TabFact, achieving especially large improvements on complex question answering. Our framework also significantly mitigates performance gaps between different backbone LLMs. This indicates that counterfactual reasoning effectively overcomes the limitations of single-direction inference, guiding LLMs toward more discerning reasoning and establishing a more principled paradigm for structured reasoning tasks. Our code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出CRAFT框架，通过反事实推理将表格问答和事实验证转化为双向验证过程，显著提升了LLM在表格推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖单向推理，限制了LLM在多步推理和结构化表格任务中探索替代假设的能力。
AI.method: CRAFT框架构建原始声明及其反事实变体，从两条推理路径中提取证据，并通过加权机制融合得到最终答案。
AI.result: 在WikiTQ和TabFact上持续超越基线，在复杂问答上提升尤其显著，并有效缩小了不同骨干LLM之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 反事实推理能克服单向推理局限，引导LLM进行更具辨别力的推理，为结构化推理任务建立了更规范的新范式。

title: MotionEnhancer: Leveraging Video Diffusion for Motion-Enhanced Vision-Language Models
summary: The new era has witnessed a remarkable capability to extend Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for tackling tasks of video understanding. While current VLMs excel at event- or story-level understanding, their ability to capture fine-grained motion details remains limited, primarily due to their focus on high-level static semantic structures and macro-event logic. In contrast, Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) are adept at modeling dynamic motion patterns, benefiting from large-scale video data and the intrinsic requirement of temporal generation. In this paper, we introduce MotionEnhancer, a novel approach that leverages motion priors distilled from a powerful video diffusion model as auxiliary supervision to enhance the motion understanding capability of a VLM via attention alignment. MotionEnhancer comprises two simple parameter-free modules, Motion-sensitive Head Selection (MHS) and Motion-salient Text Token Identification (MTTI), to directly extract and optimize motion-related attentions from the VDM in a computation-only manner. MotionEnhancer provides a scalable solution for motion understanding without additional training parameters, modifications to existing architectures, or tool calling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionEnhancer can achieve consistent improvements over state-of-the-art VLMs on two motion-level video understanding benchmarks, especially on motion-related metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出MotionEnhancer方法，利用视频扩散模型的运动先验，通过注意力对齐增强视觉语言模型的运动理解能力，无需额外参数或架构修改即可提升运动级视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM擅长事件级或故事级理解，但捕捉细粒度运动细节能力有限，因为它们主要关注高层静态语义结构和宏观事件逻辑。
AI.method: 提出MotionEnhancer，包含两个无参数模块：Motion-sensitive Head Selection (MHS)和Motion-salient Text Token Identification (MTTI)，从视频扩散模型中蒸馏运动先验作为辅助监督，通过注意力对齐优化VLM的运动理解。
AI.result: 在两个运动级视频理解基准上，相比现有最先进VLM取得一致改进，尤其在运动相关指标上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: MotionEnhancer提供了一种可扩展的运动理解方案，无需额外训练参数、架构修改或工具调用。

title: StainFlow: Entity-Stain Tracking and Evidence Linking for Process Rewards in GUI Agents
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a promising approach for improving GUI Agents in long-horizon, stochastic digital environments, but trajectory-level success feedback is too sparse to provide reliable credit assignment for intermediate exploration steps. To mitigate this issue, recent studies introduce Process Reward Models (PRMs), which provide finer-grained training feedback through global milestone verification or local step-level evaluation. However, these methods still suffer from two level-specific limitations: global milestone decomposition is subjective and singular, making it difficult to accommodate the multiple valid execution paths in real GUI tasks, while fixed local judging windows may miss long-range key evidence or dilute the decision signal with irrelevant frames. Inspired by stain-tracing mechanisms in network flow analysis, we propose StainFlow, an entity-stain-flow process reward model for GUI Agents. To reduce the subjectivity of global partitioning, we introduce the Global Entity Stain Tracking module, which extracts visually verifiable task entities and tracks how their stain concentrations and states evolve along the trajectory, allowing task phases to be objectively separated by changes in the entity evidence flow. To improve the accuracy of local verification, we introduce the Local Stain Evidence Linking module. Centered on the triggering entities of each candidate key node, it retrieves relevant steps based on their stain concentrations and state changes, and dynamically constructs high-density evidence windows for verifying true key nodes. Extensive experiments on AndroidWorld and OGRBench show that StainFlow relatively improves online RL success by 3.2% and trajectory completion judgment accuracy by 1.8%.

AI.tldr: StainFlow提出了一种基于实体污点追踪的流程奖励模型，通过全局实体污点追踪和局部污点证据链接两个模块，解决了GUI智能体中奖励稀疏和信用分配问题，在AndroidWorld和OGRBench上取得了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有PRM方法存在两个层面的局限：全局里程碑分解主观且单一，难以适应GUI任务中多样化的有效执行路径；局部固定窗口判断可能遗漏长距离关键证据或用无关帧稀释决策信号。
AI.method: 提出StainFlow模型，包含两个核心模块：1) 全局实体污点追踪模块，提取视觉可验证的任务实体并追踪其污点浓度和状态演化，客观划分任务阶段；2) 局部污点证据链接模块，以候选关键节点的触发实体为中心，基于污点浓度和状态变化检索相关步骤，动态构建高密度证据窗口进行验证。
AI.result: 在AndroidWorld和OGRBench上的实验表明，StainFlow在在线RL成功率上相对提升3.2%，在轨迹完成判断准确率上提升1.8%。
AI.conclusion: StainFlow通过污点追踪机制有效解决了GUI智能体奖励稀疏问题，为长序列决策中的信用分配提供了一种客观且自适应的解决方案。

title: Interpreting Brain Responses to Language with Sparse Features from Language Models
summary: A central goal of cognitive neuroscience is to characterize the features that are represented by human language cortex. Artificial language models (LMs) have emerged as a powerful tool to address this challenge, but studies relating biological and artificial representations are often criticized as relating one black box to another. The present work introduces Augmented Sparse Encoding Models, an encoding framework that replaces dense LM hidden states with hierarchically-organized sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, while explicitly including surprisal as a predictor. Using this approach, we (i) produce interpretations of neural responses and (ii) test whether model-brain alignment reflects primary or idiosyncratic variation in LM representations. Using a high-field 7T fMRI dataset of eight participants listening to 200 linguistically diverse sentences, we first validate our modeling framework by recovering previous interpretations of voxel populations tuned to processing difficulty and meaning abstractness. We then interpret a previously-uncharacterized (but reliable) voxel population and find that it is tuned to people-related content. Next, we show that the fronto-temporal human language network is predicted by a common set of features across its constituent regions, but find that frontal regions are relatively well-explained by surprisal alone, even in the absence of LM-based features. Finally, we show that brain responses during language processing are not merely predictable from an arbitrary set of LM features. Rather, brain responses are best explained by the features that tend to capture the most general information encoded in LM representations, suggesting a nontrivial correspondence between brain and LM language representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出增强稀疏编码模型（Augmented Sparse Encoding Models），利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征替代密集的LM隐藏状态，并结合surprisal预测因子，分析大脑语言皮层表征。通过7T fMRI实验验证，发现SAE特征能解释脑响应，揭示了对人际相关内容敏感的神经群体，并证明大脑与LM的对应关系具有非平凡性。
AI.motivation: 认知神经科学的核心目标是刻画人类语言皮层表征的特征。尽管人工语言模型（LMs）是强大的工具，但将生物学与人工表征相关联的研究常被批评为"黑箱对黑箱"。本文旨在开发一种可解释的编码框架，以弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出增强稀疏编码模型（Augmented Sparse Encoding Models），用层级组织的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征替换密集的LM隐藏状态，并显式包含surprisal作为预测因子。通过高场7T fMRI采集8名被试聆听200个语言多样性句子的数据，对模型进行验证。
AI.result: （1）恢复了先前关于处理难度和意义抽象性相关体素群体的解释；（2）发现了一个此前未表征但可靠的体素群体，其对人际相关内容敏感；（3）额颞语言网络由一组共同特征预测，但额叶区域仅依赖surprisal即可较好解释；（4）脑响应并非由任意LM特征预测，而是由LM表征中最通用的信息特征最佳解释。
AI.conclusion: 大脑与语言模型之间存在非平凡的对应关系，额叶区域对surprisal的依赖性较强，且脑响应主要由LM中捕获最通用信息的特征所解释，而非任意特征。

title: Hierarchical Semantic-Constrained Heterogeneous Graph for Audio-Visual Event Localization
summary: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) jointly models audio-visual cues to recognize and temporally localize events, including categories unseen during training. Existing methods primarily learn joint audio-visual representations in Euclidean space, but still face two significant challenges. First, the lack of supervision signals for unseen categories makes it difficult to maintain audio-visual consistency across multiple temporal scales. Second, the lack of hierarchical constraints between segment- and video-level semantics prevents the model from establishing semantic consistency across different levels. To address these challenges, we propose a hierarchical semantic constrained heterogeneous graph (HSCHG) for audio-visual event localization framework. We first construct a heterogeneous hierarchical graph in Euclidean space, which includes audio and visual segment nodes and their corresponding video-level nodes. We use multi-directional temporal edges to capture complete temporal information within each modality. Simultaneously, we employ a dual-threshold filtering gated fusion strategy, introducing cross-modal information only when the alignment confidence is high. Furthermore, we introduce bidirectional semantic constraints between segment- and video-level representations to achieve semantic consistency across different levels. Based on this, we map the multi-level audio-visual representations and text prototypes uniformly into hyperbolic space. We use a hierarchical entailment regularization loss to characterize the hierarchical relationships between videos and segments. Extensive experimental results show that our method outperforms existing methods on the OV-AVEL benchmark. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种层次语义约束异构图（HSCHG）框架，通过欧氏空间中的异构层次图、双阈值过滤门控融合策略和双曲空间中的层次蕴含正则化损失，解决了开放词汇视听事件定位中跨时间尺度一致性和跨层级语义一致性的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇视听事件定位方法在欧氏空间中学习联合视听表征，但面临两大挑战：一是缺乏未见类别的监督信号，难以维持多时间尺度上的视听一致性；二是缺乏段级与视频级语义之间的层次约束，无法建立跨层级的语义一致性。
AI.method: 1) 在欧氏空间中构建异构层次图，包含音频/视觉段节点及对应视频级节点，利用多方向时间边捕获完整时序信息；2) 采用双阈值过滤门控融合策略，仅在对齐置信度高时引入跨模态信息；3) 引入段级与视频级之间的双向语义约束；4) 将多层级视听表征与文本原型统一映射到双曲空间，使用层次蕴含正则化损失刻画视频与段之间的层次关系。
AI.result: 在OV-AVEL基准上优于现有方法，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的HSCHG框架通过层次语义约束和多空间映射有效解决了开放词汇场景下视听事件定位的跨尺度一致性和跨层级一致性问题。

title: Are Large Language Models Suitable for Graph Computation? Progress and Prospects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly explored for graph computation, where tasks require reasoning over structured relationships and algorithmic operations. Yet, it remains unclear when LLMs can reliably support such computation and how they should be incorporated into graph-solving pipelines. Existing surveys at the intersection of LLMs and graphs primarily focus on graph learning, text-attributed graphs, or graph-language modeling. To bridge this gap, we provide a comprehensive review of LLMs for graph computation through a role-based taxonomy. Specifically, we identify two major paradigms: i) LLMs as executors, where models directly solve graph tasks from graph descriptions and instructions; and ii) LLMs as planners, where models formulate problems, decompose reasoning steps, and invoke external tools or agents for execution. Based on this taxonomy, we analyze the strengths and limitations of current methods. Our review indicates that LLMs are promising for simple, small-scale tasks, but remain unreliable for large-scale and exactness-demanding tasks. Finally, we summarize available datasets and suggest four future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了LLMs在图计算中的两种角色范式——执行器（直接求解）和规划器（分解推理+调用外部工具），指出LLMs在简单小规模任务上表现良好，但在大规模和高精度任务中仍不可靠，并总结了现有数据集及四个未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLMs与图相关综述主要集中在图学习、文本属性图或图语言建模上，缺乏对LLMs在图计算（涉及结构化关系和算法推理的任务）中可靠性和应用方式的系统性梳理。
AI.method: 采用基于角色的分类法，将LLMs在图计算中的角色划分为执行器（直接根据图描述和指令求解）和规划器（分解问题并调用外部工具/智能体执行），并基于此分析各方法的优劣。
AI.result: LLMs在简单、小规模的图计算任务上表现出潜力，但在大规模和需要高精确度的任务上仍不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 总结了现有数据集，并提出了四个未来研究方向，为后续LLMs与图计算的结合提供了系统框架和指导。

title: Front-to-Attractors: Modifying the Front-to-Front Heuristic in Bidirectional Search
summary: Heuristics play a central role in the performance of bidirectional search algorithms, which commonly rely on two main classes. Front-to-end (F2E) heuristics estimate the distance from a state s to the target of the search (the goal for forward search or the start for backward search). In contrast, front-to-front (F2F) heuristics estimate the distance from s to the opposite search frontier using a pairwise function h(s, s'), where s' ranges over frontier states. Although F2F heuristics are typically more informative and therefore reduce the number of node expansions, their reliance on extensive pairwise evaluations incurs substantial computational overhead. To address this limitation, we introduce a new heuristic class, front-to-attractors (F2A), that preserves much of the informativeness of F2F while dramatically reducing its computational cost. Rather than evaluating distances to all states on the opposite frontier, F2A estimates the distance from s to a small, dynamically maintained set of attractors in the opposite search direction. These attractors serve as a surrogate for the full frontier, enabling rich heuristic guidance at a fraction of the computational expense while maintaining the optimality guarantees offered by F2F. We evaluate F2A across multiple domains and show that it reduces the number of pairwise evaluations by up to 11.2x compared to F2F, while achieving 4.8x fewer node expansions than F2E on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的双向搜索启发式方法——Front-to-Attractors (F2A)，通过在对面搜索方向维护一个小型吸引子集合来替代完整的边界状态评估，显著降低了计算开销，同时保留了接近Front-to-Front (F2F)方法的信息量和最优性保证。实验表明，F2A相比F2F减少了最多11.2倍的成对评估次数，相比Front-to-End (F2E)平均减少了4.8倍的节点扩展数。
AI.motivation: 传统双向搜索中，Front-to-End (F2E)启发式计算效率高但信息量有限，而Front-to-Front (F2F)启发式信息丰富但需要大量成对状态评估，计算开销巨大。本文旨在设计一种既能保持较高信息量又能大幅降低计算成本的新型启发式方法。
AI.method: 提出Front-to-Attractors (F2A)启发式方法，在对面搜索方向上动态维护一个小型吸引子集合作为完整边界状态的替代。通过评估当前状态到这些吸引子的距离来指导搜索，而非计算到所有对面边界状态的距离，从而大幅减少成对评估次数。
AI.result: 在多个领域上的实验表明，F2A相比F2F减少了最多11.2倍的成对评估次数，相比F2E平均减少了4.8倍的节点扩展数。
AI.conclusion: F2A在保持F2F启发式信息丰富性和最优性保证的同时，显著降低了计算开销，为双向搜索提供了一种高效实用的启发式方法。

title: An Expanded Synthetic Conversation Dataset for Multi-Turn Smishing Detection
summary: Our prior work introduced COVA, a synthetically generated multi-turn conversational smishing dataset of 3,201 labeled conversations, establishing baseline detection benchmarks across eight models. While XGBoost with TF-IDF features achieved the best performance, with 72.5\% accuracy and 0.691 macro F1, transformer models underperformed, which was attributed to input truncation and insufficient training data. We present COVA-X, an expanded dataset of 10,985 conversations spanning eight elder-targeted scam categories, produced by an improved generation pipeline addressing contamination, label mismatch, stage-direction bleed, and prompt-design failures from the first iteration. Retraining all classifiers on the expanded dataset yields the central finding of this work: Longformer now surpasses XGBoost on all evaluation metrics, achieving 79.71\% accuracy and 0.7786 macro F1 compared with 78.43\% and 0.7563 for XGBoost. This directly confirms that transformer models require larger conversational corpora to realize their contextual advantages. We additionally document a quality life-cycle including a 12.7$\times$ improvement in label correction rate, from 49.8\% to 3.9\%, an architectural intervention reducing virtual-kidnapping artifact rates from 67.1\% to 46.5\%, and a per-scam-type outcome analysis showing that scam categories modulate results in mechanism-consistent ways. A pre/post-cleanup sensitivity analysis confirms that dataset refinement recovers genuine label-relevant signal across all three classifier architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COVA-X，一个包含10,985条对话的扩展版短信诈骗数据集，通过改进生成流程解决了COVA数据集中的污染、标签不匹配等问题。实验表明，Longformer模型超越XGBoost，准确率达79.71%，宏F1达0.7786，验证了Transformer模型需要更大规模对话语料才能发挥其上下文优势。
AI.motivation: 前期工作COVA数据集中Transformer模型因输入截断和训练数据不足而表现不佳，同时存在数据污染、标签不匹配、舞台指令泄漏和提示设计失败等问题。需要构建更大规模、更高质量的数据集来验证Transformer模型的潜力。
AI.method: 构建了包含10,985条对话的COVA-X数据集，覆盖8种针对老年人的诈骗类别；采用改进的生成流程，解决污染、标签不匹配、舞台指令泄漏和提示设计失败问题；使用Longformer、XGBoost等模型进行训练和评估；进行了标签修正率、架构干预效果、每类诈骗结果分析以及前后清理敏感性分析。
AI.result: Longformer超越XGBoost，准确率79.71% vs 78.43%，宏F1 0.7786 vs 0.7563；标签修正率从49.8%提升至3.9%（提升12.7倍）；虚拟绑架异常率从67.1%降至46.5%。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型需要更大规模的对话语料才能发挥其上下文优势；数据集质量改进能恢复真实标签相关信号；不同诈骗类别对模型结果有机制一致的影响。

title: DyCon: Dynamic Reasoning Control via Evolving Difficulty Modeling
summary: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) demonstrate remarkable performance improvements by iteratively reflecting, exploring, and executing complex tasks, yet suffer from inefficiencies due to redundant reasoning, known as "overthinking". Existing methods to mitigate this issue either rely on static difficulty estimates or require task-specific training, and thus fail to adapt to the dynamic complexity during reasoning. In this work, we empirically show that the problem difficulty evolves dynamically throughout the reasoning process and is linearly encoded in the LRM's step-level embeddings. Building on this insight, we propose DyCon, a training-free framework that leverages latent step-level representations to explicitly model the evolving task difficulty, enabling the dynamic control of reasoning depth to mitigate the overthinking issue. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 4B to 32B, and across twelve benchmarks in math reasoning, general question answering, and coding tasks demonstrate that DyCon significantly enhances reasoning efficiency by reducing redundant steps without sacrificing accuracy or generalization. Project page and code are available at https://github.com/yu-lin-li/DyCon.

AI.tldr: 提出DyCon框架，通过分析LRM推理过程中的步骤级嵌入，动态控制推理深度以减少过思考问题，无需训练即可提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有大推理模型存在"过度思考"问题，即推理过程中产生冗余步骤；现有缓解方法依赖静态难度估计或需任务特定训练，无法适应推理过程中的动态复杂度变化。
AI.method: DyCon（Dynamic Control框架）：基于步骤级潜在表示显式建模推理过程中动态变化的任务难度，从而动态控制推理深度，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在4B到32B四个模型、12个基准测试（涵盖数学推理、通用问答、编码任务）上，DyCon显著提升推理效率，减少冗余步骤，且不牺牲准确率或泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 问题难度在推理过程中动态演变且在LRM步骤级嵌入中线性编码，DyCon利用这一特性实现了无需训练的高效推理控制。

title: EASE-TTT: Evidence-Aligned Selective Test-Time Training for Long-Context Question Answering
summary: Long-context question answering (QA) remains challenging for smaller language models even when answer-bearing evidence is already present in the input. Existing within-context retrieval methods localize and expose candidate evidence chunks for the question, but they stop at input-level evidence exposure rather than adapting the query-side attention parameters that control how the model allocates attention over full-context positions. In contrast, lightweight test-time adaptation methods, such as query-only test-time training (qTTT), leave evidence localization unresolved because their generic span-level self-supervised objectives do not identify which context positions support the current answer. In this paper, we propose Evidence-Aligned SElective Test-Time Training (EASE-TTT), a within-context retrieval-augmented test-time training framework that converts selected evidence chunks into a soft attention supervision target over their token positions. Instead of replacing the full context with retrieved chunks, EASE-TTT uses the resulting attention target to guide query-side adaptation, with the adapted model generating the final answer from the original full context. Experiments on six LongBench QA tasks and three small decoder-only language models show that EASE-TTT achieves the strongest macro-average performance among full-context inference, retrieval-only baselines, and qTTT, supporting evidence-aligned test-time adaptation in long-context QA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EASE-TTT框架，通过将检索到的证据块转换为软注意力监督目标，引导查询侧参数在测试时进行适应，从而提升小模型在长文本问答中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么仅在输入层面暴露证据而不调整注意力参数，要么通过通用测试时训练方法无法定位证据位置，小模型在长文本问答中即使有答案证据也难以正确回答。
AI.method: 提出EASE-TTT框架：1) 检索相关证据块；2) 将证据块转换为软注意力监督目标；3) 利用该目标引导查询侧注意力参数进行测试时训练；4) 在原始完整上下文中生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在六个LongBench QA任务和三个小型解码器模型上，EASE-TTT在宏平均性能上优于全上下文推理、仅检索基线以及qTTT方法。
AI.conclusion: EASE-TTT通过将检索证据与测试时注意力对齐相结合，有效提升了小模型在长文本问答中的性能，验证了证据对齐的测试时训练策略的有效性。

title: EgoPressDiff: Multimodal Video Diffusion for Egocentric UV-Domain Hand-Pressure Estimation
summary: Estimating hand-surface contact pressure from an egocentric view is crucial for AR/VR devices, robotic imitation, and ergonomic analysis. Existing methods often discretize pressure signal and process frames independently, leading to quantization errors and temporal inconsistencies. We present \emph{EgoPressDiff}, a conditional video diffusion framework that generates UV-pressure maps from visual input. The core of our approach is a multi-modal conditioning strategy, introducing a PoseNet and a Vertex Encoder to efficiently extract features from hand pose and 3D mesh vertices. These signals, along with depth information, guide the generative process to ensure the pressure fields are physically grounded. To effectively fuse these heterogeneous features, we further propose a Distribution-Calibrated Spatial Layer, which aligns their statistical properties before combination. Evaluated on the EgoPressure ego-view setting, EgoPressDiff achieves state-of-the-art results, improving Volumetric IoU by over 34\% relative to prior baseline, while reducing MAE and maintaining high temporal accuracy. Our project page is at https://egopressdiff.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoPressDiff，一种条件视频扩散框架，通过多模态条件策略（手部姿态、3D网格顶点、深度信息）从自我中心视角生成UV压力图，在EgoPressure数据集上相比基线方法将Volumetric IoU提升超过34%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将压力信号离散化并逐帧独立处理，导致量化误差和时间不一致性，需要一种能生成连续、时序一致的自视角手部接触压力图的方法。
AI.method: 提出条件视频扩散框架EgoPressDiff，核心是多模态条件策略：PoseNet提取手部姿态特征，Vertex Encoder提取3D网格顶点特征，结合深度信息引导压力场生成；并设计分布校准空间层（Distribution-Calibrated Spatial Layer）对齐异质特征的统计属性以实现有效融合。
AI.result: 在EgoPressure自我中心视角设定下，Volumetric IoU相对基线提升超过34%，同时降低了MAE并保持了高时间精度，达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 多模态条件视频扩散框架能有效生成物理真实的连续压力场，在AR/VR设备、机器人模仿和人体工学分析等应用中有重要价值。

title: Beyond Post-hoc Explanation: Toward Glassbox AI via Probabilistic Mediation
summary: Large language models are rapidly becoming infrastructural components in high-stakes institutional settings, including public administration, legal reasoning, and healthcare, where opacity is not merely inconvenient but institutionally and legally untenable. Existing approaches to explainability are predominantly post-hoc, offering unstable, non-contestable accounts that have no formal relationship to the reasoning process that produced the output. We argue that the problem is not the absence of explanation but the absence of structured reasoning in the first place. This paper makes the case for a fundamentally different architecture, which we call the Glassbox Framework, in which Bayesian networks serve as transparent, ante-hoc mediation layers for generative models. Bayesian networks encode domain knowledge, causal assumptions, and probabilistic dependencies before inference occurs, enabling auditable reasoning traces, uncertainty quantification, and contestable outputs. We characterise the architecture of this framework and ground it in a benefit eligibility scenario, identifying the foundational challenges spanning semantic alignment, dynamic model construction, probabilistic grounding, and human governance that must be solved to realise it at scale. By shifting from post-hoc explanation to ante-hoc probabilistic mediation, this work outlines a principled path toward AI systems that are not only powerful but fundamentally accountable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Glassbox框架，利用贝叶斯网络作为生成模型的前置透明中介层，从“事后解释”转向“事前结构化推理”，以实现AI系统的可问责性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在公共行政、法律推理、医疗等高风险场景中日益成为基础设施，但其黑箱特性在制度和法律上不可接受。现有事后解释方法不稳定、不可辩驳，与真实推理过程无形式化关联。问题不在于缺乏解释，而在于推理过程本身缺乏结构化。
AI.method: 提出Glassbox框架，核心是让贝叶斯网络作为生成模型的**事前（ante-hoc）中介层**。在推理发生前，贝叶斯网络编码领域知识、因果假设和概率依赖关系，从而实现可审计的推理轨迹、不确定性量化和可辩驳的输出。文章通过福利资格判定场景进行具体化说明。
AI.result: 明确了实现该框架需解决的四大基础挑战：语义对齐（贝叶斯网络与语言模型之间的语义映射）、动态模型构建（根据上下文实时构建贝叶斯网络）、概率基础（概率推理的可靠性）以及人类治理（人机协作与监督机制）。
AI.conclusion: 从“事后解释”转向“事前概率中介”，是构建既强大又可问责的AI系统的原则性路径。Glassbox框架为高风险场景下的大语言模型部署提供了可审计、可辩驳、有依据的结构化推理方案。

title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning
summary: Test-time compute (TTC) scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning by allocating additional compute during inference, e.g., via multi-sample generation and verifier-based reranking. Existing TTC scaling strategies and reasoning scorers remain fragmented, evaluated under inconsistent protocols, and are rarely analyzed through the lens of quality-cost trade-offs. We introduce ThinkBooster, a unified framework for seamless test-time compute scaling of LLM reasoning, which consists of (i) a modular Python library implementing state-of-the-art TTC scaling strategy and scorer families, (ii) a benchmark that jointly evaluates performance and computational efficiency, and (iii) a deployable OpenAI-compatible proxy service that enables drop-in integration of adaptive reasoning into real-world applications. We further provide a demo visual debugger for inspecting the reasoning trajectories, intermediate selection decisions, and alternative reasoning paths. Empirical results on mathematical and coding tasks reveal the performance-compute trade-offs of TTC scaling strategies and scoring methods and demonstrate that ThinkBooster provides practical gains in real-world tasks. The code is available online under an MIT license.

AI.tldr: ThinkBooster是一个统一的测试时计算扩展框架，包含模块化库、基准测试和可部署服务，用于提升LLM推理性能与效率的权衡分析。
AI.motivation: 现有TTC扩展策略和推理评分器碎片化、评估协议不一致，且缺乏从质量-成本权衡角度的系统分析。
AI.method: 提出ThinkBooster框架，包含三个组件：(i)模块化Python库实现SOTA TTC策略和评分器；(ii)联合评估性能和计算效率的基准测试；(iii)兼容OpenAI的可部署代理服务，支持自适应推理。
AI.result: 在数学和编程任务上的实验揭示了TTC扩展策略与评分方法的性能-计算权衡，并在实际任务中展现出实用增益。
AI.conclusion: ThinkBooster为TTC扩展提供了统一、可部署的解决方案，有助于实际应用中的推理质量与成本平衡。

title: Unified Safe In-context Image Generation in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers via Restricting Unsafe Information Flows
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) equipped with multimodal attention (MM-Attn) have become a dominant paradigm for image generation. However, preventing the generation of harmful content remains a critical challenge, particularly in image-to-image (I2I) editing tasks. Existing safety mechanisms are primarily designed for text-to-image (T2I) synthesis or U-Net-based architectures, which limits their effectiveness for unified safety mitigation in DiT-based frameworks. To bridge this gap, we propose Unified Visual Safety Regulator (UVR), a training-free safe generation framework that regulates unsafe semantics in generated images. UVR is grounded in an analysis of attention dynamics from the perspective of information flow in MM-Attn. We identify a task-independent start-up stage, during which unsafe semantics in output patches rapidly emerge and can be accurately localized, followed by task-specific semantic amplification and interference stages, where harmful signals are further propagated and entangled with benign content. Based on these observations, UVR mitigates unsafe generation through unified, targeted attention modulation and explicit restriction of harmful information flow over the identified unsafe output patches. Experiments across various concepts show that UVR achieves state-of-the-art safety performance by achieving 91% and 77% erase rate in image synthesis and editing tasks, while preserving visual quality and fidelity with minimal degradation. Code is available at https://github.com/deng12yx/UVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UVR，一种基于注意力机制调控的无训练安全生成框架，通过分析扩散变换器中多模态注意力的信息流动，识别不安全语义的产生阶段并进行针对性调控，在图像生成和编辑任务中实现高擦除率且保持视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有安全机制主要针对文生图或U-Net架构设计，难以有效应用于基于DiT框架的统一安全防护，尤其是在图到图编辑任务中，阻止有害内容生成仍是一大挑战。
AI.method: 通过分析MM-Attn中信息流动的注意力动态，识别出任务无关的启动阶段（不安全语义快速出现并可定位）、任务相关的语义放大与干扰阶段；基于此，UVR通过统一的针对性注意力调制和对不安全输出块的显式信息流限制来缓解有害生成。
AI.result: 在图像合成任务中达到91%的擦除率，在编辑任务中达到77%的擦除率，同时视觉质量退化最小。
AI.conclusion: UVR是一种无训练的安全生成框架，适用于DiT架构的统一安全防护，在保持图像质量的同时有效抑制不安全内容的生成。

title: Think Fast: Estimating No-CoT Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
summary: Many efforts to ensure frontier AI models are safe rely on monitoring their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. If models become able to perform sufficiently complex reasoning internally, without explicit thinking tokens, this would undermine such oversight. We measure how well frontier models reason without CoT across a suite of over 30,000 questions spanning 43 benchmarks in domains including math, coding, puzzles, causality, theory-of-mind, and strategic reasoning. To compare models against humans, we estimate the $50\%$-task-completion time horizon (TH): the human time required for tasks a model completes with $50\%$ success rate. We complement this with a $50\%$ reasoning token horizon: the minimum number of o3-mini reasoning tokens needed for tasks a model solves with $50\%$ success rate. We find that the no-CoT $50\%$ TH of frontier models has been doubling roughly every year over the past six years, with GPT-5.5's TH reaching over 3 minutes and reasoning token horizon exceeding 1,500 tokens. Our median estimates predict that frontier no-CoT THs could exceed 7 minutes by 2028, and 25 minutes by 2030, though these projections carry substantial uncertainty. We recommend frontier developers track this explicitly.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了前沿AI模型在没有链式思维（CoT）推理情况下的能力，通过超过3万个问题、43个基准测试发现，无CoT模型的50%任务完成时间每约翻倍一次，GPT-5.5已超过3分钟和1500个推理token，预计到2028年可超过7分钟、2030年超过25分钟。
AI.motivation: 当前对前沿AI模型的安全监控依赖于对其链式思维推理过程的可观测性。如果模型能够在不产生显式推理token的情况下进行足够复杂的内部推理，现有的安全监控手段将失效。因此需要量化评估模型无CoT推理的能力现状与增长趋势。
AI.method: 使用包含43个基准、超过3万个问题的评测套件，涵盖数学、编程、谜题、因果推理、心理理论和策略推理等领域。通过50%任务完成时间视界（TH）和50%推理token视界两个指标，将模型性能与人类表现及o3-mini推理token数量进行对比。
AI.result: 过去六年间，前沿模型的无CoT 50% TH大约每年翻一番。GPT-5.5的TH已超过3分钟，推理token视界超过1500个token。中位预测显示，到2028年无CoT TH可能超过7分钟，到2030年可能超过25分钟。
AI.conclusion: 模型在不使用显式推理token情况下解决复杂任务的能力正在快速提升，这可能削弱依赖CoT监控的安全措施。建议前沿开发者明确追踪这一趋势。

title: Didact: A Cross-Domain Capability Discovery System for Defence
comment: Under Review at CIKM 2026 (System Demonstration Track)
summary: Policymakers in defence and defence-aligned sectors must monitor rapidly evolving research alongside sector priorities relevant to operational and strategic needs. In practice, these sources are fragmented across heterogeneous formats, disjoint repositories, and siloed update streams, making capability discovery slow and difficult to audit. We present Didact, a prototype that integrates publicly available defence reports and policy documents from Australia with a purpose-built knowledge graph derived from Australian research publications. Didact provides natural language conversations for policy-oriented workflows, and leverages a composite retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. A key feature of Didact is an interactive Evidence Rail that visualises retrieved evidence and source relationships. Our evaluation of the output quality and runtime of Didact highlights its utility. While Didact has been co-developed as an academia-industry project for the Australian context, it is adaptable to other domains where knowledge is similarly fragmented. A demonstration video is available here:

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Didact，一个整合澳大利亚国防政策和研究出版物的原型系统，通过知识图谱和RAG技术实现自然语言交互，并提供了可视化证据轨功能。
AI.motivation: 国防领域的政策制定者需要监控快速演进的研究，但相关信息分散在不同格式、仓库和更新流中，导致能力发现缓慢且难以审计。
AI.method: Didact整合了澳大利亚公开的国防报告与政策文件，并构建了专门的知识图谱。系统采用复合检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，支持面向政策工作流的自然语言对话，核心功能是可交互的"证据轨"（Evidence Rail）可视化界面。
AI.result: 对输出质量和运行时的评估证明了Didact的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该系统作为学术界-工业界合作项目为澳大利亚语境开发，但可适配其他知识同样碎片化的领域。

title: FreeAnimate: Training-Free Human Image Animation with Preview-Guided Denoising
summary: Human Image Animation has seen significant advancements, primarily driven by diffusion models. However, existing methods typically demand substantial training data and resources to achieve high-quality results, limiting generalization and accessibility. In this work, we introduce \emph{FreeAnimate}, a training-free framework that leverages the inherent capabilities of image diffusion models to enable temporal consistency, identity preservation, and background stability. Our approach incorporates a novel preview generation strategy that provides temporal and structural priors from generated preview frames, effectively guiding pose alignment and background consistency without training. Additionally, FreeAnimate introduces Inversion-Boosted Attention and Reference-Anchored Self-Attention modules to guarantee temporal consistency and identity preservation. Experimental results demonstrate that FreeAnimate outperforms existing training-free competitors and training-based baseline methods, achieving generation quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods and offering robust generalization across diverse datasets. Our project page is at https://freeani.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FreeAnimate是一种无需训练的人体图像动画框架，通过利用预训练扩散模型的固有能力、预览生成策略和注意力机制模块，实现了时间一致性、身份保持和背景稳定性，性能优于现有无训练方法和部分有训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的人体图像动画方法通常需要大量训练数据和计算资源才能达到高质量效果，限制了泛化能力和可访问性。因此，作者希望设计一种无需额外训练的框架来降低资源需求。
AI.method: 1）预览生成策略：从生成的预览帧中获取时间和结构先验，引导姿态对齐和背景一致性。2）反演增强注意力（Inversion-Boosted Attention）：保证时间一致性。3）参考锚定自注意力（Reference-Anchored Self-Attention）：确保身份保持。
AI.result: FreeAnimate在生成质量上优于现有的无训练竞争方法和基于训练的部分基线方法，达到了与最先进方法相当的水平，并在多种数据集上展示了强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需额外训练的人体图像动画框架FreeAnimate，通过巧妙的注意力机制和预览策略克服了传统方法的资源瓶颈，兼顾了时间一致性、身份保持和背景稳定性，具有良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: TOPSIS-RAD: Ranking According to Desires
comment: 21 pages, 15 Tables and 6 figures. The numerical computation of the data that appear in the Toy Examples was Supported by the Visual TOPSIS RAD that is available at https://topsis-ranking.vercel.app/. The data of the Toy examples are also available in this URL and can be loaded in the app as the template "Article"
summary: Traditional TOPSIS derives its reference points -- the Positive Ideal Solution ($PIS$) and Negative Ideal Solution ($NIS$) -- from the observed alternative set, making rankings susceptible to misalignment with decision-maker (DM) requirements, sensitivity to outlier performances, and rank reversal. This paper proposes TOPSIS-RAD, which addresses these issues by incorporating two arrays of DM-defined reference levels. Vetoed Performance Levels ($VPL$) exclude non-viable alternatives before normalisation, preventing them from distorting the ranking frontiers. Desired Performance Levels ($DPL$) cap performances at the DM's desired level before normalisation, anchoring the $PIS$ in explicit aspirations rather than dataset extremes. Three toy examples demonstrate each mechanism: $VPL$ reshapes normalisation boundaries by removing a non-viable alternative; fixed $DPL$ frontiers stabilise rankings by limiting the influence of performances well above the desired level. The method preserves the familiar distance-based structure of TOPSIS while grounding the ranking in stable, DM-specified boundaries. Limitations and future research directions are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOPSIS-RAD方法，通过引入决策者定义的两个参考水平（VPL和DPL）来解决传统TOPSIS存在的排名反转、异常值敏感等问题，使排名更稳定且符合决策者意图。
AI.motivation: 传统TOPSIS的正负理想解完全依赖观测到的备选方案集，导致排名容易偏离决策者需求、对异常值敏感且存在排名反转问题。
AI.method: 提出TOPSIS-RAD方法，引入两组决策者定义的参考水平：VPL（否决绩效水平）在标准化前排除不可行方案，DPL（期望绩效水平）在标准化前对绩效进行上限处理，将PIS锚定在决策者的明确期望上。
AI.result: 三个玩具示例验证了机制有效性：VPL通过移除不可行方案重塑标准化边界；固定DPL边界通过限制过高绩效的影响来稳定排名。
AI.conclusion: TOPSIS-RAD保留了TOPSIS的距离结构，同时将排名建立在稳定且由决策者指定的边界上，使排名更符合决策者意图且更稳健。

title: Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs: LoRA-MINT
comment: IEEE Conf. on Computers, Software, and Applications (COMPSAC), 2026
summary: We present LoRA-MINT, a new methodology for Membership Inference Test (MINT) applied to recent Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned for specific Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The primary goal is to assess whether individual samples were part of the training data of these adapted models, providing a useful auditing tool for the management of intellectual property and sensitive data. Our analysis explores the relationship between model perplexity and membership status, providing a systematic framework for estimating data exposure in fine-tuned LLMs. We conducted experiments on four models and three benchmark datasets, obtaining precision values in determining if given data were used for training ranging from 0.77 to 0.92, which outperform state-of-the-art baselines and demonstrate the robustness and generality of the proposed method. In general, our findings underscore the potential of LoRA-MINT as an effective and scalable framework for auditing LLMs, improving transparency, and fostering the ethical and responsible deployment of AI and NLP technologies. For the sake of concreteness and current relevance, our discussion and experiments are centered on LoRAadjusted LLMs, but note that most of the presented methodology is easily applicable for auditing training data given any other technique for adapting LLMs or, more generally, any other domain-adapted AI models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoRA-MINT，一种针对LoRA微调的大型语言模型进行成员推断测试的方法，通过困惑度分析判断样本是否属于训练数据，在四个模型和三个基准数据集上取得了0.77-0.92的精确度，优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 为LoRA微调的LLM提供一种有效的成员推断测试工具，用于审计训练数据是否泄露，管理知识产权和敏感数据。
AI.method: 通过分析模型困惑度与成员状态之间的关系，构建系统框架来估计LoRA微调LLM中的数据暴露程度。
AI.result: 在四个模型和三个基准数据集上，精确度达到0.77-0.92，优于现有最先进基线方法，验证了方法的鲁棒性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: LoRA-MINT是一种有效且可扩展的LLM审计框架，可提升透明度，促进AI/NLP技术的伦理与负责任部署，且方法可推广至其他领域自适应AI模型。

title: DuMate-DeepResearch: An Auditable Multi-Agent System with Recursive Search and Rubric-Grounded Reasoning
comment: Technical report by the DuMate Team. 26 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables
summary: Deep Research (DR) has emerged as a new agentic paradigm to tackle complex, open-ended research tasks, demanding systems that can iteratively frame problems, acquire evidence, verify sources, and synthesize long-form reports. In practice, however, current DR systems are constrained by four interrelated limitations: long-horizon planning over an underspecified scope, the bottleneck of decomposing and scheduling such tasks within a single agent, hallucination risk in long-form synthesis, and limited process auditability. This technical report presents DuMate-DeepResearch, a multi-agent DR framework built on the Qianfan Agent Foundry. The framework decouples the Agent Core, which handles task understanding, planning, and scheduling, from an extensible Tool Ecosystem for retrieval, evidence acquisition, and report rendering, making every intermediate decision and tool invocation explicitly traceable. Building on this infrastructure, DuMate-DeepResearch further introduces three mechanisms: (i) a graph-based dynamic planning strategy expands the research roadmap coarse-to-fine and continuously revises it through reflection, re-planning, backtracking, and parallel branching; (ii) a recursive two-level execution design delegates each complex search sub-task to an inner Search Agent that runs its own planning loop, isolating noisy retrieval and stabilizing long-horizon execution; (iii) a rubric-based test-time optimization mechanism dynamically generates task-specific quality criteria and uses them as live reasoning scaffolds for evidence-grounded synthesis and adaptive stopping. Across two deep research benchmarks, DuMate-DeepResearch establishes new state-of-the-art results: the best overall score (58.03%) on DeepResearch Bench, and the best overall score (61.95%) on DeepResearch Bench II while ranking first in information recall and analysis.

AI.tldr: DuMate-DeepResearch 是一个基于多智能体框架的深度研究系统，通过图规划、递归执行和测试时优化三大机制，在 DeepResearch Bench 和 DeepResearch Bench II 上取得最佳成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究（DR）系统面临长程规划、单智能体任务分解瓶颈、长文本合成中的幻觉风险以及过程可审计性差等四方面限制。
AI.method: 提出多智能体 DR 框架，解耦智能体核心与工具生态；引入三大机制：基于图的动态规划策略（粗到细展开研究路线图）、递归两级执行设计（内层搜索智能体独立规划）、基于评估准则的测试时优化（动态生成质量标准并作为推理支架）。
AI.result: 在 DeepResearch Bench 上取得 58.03% 的最佳总分，在 DeepResearch Bench II 上取得 61.95% 的最佳总分，信息召回与分析排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了现有深度研究系统的核心局限，通过显式可追溯的中间决策与工具调用，实现了更可靠、可审计的长程研究任务执行。

title: OpenHalDet: A Unified Benchmark for Hallucination Detection across Diverse Generation Scenarios
comment: Preprint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Nellie179/Hallucination-Detection
summary: Hallucination detection is essential for the reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs). However, existing evaluations face two core challenges: inconsistent inference configuration and evaluation, and limited coverage of downstream domains and tasks. Consequently, reported detector performance is often difficult to compare, reproduce, and generalize beyond specific experimental settings. We introduce OpenHalDet, a unified benchmark for hallucination detection across diverse generation scenarios. OpenHalDet standardizes the evaluation pipeline, from prompt construction and response generation to truthfulness annotation, detector scoring, and metric computation. It supports heterogeneous detector families under different access settings, including black-box methods that use only generated outputs, gray-box methods that rely on probability-based signals, and white-box methods that exploit internal model signals. By bringing diverse tasks, models, and detectors into a shared framework, OpenHalDet enables controlled comparison and provides a systematic view of how different detection paradigms behave in LLM applications. We release OpenHalDet as an open and extensible codebase to facilitate reproducible evaluation and future development of hallucination detection methods. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Nellie179/Hallucination-Detection.

AI.tldr: OpenHalDet 是一个统一的幻觉检测基准，通过标准化评估流程（从提示构建到指标计算），支持黑盒、灰盒、白盒三种检测方法，解决了现有评估中配置不一致、领域覆盖有限的问题，便于可重复比较和泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型幻觉检测评估存在两个核心问题：推理配置与评估不一致，以及下游领域和任务覆盖有限，导致检测器性能难以比较、复现和泛化。
AI.method: 构建统一基准 OpenHalDet，标准化评估流程（提示构建→响应生成→真实性标注→检测器评分→指标计算），支持黑盒（仅输出）、灰盒（概率信号）、白盒（内部模型信号）三类检测器，整合多种任务、模型和检测器到统一框架中。
AI.result: 实现了可控比较，提供了不同检测范式在LLM应用中的系统性能视图，并开源了代码和数据集以促进可重复评估。
AI.conclusion: OpenHalDet 通过标准化和统一化框架，有效解决了幻觉检测评估的不可比较性和不可复现性问题，为未来方法开发提供了可扩展的基础。

title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently rely on language priors, producing confident answers that are weakly grounded in visual evidence. While this behavior is widely observed, its internal mechanisms and its impact on benchmark evaluation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study language-prior reliance from both mechanistic and behavioral perspectives. Internally, we combine counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace how ground-truth visual semantics and language-prior semantics compete across the language decoder. Our analysis reveals a multi-stage bottleneck: intermediate layers often fail to effectively retrieve visual information, while later layers can further suppress surviving visual signals in favor of text-space biases. Externally, we introduce a progressive visual decay metric based on multi-step Gaussian blurring, which identifies instances whose answers remain invariant even as visual content is increasingly destroyed. Across twelve visual question-answering benchmarks and three representative VLMs, we find that a substantial fraction of examples remain answerable under severe or total visual obfuscation, indicating that current benchmarks can inadvertently reward visual ignorance. These findings demonstrate that language-prior reliance is a systematic routing failure affecting both model internals and benchmark validity. Finally, we outline critical pathways for future research, highlighting the necessity of designing training distributions and evaluation protocols built on structurally isolated or counterfactual data to enforce genuine cross-modal grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制和行为两个层面系统研究了视觉语言模型中的语言先验依赖问题，发现模型内部存在多阶段瓶颈导致视觉信息被压制，并通过渐进视觉退化指标揭示了当前基准测试可能无意中奖励“视觉无知”的现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究观察到VLM过度依赖语言先验而忽视视觉证据，但其内部机制和该行为对基准评测的影响仍未被充分理解。
AI.method: 内部机制上结合反事实层替换与监督式逐层MLP探测，追踪视觉语义与语言先验语义在语言解码器中的竞争过程；外部行为上提出基于多步高斯模糊的渐进视觉退化指标，评估模型在视觉信息不断损坏下答案的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现中间层无法有效检索视觉信息，后续层进一步压制视觉信号以强化文本偏差；在12个VQA基准和3个代表性VLM上，大量样本在严重甚至完全视觉遮挡下仍能被正确回答，说明当前基准可能无意奖励视觉忽视。
AI.conclusion: 语言先验依赖是一个系统性的路由失败，影响模型内部机制和基准有效性；未来需要基于结构隔离或反事实数据设计训练分布和评估协议，以强制实现真正的跨模态对齐。

title: Off-Policy Evaluation with Strategic Agents via Local Disclosure
summary: We study off-policy evaluation (OPE) under strategic behavior where decision subjects (or agents) respond to a decision maker's policy by strategically modifying their covariates.
