GP-Adapter constructs modality-specific, class-wise one-class GPs on top of frozen CLIP embeddings using an RBF kernel for image features and a linear kernel for text prompts and fuses their predictive statistics to produce a variance-aware confidence score for OOD detection. The method requires no fine-tuning of the CLIP backbone and relies only on a small $K$-shot cache and lightweight hyperparameter selection, with memory cost scaling as $O(CK^2)$ for $C$ classes and $K$ shots. Experiments on ImageNet and multiple OOD benchmarks show that GP-Adapter provides competitive few-shot performance and consistently improves OOD detection when combined with prompt-learning baselines, highlighting the complementarity between GP-based uncertainty modeling and prompt learning. Overall, our results suggest that integrating probabilistic inference with large pre-trained vision-language models can improve reliability in low-data and distribution-shifted settings. Code is available at https://github.com/tms-byte/GP-Adapter

AI.tldr: GP-Adapter是一种无需训练即可为CLIP模型添加高斯过程不确定性建模的框架，用于少样本分类和分布外检测，在ImageNet和多个OOD基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: CLIP在零样本识别中表现强劲，但产生的确定性相似分数缺乏不确定性信息，这在分布偏移和数据稀缺情况下至关重要。
AI.method: 在冻结的CLIP嵌入之上，为图像特征使用RBF核、为文本提示使用线性核构建模态特定、类别级的一类高斯过程，融合预测统计量产生方差感知的置信度分数用于OOD检测，无需微调CLIP骨干网络。
AI.result: 在ImageNet和多个OOD基准上，GP-Adapter提供了有竞争力的少样本性能，与提示学习基线结合时持续改进OOD检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 将概率推理与大规模预训练视觉-语言模型相结合，可以提高低数据和分布偏移场景下的可靠性。

title: Supervision versus Demonstration-Based In-Context Learning for Multiword Expression Classification
summary: Turkish idiomatic light verb constructions (LVCs) are challenging for multiword expression processing because they often share the same surface form as fully literal verb-object combinations while functioning as a single, partially idiomatic predicate. We frame Turkish LVC detection as a binary classification task (literal meaning vs. idiomatic meaning) and evaluate on a manually created controlled set (N=147) with matched negatives: out-of-domain random sentences and in-domain literal controls (NLVC), alongside LVC positives. We compare a supervised Turkish encoder baseline (BERTurk with a classifier head) to three instruction-tuned LLMs from different families under zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot prompting, and analyze how demonstrations shift error profiles. In zero-shot, LLMs perform well on negatives but show very low LVC recall. One-shot prompting sharply improves LVC detection but can induce strong, model-specific biases, leading models to overpredict or underpredict LVCs. A richer few-shot prompt improves calibration and yields robust overall performance for GPT-OSS-20B and Qwen 2.5-14B. Overall, the results highlight substantial prompt sensitivity in Turkish metalinguistic classification: the supervised baseline remains competitive, while prompted LLMs can match or exceed it on LVCs with carefully constructed demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本研究将土耳其语惯用轻动词结构检测建模为二分类任务，比较了监督模型BERTurk与三种指令微调大语言模型在零样本、一样本和少样本提示下的表现。结果表明，LLMs在零样本下召回率低，一样本提示虽提升检测但引入模型偏差，少样本提示能改善校准效果，GPT-OSS-20B和Qwen 2.5-14B表现稳健。总体而言，提示敏感性显著，监督基线仍具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 土耳其语惯用轻动词结构在形式上与字面动词-宾语组合相同，但功能上作为部分惯用谓语，给多词表达处理带来挑战。现有方法难以有效区分其字面义与惯用义，需要更有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 将LVC检测作为二分类任务，使用人工构建的平衡数据集（N=147），包含LVC正例、域外随机句子和域内字面控制负例。对比监督模型BERTurk（加分类头）与三种指令微调大语言模型（GPT-OSS-20B、Qwen 2.5-14B等），采用零样本、一样本和少样本提示策略，并分析演示样本对错误分布的影响。
AI.result: 零样本下LLMs对负例表现良好但对LVC召回率极低；一样本提示显著提升LVC检测但引入模型特定偏差（过度或不足预测）；少样本提示改善校准效果，GPT-OSS-20B和Qwen 2.5-14B取得稳健性能；监督基线BERTurk仍具竞争力，LLMs在精心构建演示样本时可匹敌或超越基线。
AI.conclusion: 土耳其语元语言分类任务对提示高度敏感，少样本提示可有效提升LLMs的LVC检测性能，但提示设计需谨慎以避免偏差；监督模型仍是可靠基准，LLMs在特定条件下可超越监督方法。

title: 3DMorph: Single-Image-Guided Local 3D Shape Editing and Morphing
summary: Despite recent progress in 3D generation, intuitive editing of existing shapes remains limited. Unlike images, which benefit from well-established inpainting tools, general 3D objects such as meshes still lack simple and effective methods for local shape editing. Existing approaches are often global, domain-specific, require complex user interaction, or focus on appearance (color and texture) rather than geometry. We introduce 3DMorph, a training-free framework for single-image-guided local 3D shape editing and morphing. Given an edited image showing a desired shape modification, our method automatically localizes the relevant 3D region and transfers 2D modifications to 3D while preserving unmodified areas. 3DMorph also enables intermediate shape generation between the original and edited objects, facilitating design exploration. To benchmark editing quality, we introduce Delta3D, an image-guided local 3D editing benchmark with paired ground-truth edits. Experimental results show that 3DMorph translates intuitive 2D edits into 3D, outperforming state-of-the-art generative and editing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3DMorph，一种无需训练的框架，利用单张编辑图像实现局部3D形状编辑和变形，并引入Delta3D基准数据集，实验表明该方法优于现有生成和编辑方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D形状编辑方法多为全局性、领域特定、需要复杂用户交互，或仅关注外观（颜色和纹理）而非几何形状，缺乏类似图像修复工具的简单有效的局部形状编辑方法。
AI.method: 给定一张显示所需形状修改的编辑图像，3DMorph自动定位相关3D区域，将2D修改迁移到3D，同时保留未修改区域；支持在原始和编辑后的对象之间生成中间形状。
AI.result: 实验结果表明3DMorph能将直观的2D编辑转化为3D编辑，在编辑质量上超越现有的最先进生成和编辑方法。同时构建了Delta3D基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: 3DMorph提供了一种无需训练、单图引导的局部3D几何编辑方法，填补了3D形状直观编辑的空白，有助于设计探索。

title: Your UnEmbedding Matrix is Secretly a Feature Lens for Text Embeddings
summary: Large language models exhibit impressive zero-shot capabilities across a wide range of downstream tasks. However, they struggle to function as off-the-shelf embedding models, leading to suboptimal performance on massive text embedding benchmarks. In this paper, we identify a potential cause underlying this deficiency. Our motivation stems from an unexpected observation: text embeddings tend to align with frequent but uninformative tokens when projected onto the vocabulary space. We argue that this excessive expression of high-frequency tokens suppresses the model's ability to capture nuanced semantics. To address this, we introduce EmbedFilter, a simple linear transformation designed to refine text embeddings derived from LLMs directly. Specifically, we uncover that the unembedding matrix within LLMs encodes a latent space that is actively writing these frequent tokens into embedding space. By filtering out this subspace, EmbedFilter suppress the influence of high-frequency tokens, thereby enhancing semantic representations. As a compelling byproduct, this enables an inherent dimensionality reduction, lowering index storage and speedup retrieval while fully preserving the refined embedding quality. Our experiments across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that LLMs equipped with EmbedFilter achieve superior zero-shot downstream performance even with significantly reduced embedding dimensions. We hope our findings provide deeper insights into the mechanisms of LLM-based representations and inspire more principled designs to improve text embeddings training. Our code is available at https://github.com/CentreChen/EmbFilter.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM文本嵌入倾向于与高频但信息量少的token对齐，提出EmbedFilter方法通过过滤掉高频token子空间来改善语义表示，并实现降维加速检索。
AI.motivation: LLM在零样本下游任务中表现优异，但作为现成的嵌入模型效果不佳。作者观察到文本嵌入在投影到词汇空间时会与高频但无信息的token对齐，这种高频token的过度表达抑制了模型捕捉细微语义的能力。
AI.method: 提出EmbedFilter，一种简单的线性变换方法。利用LLM内部的unembedding矩阵编码的潜在空间（该空间会将高频token写入嵌入空间），通过过滤掉这个子空间来抑制高频token的影响。
AI.result: 在多个LLM骨干网络上，EmbedFilter在显著降低嵌入维度的同时，实现了更优的零样本下游任务性能；同时实现索引存储降低和检索加速。
AI.conclusion: 提供对LLM表示机制的深入见解，为改进文本嵌入训练提供更原则性的设计思路。代码已开源。

title: Native3D: End-to-End 3D Scene Generation via Unified Mesh-Texture Modeling and Semantic Alignment
summary: This paper presents Native3D, the first end-to-end 3D scene generation framework that completely bypasses 2D intermediate representations. Traditional approaches typically require adapting 3D representations to the 2D domain to leverage pre-trained diffusion models, which inevitably introduces domain adaptation issues including geometric structural distortion and texture detail degradation. To address these limitations, we design a unified mesh-texture joint representation that simultaneously models both geometric structures and texture features through a Transformer-based scene encoder, effectively maintaining spatial relationships and visual consistency among objects within scenes. We further propose the 3D Representation Alignment Loss (3D REPA Loss), which employs an improved contrastive learning mechanism to align multi-level semantic representations in the latent space, significantly enhancing geometric and textural fidelity. Experimental results demonstrate that Native3D outperforms existing methods in both generation quality and editing flexibility, providing a novel solution for 3D scene editing.

AI.tldr: Native3D是首个完全绕过2D中间表示的端到端3D场景生成框架，通过统一的网格-纹理联合表示和3D REPA Loss，在生成质量和编辑灵活性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要将3D表示适配到2D域以利用预训练扩散模型，导致几何结构失真和纹理细节退化等问题，本文旨在解决这一领域适配问题。
AI.method: 1) 设计统一的网格-纹理联合表示，通过基于Transformer的场景编码器同时建模几何结构和纹理特征；2) 提出3D表示对齐损失(3D REPA Loss)，采用改进的对比学习机制对齐潜在空间中的多级语义表示。
AI.result: Native3D在生成质量和编辑灵活性方面均优于现有方法，能够有效保持场景内物体的空间关系和视觉一致性。
AI.conclusion: Native3D为3D场景编辑提供了一种新颖的端到端解决方案，完全避免了2D中间表示带来的领域适配问题。

title: Agentopia: Long-Term Life Simulation and Learning in Agent Societies
summary: Humans learn from social life. Simulating this process with LLM-powered agents represents a promising research direction, raising a natural question: whether LLMs can learn from such simulated social experience to better understand and replicate human behavior. However, prior agent society simulations typically operate at the scale of days, limiting the depth of social interactions and long-term growth. In this paper, we study long-term life simulation and LLM learning in agent societies, with two goals: (1) investigating social behaviors that emerge from life-long simulation, and (2) developing anthropomorphic capabilities in LLMs, particularly intelligence in social life, through years of simulated social experience. Specifically, we present Agentopia, a comprehensive framework for long-term life simulation in multi-agent societies, where 100 agents autonomously pursue personal growth, develop social relationships, and fulfill their needs and goals over 10 simulated years. We define life reward to mirror human well-being, and leverage this reward to train LLMs via rejection sampling. Extensive experiments show that agents exhibit rich emergent social behaviors. Furthermore, life reward training effectively enhances the underlying LLM, which leads to improved agent well-being in simulation, and generalizes to downstream role-playing benchmarks with +15.6% improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agentopia框架，在包含100个智能体的多智能体社会中模拟10年的长期生活，利用生活奖励通过拒绝采样训练LLM，实验表明智能体展现出丰富的涌现社会行为，且训练后的LLM在角色扮演基准上提升了15.6%。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM能否从模拟的社会经验中学习，以更好地理解和复现人类行为，特别是通过长期生命模拟发展LLM的拟人化能力。
AI.method: 构建Agentopia框架，在100个智能体的多智能体社会中模拟10年长期生活；定义反映人类福祉的"生活奖励"，并通过拒绝采样训练LLM。
AI.result: 智能体在长期模拟中涌现出丰富的社交行为；生活奖励训练有效提升了底层LLM的性能，在模拟中改善了智能体福祉，并在下游角色扮演基准上取得+15.6%的提升。
AI.conclusion: 长期社会模拟和基于生活奖励的训练能够有效增强LLM的社交生活智能，并泛化到下游任务。

title: Consistent-Inversion: Reverse Consistency Guidance for Structure-Preserving Visual Editing
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia; 10 pages, 4 figures
summary: Text-guided diffusion models have become effective tools for real-image visual editing, where the edited image must follow a target instruction while preserving editing-irrelevant structure. Most training-free editors rely on inversion: a source image is mapped to a noisy latent trajectory and the terminal latent is reused for target-prompt denoising. This reuse is useful for preservation, but it also couples source reconstruction and target editing. The resulting trajectory mismatch may either damage background/layout details or over-constrain the intended edit. This paper presents Consistent-Inversion, a training-free reverse consistency guidance framework for structure-preserving visual editing. Instead of treating the inverted source latent as a fixed initialization, Consistent-Inversion checks whether an intermediate target trajectory can be reversed toward the source inversion trajectory under the source prompt. To make this check well-defined, we construct an auxiliary target-side noise representation, perform source-guided reverse denoising, and use the resulting reverse consistency discrepancy as a correction signal for selected early target denoising steps. The method does not update model parameters, is compatible with inversion-based editors, and introduces only a small inference overhead when applied sparsely. Experiments on PIE-Bench show that Consistent-Inversion improves background and structural fidelity under a unified SD3.5 protocol while maintaining target-prompt alignment, and compatibility experiments further verify the same correction principle on classical Stable-Diffusion inversion pipelines.

AI.tldr: Consistent-Inversion是一种无需训练的逆向一致性引导框架，通过检查目标轨迹能否逆向回到源反转轨迹，并利用逆向一致性差异修正早期去噪步骤，从而在保持目标提示对齐的同时提升背景和结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反转的免训练编辑方法中，源图像的反转潜变量被直接复用于目标提示去噪，导致源重建与目标编辑耦合，产生轨迹不匹配，进而破坏背景/布局细节或过度约束编辑效果。
AI.method: 构建辅助目标侧噪声表示，执行源引导的逆向去噪，计算逆向一致性差异作为修正信号，稀疏地应用于早期目标去噪步骤中，无需更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench上，采用统一的SD3.5协议，Consistent-Inversion提升了背景和结构保真度，同时保持了目标提示对齐；在经典Stable-Diffusion反转流水线上也验证了相同的修正原理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架与基于反转的编辑器兼容，仅增加少量推理开销，有效改善了结构保持型视觉编辑的性能。

title: How reliable are LLMs when it comes to playing dice?
summary: We investigate the probabilistic reasoning capabilities of large language models through a controlled benchmarking study on discrete probability problems. We constructed two datasets, respectively a set of standard exercises and a set of counterintuitive exercises, designed to trigger heuristic reasoning, and evaluated 8 state-of-the-art models, each tested with and without Chain-of-Thought prompting. Models achieve an average accuracy of 0.96 on standard problems but only 0.59 on counterintuitive ones. We further provide empirical evidence of token bias: performance drops by over 20% when canonical formulations are replaced by disguised variants. Embedding misleading suggestions in the prompt reduces performance by up to 34%, with no model proving immune. Taken together, the reported findings suggest that current LLMs are not yet genuine probabilistic reasoners, despite their success in advanced mathematical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建标准与反直觉两类概率问题数据集，测试了8种大语言模型（含思维链提示）的概率推理能力。模型在标准问题上准确率达0.96，但在反直觉问题上仅0.59；令牌偏差导致性能下降超20%，误导性提示使性能下降高达34%，表明当前LLM并非真正的概率推理器。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在离散概率问题上的真实推理能力，特别是面对反直觉问题时的表现，以及token偏差和误导性提示对模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建标准练习和反直觉练习两类数据集，对8种最新模型进行基准测试，每种模型分别在有/无思维链提示条件下评估，并设计伪装变体和误导性提示进行对照实验。
AI.result: 标准问题准确率0.96，反直觉问题仅0.59；规范表述改为伪装变体后性能下降超20%；误导性提示使性能下降高达34%，且无模型完全免疫。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM在高级数学问题上表现成功，但它们目前还不是真正的概率推理器，在面对反直觉问题、令牌偏差和误导性提示时表现脆弱。

title: TraRA: Trajectory-level Recognition Aggregation for Video Text Spotting in Urban Surveillance
comment: 22nd IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems
summary: Video Text Spotting (VTS) is essential for urban surveillance and intelligent transportation systems, enabling automated reading of street signs, vehicle markings, and scene text in video streams. However, reliable recognition remains challenging due to dynamic video factors common in surveillance scenarios, including motion blur, occlusion, and scale variation, which degrade frame-level recognition. Existing VTS methods typically perform recognition independently on each frame, leading to inconsistent and inaccurate results across sequences. To address these limitations, we propose TraRA (Trajectory-level Recognition Aggregation for VTS), a plug-and-play method that performs trajectory-level text recognition by leveraging temporal and multimodal consistency. TraRA integrates two key modules: (1) the Temporal Clustering and (2) the Vision-Language Aggregation. The former refines noisy trajectories by grouping temporally and visually coherent text instances, while the latter employs a Low-Rank Adaptation-enhanced Vision-Language model to fuse visual cues with linguistic context across frames. By aggregating information over entire text trajectories, TraRA achieves robust text recognition even under challenging surveillance conditions. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks, including road and urban scene datasets (RoadText, BOVText, ArTVideo, and ICDAR15), demonstrate that TraRA consistently improves tracking and recognition performance over state-of-the-art VTS methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/trid2912/TraRA.

AI.tldr: TraRA是一种即插即用的轨迹级文本识别聚合方法，通过时间聚类和视觉-语言聚合模块，有效提升视频文本检测与识别在监控场景下的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频文本识别方法逐帧独立处理，导致动态视频因素（运动模糊、遮挡、尺度变化）下识别结果不一致且不准确。
AI.method: 提出TraRA方法，包含两个核心模块：(1) 时间聚类模块，通过分组时间与视觉一致的文本实例来优化噪声轨迹；(2) 视觉-语言聚合模块，利用LoRA增强的视觉-语言模型融合跨帧的视觉线索与语言上下文。
AI.result: 在RoadText、BOVText、ArTVideo和ICDAR15四个公开基准数据集上，TraRA持续提升了视频文本跟踪与识别性能，优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: TraRA通过轨迹级信息聚合，在监控等具有挑战性的场景下实现了鲁棒的文本识别，且作为即插即用模块易于集成到现有VTS系统中。

title: When Recovery Matters: The Blind Spot of Surrogate Privacy in MLLM Editing
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) enable flexible instruction-driven image editing, but privacy risks arise when user images expose diverse and user-specific private content. Canonical privacy protection strategies typically substitute sensitive regions with surrogate content before cloud editing. Yet, the resulting output is often an edited surrogate rather than the desired edited source image, neglecting the local recovery in both design and evaluation scope. To this end, we introduce SPPE (Surrogate-based Privacy-Preserving Editing), the first recovery-oriented benchmark covering 36 fine-grained privacy categories and 65 editing instructions. It defines two complementary tasks: 1) editability assessment, which estimates before cloud interaction whether a surrogate can induce an edit consistent with the original image; and 2) surrogate-to-source edit recovery, which evaluates whether the edited surrogate can be transferred back to the private source with the edit effect preserved. We address each task with a dedicated method: ERMA predicts surrogate editability through instruction-aware multimodal relation modeling, while \method performs cycle-consistent recovery by using the surrogate editing pair as visual edit evidence and the source image as a source-preserving anchor. Experiments on SPPE and InstructPix2Pix show consistent improvements on both tasks. For editability assessment, ERMA improves over the best-performing baselines by 13.9% in SRCC and 12.3% in PLCC. For surrogate-to-source edit recovery, C2E-S2SER outperforms SOER across all 8 source integrity and edit consistency metrics on SPPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPPE基准和两种方法（ERMA和C2E-S2SER），用于解决多模态大语言模型图像编辑中的隐私保护问题，核心思路是通过替身图像进行隐私保护编辑，并在编辑后恢复原始图像效果。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护策略在云编辑前用替身内容替换敏感区域，但输出的是编辑后的替身而非用户期望的原始图像编辑结果，缺乏局部恢复的设计与评估。
AI.method: 提出SPPE基准，涵盖36个细粒度隐私类别和65条编辑指令，定义两个任务：1) 可编辑性评估（ERMA方法，通过指令感知的多模态关系建模预测替身可编辑性）；2) 替身到源图像的编辑恢复（C2E-S2SER方法，通过循环一致性恢复，利用替身编辑对作为视觉证据，源图像作为保源锚点）。
AI.result: 在可编辑性评估上，ERMA的SRCC提升13.9%，PLCC提升12.3%；在替身到源编辑恢复上，C2E-S2SER在SPPE上所有8项源完整性和编辑一致性指标均优于SOER。
AI.conclusion: 提出的SPPE基准和两种方法有效解决了隐私保护图像编辑中的恢复问题，验证了循环一致性恢复范式的有效性。

title: Textual Supervision Enhances Geospatial Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Geospatial understanding is a critical yet underexplored dimension in the development of machine learning systems for tasks such as image geolocation and spatial reasoning. In this work, we analyze the geospatial representations acquired by three model families: vision-only architectures (e.g., ViT), vision-language models (e.g., CLIP), and large-scale multimodal foundation models (e.g., LLaVA, Qwen, and Gemma). By evaluating across image clusters, including people, landmarks, and everyday objects, grouped based on the degree of localizability, we reveal systematic gaps in spatial accuracy and show that textual supervision enhances the learning of geospatial representations. Our findings suggest the role of language as an effective complementary modality for encoding spatial context and multimodal learning as a key direction for advancing geospatial AI.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了视觉模型、视觉-语言模型和多模态基础模型在地理空间理解上的表现，发现文本监督能增强地理空间表征学习，语言可作为有效补充模态，多模态学习是推进地理空间AI的关键方向。
AI.motivation: 地理空间理解是机器学习系统（如图像地理定位和空间推理）中关键但尚未充分探索的维度，现有研究缺乏对模型获取地理空间表征的系统性分析。
AI.method: 评估三类模型族：纯视觉架构（如ViT）、视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）和大规模多模态基础模型（如LLaVA、Qwen、Gemma）。按可定位程度将图像聚类为人物、地标和日常物体进行跨类别评估。
AI.result: 揭示了空间准确性的系统性差距，并证明文本监督能够增强地理空间表征的学习。
AI.conclusion: 语言可作为编码空间上下文的有效补充模态，多模态学习是推进地理空间AI的关键方向。

title: Seeing Without Exposing: Adaptive Privacy Control for Open-World, Context-Hungry MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have raised new privacy challenges. On the data side, user-provided inputs often include unpredictable sensitive information; while on the downstream task side, model reasoning depends on rich visual context that may itself be privacy-sensitive. Existing privacy protection methods, however, rely on predefined sensitive categories and fixed obfuscation strategies, struggling to tackle such challenges in MLLMs. To address this dilemma, we propose Anchored Privacy Drifting (APD), a training-free method that drifts privacy-sensitive elements toward semantically equivalent alternatives while anchoring contextual cues to the source image. To systematically evaluate this dual objective of privacy protection and contextual preservation, we introduce AdaptShield, a comprehensive benchmark covering 22 privacy categories, which combines conventional privacy metrics with MLLM-based assessments of contextual utility. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves balanced improvements in both privacy sanitization and content retention, with average gains of 10.4% on textual categories and 8.5% under MLLM-based evaluation across four MLLM series, i.e., Qwen2.5, Qwen3, InternVL3, and InternVL3.5.

AI.tldr: 提出APD方法，通过将隐私敏感元素漂移到语义等价替代项，同时锚定上下文线索到源图像，实现无需训练的隐私保护。配套AdaptShield基准测试，涵盖22个隐私类别，实验显示在文本类别上平均提升10.4%，MLLM评估下平均提升8.5%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）带来新的隐私挑战：用户输入包含不可预测的敏感信息，模型推理依赖的视觉上下文本身也可能涉及隐私。现有方法依赖预定义敏感类别和固定混淆策略，难以应对MLLM中的隐私问题。
AI.method: 提出Anchored Privacy Drifting (APD)，一种无需训练的方法，将隐私敏感元素漂移到语义等价替代项，同时将上下文线索锚定到源图像。并构建AdaptShield基准，结合传统隐私指标和基于MLLM的上下文效用评估。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5、Qwen3、InternVL3和InternVL3.5四个MLLM系列上，文本类别平均提升10.4%，MLLM评估下平均提升8.5%。
AI.conclusion: APD方法在隐私净化和内容保留之间实现了平衡改进，有效解决了MLLM中的隐私保护困境。

title: EvoGS: Constructing Continuous-Layered Gaussian Splatting with Evolution Tree for Scalable 3D Streaming
summary: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting requires highly scalable, progressive representations. Existing progressive methods rely on \textit{discrete layering}, accumulating separate splat sets for each level of detail. This structural independence between layers inherently leads to error accumulation, severe splat redundancy, and uncontrolled quality transitions. We propose EvoGS, the first \textit{continuous-layering} representation. Organized as an Evolution Tree, EvoGS generates finer details via an explicit, wavelet-inspired parent-child refinement. This empowers child nodes to structurally correct ancestral errors, yield inherently sparse and highly compressible inter-layer signals. Extensive experiments show EvoGS eliminates splat redundancy from over 65\% to under 25\%. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, it reduces transmission payload and GPU VRAM footprint by up to 2.4$\times$ and 5.5$\times$, respectively, and achieves smooth quality transitions optimal for real-time adaptive streaming. Project page: https://yuang-ian.github.io/evogs/

AI.tldr: EvoGS提出了一种基于进化树的连续分层3D高斯表示方法，通过小波启发的父子节点细化机制，解决了离散分层方法中的误差累积、冗余和不连续问题，实现了高效的自适应流传输。
AI.motivation: 现有基于离散分层的流式3D高斯方法存在各层独立、误差累积、冗余严重和画质切换不自然的问题，亟需一种连续分层的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出EvoGS，采用进化树（Evolution Tree）结构，通过小波启发的显式父子节点细化机制实现连续分层，子节点能够结构性地修正祖先误差，生成稀疏且高压缩性的层间信号。
AI.result: 将高斯冗余从65%降至25%以下；相比SOTA基线，传输负载和GPU显存占用分别降低2.4倍和5.5倍；实现了适合实时自适应流传输的平滑质量过渡。
AI.conclusion: EvoGS通过连续分层表示有效解决了离散方法的固有问题，在压缩效率、显存占用和视觉质量过渡方面均达到最优，适合流式3D高斯渲染场景。

title: OPTIMUS-Prime: Minimal and Sufficient Concept Explanations for Deep Vision Models
summary: The growing demand for transparency in automated decision-making has propelled eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) to the forefront of machine learning research. In computer vision, however, existing explanation methods often prioritize end-user accessibility at the expense of formal guarantees, leaving a critical gap between practical utility and theoretical rigor. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing OPTIMUS, a novel framework for generating concept-based visual explanations for deep classification models. OPTIMUS explanations take the form of visual heatmaps that not only remain interpretable to end users, but are grounded in the well-established theory of prime implicants, providing formal guarantees that have been largely absent from existing saliency-based methods. Specifically, OPTIMUS explanations satisfy two desirable properties: sufficiency, ensuring that the highlighted concepts provably guarantee the classifier's prediction, and minimality, ensuring that no strict subset of those concepts retains this guarantee. Together, these properties yield explanations that are both logically tight and visually coherent. We validate our approach on a visual classification benchmark, demonstrating that OPTIMUS heatmaps naturally and faithfully surface the decision-relevant concepts underlying model predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPTIMUS框架，基于素蕴含理论生成具有充分性和最小性保证的概念级视觉解释热力图，填补了XAI方法在实用性与理论严谨性之间的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉XAI方法注重终端用户可理解性，但缺乏形式化保证，在实用性与理论严谨性之间存在关键缺口。
AI.method: 提出OPTIMUS框架，将概念级视觉解释（热力图）建立在素蕴含理论基础上，满足充分性（高亮概念能保证分类结果）和最小性（无严格子集能保持该保证）两个理想性质。
AI.result: 在视觉分类基准上验证，OPTIMUS热力图能够自然且忠实地揭示决策相关的概念。
AI.conclusion: OPTIMUS提供了兼具逻辑严谨性与视觉连贯性的可解释性方案，弥合了实用性与理论保证之间的差距。

title: AdaTok: Self-Budgeting Image Tokenization with Quality-Preserving Dynamic Tokens
summary: Image tokenizers, from 2D grids to recent 1D sequences, typically encode every image with the same fixed number of tokens. Yet visual complexity is highly heterogeneous, so a uniform budget overspends on simple inputs and underserves complex ones. Existing elastic tokenizers expose variable-length reconstructions, but often leave token length as a deployment-time operating point, a search target, or an external prediction rather than an output of the tokenizer itself. In this work, we ask whether a discrete visual tokenizer can budget itself in one pass. Our central finding is that actionable elasticity requires a representation--allocation co-design: prefixes must remain decodable across budgets, and the tokenizer must learn which prefix each image needs. We propose AdaTok, a self-budgeting discrete 1D tokenizer. AdaTok combines Prioritized Representation Learning, which orders tokens with nested tail masking and resolves budget-dependent semantic shift through Multi-Head LoRA decoder heads, with Adaptive Token Allocation, which trains a lightweight deterministic-group GRPO policy over candidate budgets. Dynamic Pareto Weighting balances fidelity and efficiency during policy training without manual trade-off sweeps. On ImageNet-1K, AdaTok-Full reaches rFID 1.31 at 256 tokens, while AdaTok-Adaptive attains rFID 1.50 using only ~118 tokens on average, outperforming discrete 1D baselines at comparable budgets. In autoregressive image generation, the shorter adaptive representation yields ~2.1x throughput over a fixed 256-token decode, suggesting that visual token count can be learned as a content-conditioned output rather than set as a fixed hyperparameter.

AI.tldr: AdaTok是一种自预算离散1D图像分词器，通过表示-分配联合设计，使分词器能根据图像复杂度自动决定token数量，在ImageNet-1K上达到rFID 1.50（平均~118 tokens），相比固定256 tokens的方案提升2.1倍吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有图像分词器对所有图像使用固定数量的token，忽略了视觉复杂度的异质性，导致简单图像浪费计算资源，复杂图像表示不足。已有的弹性分词器虽然支持可变长度，但token长度通常被作为部署时的操作点、搜索目标或外部预测，而非分词器自身的输出。
AI.method: 提出AdaTok，核心包括：(1) 优先表示学习（Prioritized Representation Learning）——通过嵌套尾部掩码对token排序，并利用Multi-Head LoRA解码器头解决预算依赖的语义偏移；(2) 自适应token分配（Adaptive Token Allocation）——训练轻量级确定性子组GRPO策略来选择候选预算；(3) 动态帕累托加权（Dynamic Pareto Weighting）——在策略训练中平衡保真度与效率，无需手动权衡搜索。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上，AdaTok-Full在256 tokens下达到rFID 1.31；AdaTok-Adaptive平均仅用~118 tokens即达到rFID 1.50，优于同等预算的离散1D基线。在自回归图像生成中，自适应表示相比固定256 tokens解码实现约2.1倍吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token数量可以作为内容条件化的输出进行学习，而非设定为固定超参数，证明了自预算离散分词器的可行性和有效性。

title: TEVI: Text-Conditioned Editing of Visual Representations via Sparse Autoencoders for Improved Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP are highly useful for diverse tasks due to their shared image-text embedding space. Despite this, the image and text embeddings are often poorly aligned, affecting downstream performance. Recent work has shown that this can be attributed to an information imbalance: images contain more information than their captions describe. In this work, we propose TEVI, a framework that uses captions as a signal for what to retain from image embeddings. Specifically, we use sparse autoencoders to disentangle image embeddings and train a masking module to selectively reconstruct the embedding based on a given caption. In a controlled setup with synthetic captions, we show that TEVI is effective at preserving caption-described attributes while discarding others. By applying TEVI to CLIP models trained on natural images, we further achieve improved retrieval performance across coarse-grained short-caption (MS COCO, Flickr) and fine-grained long-caption (IIW, DOCCI) benchmarks, with stronger gains on richer captions, and improved robustness on the RoCOCO benchmark.

AI.tldr: TEVI框架利用稀疏自编码器和掩码模块，根据文本描述选择性地保留图像嵌入中的相关信息，从而改善视觉-语言模型中的图文对齐问题，在多项检索基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）中图像和文本嵌入存在信息不对等：图像包含的信息远多于文本描述，导致嵌入对齐不佳，影响下游任务性能。
AI.method: 提出TEVI框架：使用稀疏自编码器解耦图像嵌入，训练一个基于给定文本描述的掩码模块，选择性地重建图像嵌入中与描述相关的部分，过滤无关信息。
AI.result: 在合成描述的控制实验中有效保留描述属性并丢弃其他属性；在自然图像CLIP模型上，在粗粒度短描述（MS COCO, Flickr）和细粒度长描述（IIW, DOCCI）基准上均提升检索性能，尤其在丰富描述上增益更显著，并在RoCOCO基准上提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 利用文本描述作为信号引导图像嵌入的筛选，能有效改善图文对齐，提升视觉-语言模型在下游任务中的表现。

title: DualGate-Net: A Prior-Gated Dual-Encoder Framework for Histopathology Cell Detection
summary: Cell detection in histopathology images strongly depends on surrounding tissue context, where visually similar cells may belong to different classes under different microenvironments. Recent tissue-aware methods incorporate contextual priors, but often rely on static fusion strategies that may propagate noisy information. In this work, we propose DualGate-Net, a prior-aware dual-encoder framework that combines a ConvNeXtV2-based local encoder and a SegFormer-based global encoder through a learnable prior-gated fusion mechanism. The proposed module adaptively regulates the influence of tissue priors across spatial locations, while an auxiliary foreground reconstruction branch preserves high-frequency cellular structures during training. In addition, auxiliary cellness-guided cues are incorporated to further improve localization robustness. Experiments on the OCELOT benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements, achieving macro F1-scores of 0.7722 on the validation set and 0.7345 on the test set, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive prior integration for robust histopathology cell detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DualGate-Net，一种基于可学习先验门控融合机制的双编码器框架，用于组织病理学图像中的细胞检测，在OCELOT基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 组织病理学图像中细胞检测严重依赖周围组织上下文，视觉上相似的细胞在不同微环境中可能属于不同类别。现有组织感知方法虽引入上下文先验，但常依赖静态融合策略，可能传播噪声信息。
AI.method: 提出DualGate-Net，包含ConvNeXtV2局部编码器和SegFormer全局编码器的双编码器框架，通过可学习的先验门控融合机制自适应调节组织先验在不同空间位置的影响；同时引入辅助前景重建分支保留高频细胞结构，以及细胞性引导线索提升定位鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在OCELOT基准上，验证集macro F1达到0.7722，测试集macro F1达到0.7345，验证了自适应先验整合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的先验门控融合机制相比静态融合策略能更有效地整合组织上下文信息，为鲁棒的组织病理学细胞检测提供了新思路。

title: MemDreamer: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Hierarchical Graph Memory and Agentic Retrieval Mechanism
summary: Current Vision-Language Models struggle with hours-long videos because processing full-length visual sequences induces prohibitive token explosion and attention dilution. To overcome this, we introduce MemDreamer to decouple perception and reasoning, shifting long-video understanding into an agentic exploration process. As a plug-and-play framework, it incrementally streams videos to construct a Hierarchical Graph Memory, a top-down three-tier architecture for semantic abstraction, anchored by a foundational graph capturing spatiotemporal and causal relations. During inference, the reasoning model employs agentic tool-augmented retrieval, navigating hierarchies, searching nodes, and traversing logical edges via an Observation-Reason-Action loop. Experiments show MemDreamer achieves SOTA results across four mainstream benchmarks, narrowing the gap with human experts to only 3.7 points. It constrains the reasoning context window to merely 2% of full-context ingestion while delivering a 12.5 point absolute accuracy gain. Furthermore, statistical analysis uncovers a strong positive linear correlation between an VLM's performance on logic reasoning and long-video understanding benchmarks, establishing agentic capability scaling as a new paradigm for multimodal comprehension.

AI.tldr: MemDreamer通过分层图记忆和智能体检索机制，将长视频理解转化为探索过程，仅用2%的上下文窗口实现SOTA性能，与人类专家差距缩小至3.7分。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型处理长视频时面临token爆炸和注意力稀释问题，无法有效理解数小时长度的视频内容。
AI.method: 提出MemDreamer框架，采用分层图记忆架构（三层次语义抽象）增量式流式处理视频，结合智能体增强检索（Observation-Reason-Action循环）进行推理。
AI.result: 在四个主流基准上达到SOTA，推理上下文仅需全量的2%，准确率提升12.5分，与人类专家差距仅3.7分。
AI.conclusion: 发现VLM的逻辑推理与长视频理解性能呈强正线性相关，智能体能力扩展成为多模态理解的新范式。

title: Does Appearance Help? A Systematic Study of Image-Based Re-Identification in Online 3D Multi-Pedestrian Tracking
comment: Accepted for publication at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: LiDAR-based 3D Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) typically relies solely on geometric information, which is often insufficient to distinguish between targets during prolonged occlusions or in crowded human-populated environments. While integrating RGB-based Re-Identification (ReID) offers a theoretical solution for preserving identity context, existing approaches often rely on computationally expensive parallel detectors that hinder real-time robot responsiveness. This work presents a systematic study of image-based ReID in online 3D MOT, utilizing a lightweight projection-based framework to decouple geometric and appearance modeling for mobile robots. A comprehensive analysis of feature extraction architectures is conducted, employing lightweight CNNs and Vision Transformers, and evaluating various multi-modal data association strategies to balance computational latency with robust tracking. Experiments on the Pedestrian class of the KITTI dataset reveal that naive linear fusion, of appearance and motion costs, degrades performance due to visual noise. Conversely, a cascaded matching strategy successfully recovers occluded tracks without compromising overall precision, effectively preventing identity switches to maintain human-robot interaction continuity. We show that lightweight architectures can offer an optimal trade-off between the low latency required for safe navigation and the discriminative power needed for social awareness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了在移动机器人3D多目标跟踪中，使用轻量级投影框架将图像ReID与几何信息解耦，通过级联匹配策略有效处理遮挡和人群密集场景，在KITTI数据集上证明轻量级架构能在低延迟和鲁棒跟踪之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 纯几何信息的LiDAR 3D MOT在长时间遮挡或拥挤人群环境中难以区分目标，而现有融合RGB ReID的方法依赖计算昂贵的并行检测器，无法满足移动机器人的实时性需求。
AI.method: 提出轻量级投影框架解耦几何与外观建模；对比轻量级CNN和Vision Transformer等特征提取架构；评估多种多模态数据关联策略，包括朴素线性融合和级联匹配策略。
AI.result: 朴素线性融合因视觉噪声导致性能下降；级联匹配策略成功恢复被遮挡轨迹且不损害整体精度，有效防止身份切换。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级架构能够在安全导航所需的低延迟与社交感知所需的判别能力之间提供最优权衡。

title: Reconstructing Multi-Decadal Forest Disturbances: A Spatio-Temporal Transformer Approach
summary: Accurate monitoring of forest disturbances is essential for understanding carbon dynamics and land management, yet traditional approaches typically rely on pixel-wise analysis of satellite time-series, ignoring spatial context. We present a deep learning framework that maps 38 years (1984-2022) of forest disturbance across the contiguous United States by modeling temporal trajectories and spatial neighborhoods simultaneously. By leveraging a vision transformer architecture, our approach effectively filters noise from weak supervision signals to produce spatially coherent disturbance maps. We perform exhaustive evaluations across multiple satellites (Landsat, Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2) and temporal windows (38 years and the more recent 6 years), validating performance against a novel, manually annotated validation dataset (n=300) and independent fire perimeter dataset (n=706). The results highlight the complexity of the task: while our spatio-temporal model demonstrates high precision (up to 98.2% for +-1 year detection on MTBS and up to 71.3% on the CONUS validation datasets, with F1-scores up to 75.8% and 47.3%, respectively) and effectively reduces spatial artifacts, it exhibits performance trade-offs across different disturbance regimes compared to pixel-wise baselines. Our method offers a promising foundation for consistent forest monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉Transformer的深度学习框架，通过同时建模时间轨迹和空间邻域，对美国本土38年（1984-2022）的森林干扰进行了高精度监测，在多个卫星数据源上验证了有效性，精度最高达98.2%。
AI.motivation: 传统森林干扰监测方法通常基于像素级的时间序列分析，忽略了空间上下文信息，导致监测结果缺乏空间连贯性。本文旨在解决这一问题，通过同时建模时间和空间维度来提升监测精度和空间一致性。
AI.method: 采用视觉Transformer架构，同时建模时间轨迹和空间邻域信息，利用弱监督信号进行训练，并有效过滤噪声。在Landsat、Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2等多个卫星数据源上进行了38年和6年时间窗口的实验评估。
AI.result: 在MTBS数据集上，±1年检测精度高达98.2%，F1分数达75.8%；在CONUS验证数据集上精度达71.3%，F1分数为47.3%。该方法有效减少了空间伪影，但在不同干扰类型间存在性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该时空模型为一致性森林监测提供了有前景的基础，虽在不同干扰场景下与像素级基线存在性能权衡，但整体上显著提升了监测的空间连贯性和精度。

title: ExMesh: EXplicit Mesh Reconstruction with Topology Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026 (CVPR 2026)
summary: Reconstructing surface meshes from multi-view images has remained a core challenge in recent years. Most existing methods, whether implicit or explicit, depend on intermediate representations and post-processing steps like Marching Cubes or TSDF fusion, often resulting in artifacts and fragmented geometry. Directly optimizing explicit meshes is a promising approach. However, it presents two critical challenges. The first is how to adaptively refine mesh topology to capture detail without introducing degenerate faces. The second is how to maintain consistent UV coordinates for high-fidelity texturing as the mesh structure evolves. To overcome these, we propose ExMesh, a novel framework that directly optimizes explicit meshes by integrating differentiable optimization with discrete topology updates. Specifically, we introduce an adaptive vertex splitting and merging strategy, along with real-time UV maintenance, to enable coarse-to-fine optimization while preserving geometric integrity. To our knowledge, ExMesh is the first framework to seamlessly integrate discrete topology operations into a continuous differentiable optimization pipeline. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ExMesh achieves a balance among accuracy, computational efficiency, and mesh conciseness.

AI.tldr: ExMesh提出了一种直接优化显式网格的框架，通过可微优化与离散拓扑更新结合，实现从粗到细的重建，无需中间表示和后处理步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖中间表示（如Marching Cubes、TSDF融合）会产生伪影和碎片化几何，而直接优化显式网格面临自适应细化拓扑和保持UV一致性的双重挑战。
AI.method: 提出ExMesh框架，创新性地将离散拓扑操作（自适应顶点分裂与合并）集成到连续可微优化管线中，并引入实时UV维护机制。
AI.result: 在精度、计算效率和网格简洁性之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: ExMesh是首个将离散拓扑操作无缝集成到连续可微优化中的框架，有效解决了显式网格直接优化的关键难题。

title: CULTURESCORE: Evaluating Cultural Faithfulness in Video Generation Models
summary: As video generation models like Veo 3.1 and LTX-2 advance, their ability to accurately represent diverse global cultures remains a critical yet understudied frontier. Current metrics, such as VideoScore, only measure visual quality but offer no mechanism for assessing cultural faithfulness. Consequently, a model that replaces a Namaste with a handshake receives the same score as one that generates the gesture correctly. We propose CultureScore, a compositional evaluation framework that decomposes cultural faithfulness into three granular dimensions: Identity (who is represented), Context (culturally localized background), and Behavior (normative gestures and interactions). We operationalize this framework through an evaluation suite spanning 10 countries, yielding 6,180 generated videos across three state-of-the-art models. Our evaluation reveals that no current model achieves culturally faithful video generation: the best-performing model reaches only 56.8\% overall CultureScore, with Behavior the most challenging dimension, which remains below 52\% across all models. Furthermore, human preference rankings align directionally with CultureScore but are inverted relative to VideoScore; the highest-scoring model on visual quality was ranked last by annotators, underscoring that cultural faithfulness is an essential criterion for equitable video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CultureScore框架，从身份、背景、行为三个维度评估视频生成模型的文化忠诚度。对10个国家、3个模型、6180个视频的评估显示，最佳模型仅达56.8%得分，行为维度最差（<52%），且人类偏好与CultureScore一致，与VideoScore相反。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评估指标（如VideoScore）仅衡量视觉质量，无法评估模型对多元文化的忠实再现能力，导致文化上的错误（如将合十礼替换为握手）无法被有效检测。
AI.method: 提出CultureScore合成评估框架，将文化忠诚度分解为身份（代表谁）、背景（文化本地化场景）和行为（规范手势与互动）三个维度，并在10个国家、3个SOTA模型上生成6180个视频进行系统评估。
AI.result: 所有模型均未能实现文化忠诚的视频生成：最佳模型CultureScore仅56.8%，行为维度最差（低于52%）。视觉质量最高的模型在人工标注中排名垫底，表明文化忠诚度是公平视频生成的关键标准。
AI.conclusion: CultureScore能有效区分模型的文化表现，且与人类偏好一致；现有模型在文化忠实性方面存在显著不足，亟需改进。

title: AnchorWorld: Embodied Egocentric World Simulation with View-based Evolution Customization
summary: Despite being a pivotal frontier, interactive world modeling remains underexplored in terms of the versatile controllability required by practical scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present AnchorWorld, a framework that advances egocentric simulation through enhanced interaction integrity and a flexible mechanism for world customization. First, we utilize 3D human motion as the primary interaction modality. To complement the out-of-view or truncated body parts in egocentric views, we introduce an auxiliary training supervision that incorporates exogenous viewpoints decoupled from the agent's first-person sensorium. It allows the model to observe the agent's full-body positioning relative to the environment, facilitating a more robust spatial grounding of human-world interactions. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective mechanism for customizing self-evolving worlds. This is achieved by defining anchor views within a unified world coordinate system, coupled with textual descriptions dictating the dynamic evolution of local scenes. Experimental results show that AnchorWorld significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, while ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our key designs. Notably, our customization scheme exhibits promising spatio-temporal geometric consistency and adheres strictly to the prescribed evolutionary dynamics.

AI.tldr: AnchorWorld是一个面向交互式世界建模的框架，通过3D人体运动与外源视角辅助监督实现完整的全身交互感知，并利用锚点视图与文本描述实现可定制的自演化世界，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界建模在实际应用中需要多样的可控性，但现有研究对此探索不足，尤其在egocentric视角下因身体部位被截断或超出视野导致交互建模不完整。
AI.method: 1) 以3D人体运动作为主要交互模态；2) 引入外源视角辅助训练监督，弥补第一人称视角中身体部位的缺失，增强空间定位；3) 提出锚点视图机制，在统一世界坐标系下结合文本描述控制局部场景的动态演化。
AI.result: 显著优于当前最先进的基线模型，消融实验验证了关键设计的有效性，定制方案展现出良好的时空几何一致性并严格遵循指定的演化动态。
AI.conclusion: AnchorWorld通过多视角监督与锚点视图定制机制，有效提升了交互式世界建模的完整性和可控性，为egocentric仿真提供了新的解决方案。

title: Varifold Moment Invariants for Sustainable and Explainable Contour Feature Extraction
summary: We introduce Varifold Moments Invariants (VMI) as a unifying framework for many previously introduced Moment Invariants. These invariants are deeply related to other contour features that are invariant under translations and rotations, like Extended Gaussian Image, Elliptic Fourier Descriptors or Shape Distributions. The advantage of the varifold approach to moments consists in being able to combine the geometry of the region, its boundary, and the family of lines tangent to it, in order to create a substantial number of invariant features with high discriminating power and clear geometric meaning. By coupling our VMI feature extraction with the light feature classifiers Random Forest or Multi-Layer-Perceptron, we outperform state-of-the-art approaches based on contours, while decreasing drastically the computational cost to the point of allowing our algorithm to run on light devices. We tested our approach on classification tasks on a large number of widely-used datasets of various types (leaves, objects, cells) and achieved high accuracy with a low number of geometrically interpretable features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Varifold矩不变量（VMI）统一框架，结合区域几何、边界和切线族生成高判别力几何特征，配合轻量分类器在轮廓分类任务上超越现有方法，计算成本低且可在轻量设备运行。
AI.motivation: 现有矩不变量方法众多但缺乏统一框架，且现有基于轮廓的方法计算成本高、可解释性差。VMI旨在统一这些方法，同时提高判别力、降低计算开销。
AI.method: 提出Varifold矩不变量（VMI），将区域几何、边界和切线族信息融合生成不变特征；配合Random Forest或MLP等轻量分类器进行分类。
AI.result: 在叶片、物体、细胞等多类数据集上，以少量几何可解释特征取得高准确率，超越基于轮廓的现有方法，且计算成本大幅降低，可在轻量设备运行。
AI.conclusion: VMI是一个兼具统一性、高判别力、几何可解释性和计算高效性的矩不变量框架，适合轻量设备的实时分类任务。

title: VeriDrive: Verifiable Counterfactual Supervision for Cost-Efficient Vision-Language Planning
summary: Vision-language driving models increasingly use reasoning supervision to bridge perception, prediction, and planning, but existing driving rationales are often free-form and expensive to generate with frontier models. We present VeriDrive, a framework for constructing planning-oriented, verifiable counterfactual supervision. VeriDrive converts driving reasoning into a structured Perception-Evaluation-Revision chain that grounds key objects in future motion, evaluates alternative ego trajectories with rule-checkable evidence, revises risky intent toward expert behavior, and produces final planning targets. To scale data construction, VeriDrive combines local generation with validator-guided selective correction, escalating only invalid or difficult samples. We build the VeriDrive dataset on nuScenes and train under the Omni-Q protocol. Controlled open-loop experiments show that VeriDrive improves L2, Collision, and Intersection over OmniDrive while reducing logged token usage, generation time, and actual paid LLM/VLM cost. These results show that auditable intermediate fields and structured revision targets can improve vision-language planning supervision under realistic annotation budgets. Code, prompts, and validator scripts are coming soon and will be released after the review process.

AI.tldr: VeriDrive提出了一种结构化、可验证的反事实推理监督框架，通过感知-评估-修正链将驾驶推理转化为可审计的规划信号，在降低生成成本的同时提升了自动驾驶规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言驾驶模型使用的推理监督多为自由文本形式，且依赖前沿模型生成，成本高昂且难以审计，缺乏结构化的可验证规划导向监督信号。
AI.method: 将驾驶推理转化为结构化的"感知-评估-修正"链，基于未来运动定位关键目标、用规则可验证证据评估替代轨迹、修正高风险意图为专家行为。结合本地生成与验证器引导的选择性修正，仅处理无效或困难样本以扩展数据规模。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上基于Omni-Q协议训练，开环实验表明VeriDrive相比OmniDrive在L2、碰撞率和交并比指标上均有提升，同时减少了日志token用量、生成时间和实际LLM/VLM付费成本。
AI.conclusion: 可审计的中间字段和结构化修正目标能在实际标注预算约束下有效改善视觉-语言规划监督质量。

title: Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Adapter for Micro-gesture Online Recognition
comment: Technical Report. 1st Place in Micro-gesture Online Recognition in 4th MiGA at IJCAI 2026
summary: Micro-gesture online recognition aims to temporally localize and classify subtle gestures in untrimmed videos. Owing to their extremely short duration, low motion amplitude, and ambiguous visual cues, capturing discriminative spatiotemporal representations remains highly challenging. Existing parameter-efficient adapters typically employ a single branch to model spatial and temporal cues jointly, which may fail to capture the fine-grained patterns of micro-gestures. To address this limitation, we propose a Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Adapter that decomposes video adaptation into independent temporal and spatial branches via lightweight depthwise convolutions. In addition, to address the long-tail distribution problem in the benchmark dataset, we introduce Adaptive Soft Balanced Augmentation, which dynamically allocates augmentation intensity based on class rarity and learning difficulty, without manual thresholds. Our method achieves an F1 score of 0.43808, ranking 1st in Track 2 of the 4th EI-MiGA-IJCAI Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文针对微手势在线识别中的时空表征学习困难问题，提出了时空解耦适配器（STD-Adapter）和自适应软平衡增强（ASBA）方法，在第四届EI-MiGA-IJCAI挑战赛Track 2中取得第一名（F1=0.43808）。
AI.motivation: 微手势具有持续时间极短、运动幅度小、视觉线索模糊等特点，现有参数高效适配器通常使用单分支联合建模时空信息，难以捕捉微手势的细粒度模式。
AI.method: 1）时空解耦适配器（STD-Adapter）：通过轻量级深度可分离卷积将视频适配分解为独立的时间分支和空间分支；2）自适应软平衡增强（ASBA）：根据类别稀有度和学习难度动态分配增强强度，无需手动设置阈值，缓解长尾分布问题。
AI.result: 在第四届EI-MiGA-IJCAI挑战赛Track 2中取得第一名，F1得分为0.43808。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的时空解耦策略和自适应数据增强方法能有效提升微手势在线识别的性能。

title: Mind the Gap: Disentangling Performance Bottlenecks in Video Instance Segmentation
summary: In Video Instance Segmentation (VIS), classification, segmentation, and tracking objectives are jointly evaluated, but their individual contributions to performance loss remain opaque. We introduce a diagnostic framework that formulates identity and class assignment as an Integer Linear Program (ILP), yielding a model-agnostic oracle that hierarchically isolates each error source. Applied to seven VIS methods spanning online and offline paradigms across YouTube-VIS 2019/2021 and a diagnostic subset of OVIS, our analysis reveals a consistent picture. Tracking instability is a critical bottleneck for online methods, with gaps exceeding 20 AP under heavy occlusion, and grows sharply with video length and instance density. While semantic classification contributes meaningfully on standard benchmarks, its impact becomes negligible where tracking fails most. Although stronger backbones substantially lift default scores, they leave AP tracking gaps largely intact, confirming that temporal fragility is algorithmic rather than purely representational. To complement the oracle, we introduce TrackLens, a visual tool that translates gap magnitude into observable, query-level failure modes. Together, these tools provide a systematic foundation for targeting VIS's core challenge: robust long-term temporal association.

AI.tldr: 本文提出诊断框架（ILP oracle）和可视化工具TrackLens，系统分析VIS中分类、分割、跟踪三种误差来源，发现跟踪不稳定性是核心瓶颈，尤其在遮挡、长视频和密集实例场景下表现突出，且语义分类影响在跟踪失败时微乎其微。更强骨干网络无法缩小跟踪差距，表明时序脆弱性是算法性问题。
AI.motivation: VIS任务中分类、分割和跟踪目标共同评估，但各自对性能损失的贡献不透明，缺乏系统性诊断工具来隔离和分析各误差来源。
AI.method: 提出基于整数线性规划（ILP）的诊断框架，作为模型无关的oracle，分层隔离身份分配和类别分配误差。并开发TrackLens可视化工具，将差距幅度转化为可观察的查询级故障模式。
AI.result: 在YouTube-VIS 2019/2021和OVIS子集上对七种VIS方法分析发现：跟踪不稳定性是主要瓶颈，尤其在严重遮挡下差距超过20 AP；跟踪误差随视频长度和实例密度急剧增长；语义分类在跟踪失败时影响可忽略；更强骨干网络无法缩小跟踪差距。
AI.conclusion: VIS的核心挑战是鲁棒的长期时序关联（跟踪），而非分类或特征表示能力。提出的框架为针对性解决该问题提供了系统基础。

title: DisPOSE: Projected Polystochastic Diffusion for Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Recovering 3D human poses for multiple individuals from different camera views is a fundamental bottleneck for analyzing interacting behaviors. Existing self-supervised approaches leverage synthetic catalogues of 3D poses; however, this leads to poor generalization in real-world scenarios due to distribution shifts. We therefore introduce DisPOSE, a self-supervised framework that approximates the inherently discrete multi-view person-assignment problem as a generative diffusion process over the space of polystochastic tensors. By employing differentiable Sinkhorn projections during denoising, our model learns to guide solutions toward valid and feasible assignments based on 2D image priors. The complete 3D skeletons of localized individuals are then regressed using a Hypergraph-Convolutional Decoder that explicitly models relational structures and articulated joints across multiple views. The proposed approach outperforms current state-of-the-art self-supervised methods on standard datasets and demonstrates strong performance on a newly proposed benchmark featuring highly occluded scenes from surgical operating rooms. Our diffusion-based localization demonstrates high label efficiency, retaining 99% of its performance with only 10% of the pseudo-labels. Notably, disentangling the assignment and root regression components while maintaining differentiability makes DisPOSE nearly agnostic to different camera arrangements.

AI.tldr: DisPOSE是一个自监督框架，通过将多视角多人3D姿态估计中的分配问题建模为扩散过程，结合Sinkhorn投影和超图卷积解码器，实现了高效、鲁棒且不依赖相机布局的3D人体姿态恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督方法依赖合成3D姿态目录，在真实场景中因分布偏移泛化能力差，且多视角下多人姿态恢复的离散分配问题难以处理。
AI.method: 将多视角人员分配问题建模为多随机张量空间上的生成扩散过程，通过可微Sinkhorn投影引导去噪过程得到有效分配；利用超图卷积解码器从多视角回归完整3D骨架。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上超越现有自监督方法，在高度遮挡的手术室场景新基准上表现优异；仅用10%伪标签即可保持99%性能。
AI.conclusion: DisPOSE通过解耦分配与根回归组件并保持可微性，实现了对多种相机布局的近乎无关性，兼具高标签效率和强泛化能力。

title: OpenGlass: Open-Source Smart Glasses for On-Device Event-Based Gesture Recognition
summary: Smart eyewear enables unobtrusive, context-aware interaction through multimodal sensors and on-device intelligence, but is severely limited by power, memory, and compute constraints in a compact form factor. Open-hardware platforms supporting event-based vision and embedded ML at this scale are rare. This work introduces an open-source smart glasses platform for rapid prototyping of novel sensors and algorithms. Its modular design uses a flexible FPC interposer to support both event-based and frame-based cameras without full PCB redesign. A hardware-software co-designed power management system combines a configurable PMIC with event-driven wake-up via an nRF5340 coordinator, keeping the GAP9 RISC-V SoC powered down between inferences. The prototype achieves up to 11.8 hours of continuous on-device ML from a 200 mAh battery. As a demonstration, an egocentric hand gesture recognition pipeline was evaluated on the LynX dataset using polarity-separated event histograms from a Prophesee GENX320 camera. R(2+1)D achieved the best cross-subject accuracy of 83.94\% (macro F1 = 0.781) under leave-two-subjects-out validation, with 33.9 ms end-to-end latency on the GAP9. Temporal augmentation and removal of ambiguous classes provided the largest gains (+8.9 pp). All hardware designs, firmware, and models are released open source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种开源的智能眼镜平台，采用模块化设计和硬件-软件协同电源管理，支持事件相机和帧相机，在GAP9 RISC-V SoC上实现11.8小时持续ML推理，并通过LynX数据集上的手势识别验证了系统性能。
AI.motivation: 现有智能眼镜受限于功耗、内存和算力，且支持事件视觉和嵌入式ML的开源硬件平台极少，亟需一个可在紧凑尺寸下快速原型验证新型传感器和算法的开放平台。
AI.method: 采用柔性FPC转接板实现模块化设计，支持事件相机和帧相机无需重新设计PCB；硬件-软件协同电源管理，通过可配置PMIC结合nRF5340事件驱动唤醒，使GAP9 RISC-V SoC在不推理时保持断电状态。
AI.result: 200mAh电池下实现11.8小时连续ML推理；在LynX数据集上，R(2+1)D在手势识别任务中取得83.94%的跨受试者准确率（macro F1=0.781），端到端延迟33.9ms；时序增强和移除歧义类别带来最大提升（+8.9个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 该开源智能眼镜平台在功耗、性能和模块化方面均具有显著优势，所有硬件设计、固件和模型均已开源，为可穿戴设备领域的快速原型开发提供了有力支持。

title: Skill-3D: Evolving Scene-Aware Skills for Agentic 3D Spatial Reasoning
summary: This paper explores agentic 3D spatial understanding, i.e., MLLM agents performing 3D reasoning through tool use. Existing methods often misuse tools and exhibit biased tool preferences under 3D scenarios, leaving the agentic paradigm with only marginal gains over non-agentic strategies. We reveal that 3D spatial reasoning tasks are heterogeneous across scenes, while these agents apply a uniform tool-use strategy to all scenes rather than selecting tools according to the specific scene and task. To address this, we propose Skill-3D, a framework that learns self-evolving scene-aware skills. Specifically, Skill-3D identifies the task scene and records the agent's tool-use trajectory into a Scene Memory, where successful trajectories from similar scenes are aggregated and distilled into a reusable scene-aware skill, with failed ones attached to the skill as lessons. During training, once a similar scene recurs, the corresponding skill is injected to guide the agent, producing new trajectories whose successes and failures further refine the skill, forming a loop in which the memory and the skill library co-evolve. Experiments show that Skill-3D substantially improves tool utilization in 3D spatial reasoning (from 39% to 78% on VSI-Bench), driving the agent toward correct and sufficient tool use. For instance, it improves Gemini-3-Flash by 67% on MMSI-Bench. Furthermore, we conduct agentic post-training over skill-guided trajectories, which boosts Qwen3-VL-8B by 43% on VSI-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill-3D框架，通过自演进的场景感知技能学习，将智能体的3D工具使用成功率从39%提升到78%。
AI.motivation: 现有3D推理智能体对所有场景使用统一的工具策略，忽略了3D空间推理任务在不同场景间的异质性，导致工具误用和性能提升有限。
AI.method: Skill-3D框架包含Scene Memory和技能库：识别任务场景并记录工具使用轨迹，将相似场景的成功轨迹聚合并蒸馏为可复用的场景感知技能，失败轨迹作为经验教训附加；当相似场景再次出现时注入对应技能引导智能体，新轨迹的成败进一步优化技能，形成记忆与技能库的共同演进闭环。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench上工具利用率从39%提升至78%，在MMSI-Bench上使Gemini-3-Flash提升67%，通过技能引导轨迹对Qwen3-VL-8B进行后训练后在VSI-Bench上提升43%。
AI.conclusion: 场景感知的技能学习能有效解决3D推理中工具误用问题，实现正确且充分的工具使用，并可通过后训练进一步赋能基础模型。

title: Implicit Data Synthesis for Contrastive Unsupervised Data Augmentation
summary: Scientific observations generate large quantities of unlabeled data which is laborious to hand-label, making unsupervised learning techniques valuable for processing datasets. Among these approaches, contrastive learning provides a convenient mechanism for extracting structural representations from unannotated datasets. For natural imagery, the general approach is to use a variety of data-space augmentation methods in order to generate synthetic samples; however, for scientific observations data-space perturbations can fundamentally alter the underlying data. Our proposed method is to generate contrastive samples by perturbing the network weights rather than the underlying data, thus more closely preserving the structure of the data. We demonstrate this technique using a SimCLR-based pipeline applied over radar observations of meteors, and show performance gains under matched protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过扰动网络权重而非数据本身来生成对比学习样本的方法，在雷达流星观测数据上验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 科学观测产生大量未标注数据，手动标注成本高；现有对比学习依赖数据增强，但科学数据中数据空间扰动会改变底层数据结构。
AI.method: 提出扰动网络权重而非数据来生成对比样本，基于SimCLR框架在雷达流星观测数据上实现。
AI.result: 在匹配协议下，该方法相比传统数据增强方法取得了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 权重扰动对比学习是一种更适用于科学观测数据的无监督表示学习方法，能更好地保持数据原始结构。

title: Streaming Video Generation with Streaming Force Control
summary: We introduce StreamForce, a streaming video generation framework that enables physically grounded control through continuous force inputs. Unlike prior video models that train separate models for different force types, assume fixed forces, or rely on non-causal processing, StreamForce is a causal and unified model that responds instantly and coherently to both local and global, time-varying forces. To achieve this, we design a unified force representation as a control signal and develop a distillation pipeline for force-controllable video generation. Our model combines autoregressive efficiency with force responsiveness, sustaining stable photometric and dynamic realism. StreamForce runs at up to 16.6 FPS on a single GPU, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both force adherence and motion realism. Project website: https://neu-vi.github.io/StreamForce/

AI.tldr: StreamForce是一个流式视频生成框架，通过连续力输入实现物理可控的视频生成，支持局部和全局时变力，具备因果性和统一性，在单GPU上达到16.6 FPS，在力遵循和运动真实性方面达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视频模型存在以下问题：不同力类型需要训练不同模型、假设力是固定的、或依赖非因果处理。作者希望构建一个因果且统一的模型，能够即时且一致地响应局部和全局的时变力。
AI.method: 设计统一的力表示作为控制信号，开发用于力可控视频生成的蒸馏流程，结合自回归模型的高效性与力响应能力。
AI.result: 单GPU上运行速度达16.6 FPS，在力遵循和运动真实性方面达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: StreamForce通过统一的力表示和蒸馏管道，成功实现了高效、因果、物理可控的流式视频生成，兼顾了光度和动态的真实性。
